jobs.title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The DevSecOps Engineer at Shield AI is responsible for designing, building, securing, and operating the software delivery infrastructure required to develop and deploy advanced autonomous systems for defence applications.

This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, platform engineering, cyber security, and defence systems engineering. The DevSecOps Engineer works alongside autonomy, software, systems, integration, and test engineers to create secure and reliable development environments and delivery pipelines that enable teams to rapidly develop, integrate, test, and deploy mission critical software.

The ideal candidate has a strong software and platform engineering background combined with significant experience operating within UK defence environments. They have a strong understanding of the UK Ministry of Defence/NATO approach to DevSecOps, Secure by Design, cyber risk management, security assurance, and the delivery of software into classified and operational environments.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and operate secure development and deployment infrastructure for Shield AI autonomy and defence programmes.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines that enable rapid, repeatable, and secure delivery of autonomy and mission software.
  • Embed security throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring security controls, testing, evidence, and assurance are integrated into engineering workflows rather than treated as separate activities.
  • Apply UK MOD Secure by Design principles throughout the development lifecycle and help engineering teams understand and meet their responsibilities for cyber security and technical assurance.
  • Work closely with software, autonomy, systems, cyber security, integration, and test engineers to establish development environments that support rapid engineering while meeting defence security requirements.
  • Design and maintain development and deployment environments spanning cloud, on premises infrastructure, laboratory environments, simulation, hardware in the loop, and operational platforms.
  • Enable secure software development and deployment across different security classifications and appropriately segmented development environments.
  • Implement automated security controls within CI/CD pipelines, including static analysis, dependency scanning, container scanning, secrets detection, software composition analysis, vulnerability management, and policy enforcement.
  • Champion a DevSecOps culture where software engineers take ownership of the security, reliability, deployability, and operational performance of the systems they develop.

Required Qualifications

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cyber Security, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, software engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Significant experience delivering software or digital capabilities within UK defence or another highly regulated national security environment.
  • Strong understanding of the UK Ministry of Defence/NATO approach to DevSecOps and Secure by Design, including the integration of cyber security and risk management throughout the capability lifecycle.
  • Experience applying MOD security policies, security assurance processes, and technical security requirements to software intensive defence programmes.
  • Experience developing and operating CI/CD pipelines using modern source control, build, test, artefact management, and deployment technologies.
  • Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, containerisation, and infrastructure automation
  • Experience with technologies such as Git, GitLab or GitHub, or equivalent tooling.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience supporting DevSecOps, software delivery, or digital engineering activities across NATO nations or multinational defence programmes.
  • Understanding of DevSecOps approaches, security frameworks, and software assurance practices used by other NATO nations, particularly the United States and European NATO partners.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

The Senior Director of Operations & Sustainment (O&S) is responsible for ensuring customers successfully deploy, operate, maintain, and evolve the company's software and VIDAR hardware products throughout their lifecycle. O&S owns the post-development operational ecosystem that enables Hivemind Vision (HMV) integrated VIDAR, Hivemind Enterprise (HME) software and the Hivemind Solutions (HMS) service to scale while maintaining exceptional customer satisfaction.

This is an exciting opportunity to build the Hivemind O&S organization from the ground up. The organization serves as the bridge between Product Engineering, Customer Success, and Field Operations by enabling successful product deployment, sustaining operational readiness, providing technical support, capturing customer feedback, and driving continuous improvement.

This role sits at the center of all Hivemind business lines, ensuring customer satisfaction post-delivery. This is a hands-on leadership role that requires both strong systems engineering instincts and the organizational discipline to build a team and establish the processes, systems, and engineering rigor necessary to support a growing customer base while ensuring issues rapidly inform future product development.

What you'll do:

    Establish the organization, practices, tools, and ways of working which manage the following:

    Product Deployment & Integration

  • Lead teams responsible for installation, integration, and operational deployment of the HME Software within customer environments.
  • Develop repeatable deployment methodologies, tools, and best practices that reduce deployment timelines and improve customer outcomes.
  • Support direct HME customers integrating and building upon the HME, HMS teams delivering customized customer solutions, and HMV customers integrating VIDAR and associated software.

    • Training, Documentation & Knowledge Enablement

  • Own the strategy and execution for customer education and operational knowledge management.
  • Maintain and continuously improve training curriculum, technical publications, installation guides, troubleshooting documentation, and operational manuals.
  • Develop knowledge transfer materials that enable customers to effectively deploy, configure, maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance their systems.
  • Produce technical content and playbooks for Forward Deployed Engineers, Customer Support Engineers, and field personnel to resolve recurring issues and efficiently collect diagnostic data.

    • Sustaining Engineering

  • Lead engineering efforts supporting products operating in customer environments.
  • Track and manage customer configurations and upgrades.
  • Provide technical expertise for deployment support, issue resolution, and operational readiness.
  • Ensure technical issues are documented, reproduced, prioritized, and communicated effectively to HMV, HME, and HMS Engineering organizations.
  • Drive root cause analysis and corrective actions that improve product reliability and customer experience.

    • Test & Evaluation

  • Drive rapid validation and verification activities supporting customer-critical hardware repairs, bug fixes and software updates.
  • Develop lightweight but rigorous test methodologies for sustaining engineering changes.
  • Coordinate closely with Engineering to accelerate customer-impacting releases.

    • Customer Support Engineering

  • Own the technical support engineering organization serving as the initial point of contact for customer-reported issues and feature requests.
  • Establish technical triage processes that rapidly classify, prioritize, and route customer issues.
  • Provide technically proficient support beyond traditional call-center functions.
  • Define service level objectives and operational metrics for customer responsiveness.
  • Ensure customer feedback is systematically captured and incorporated into product planning as appropriate.

    • Operational Excellence & Engineering Enablement

  • Establish the systems engineering discipline, operational processes, and governance supporting all Operations & Sustainment functions.
  • Define standard operating procedures, workflows, quality standards, and engineering best practices.
  • Develop operational metrics and dashboards to monitor deployment performance, customer support effectiveness, issue resolution, and sustainment health.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, scalability, and customer satisfaction.

    • Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the operational interface between Engineering, Program Management, Customer Success, Forward Deployed Engineering, and Customer Support.
  • Translate operational insights and customer feedback into actionable product improvements.
  • Partner with HMV, HME, and HMS leadership to ensure sustainment capabilities evolve alongside product growth.
  • Balance customer responsiveness with long-term product quality and engineering priorities.

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field.
  • 15 years of experience leading software operations, sustaining engineering, technical support, or product lifecycle organizations.
  • Experience with government, defense, or mission-critical software systems
  • Experience supporting sustainment or ILS organizations for integrated hardware and software products.
  • Demonstrated success building operational organizations from the ground up supporting both product and customer delivery teams.
  • Strong systems engineering mindset with experience establishing scalable operational processes.
  • Experience leading cross-functional technical teams through complex customer issues and product improvements.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in AI/ML platforms or autonomous systems
  • Experience with Software Development Kits (SDKs), APIs, or developer platforms.
  • Experience supporting both commercial software products and customized customer solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer, Hardware Test (R5099)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:
At Shield AI, we are revolutionizing defense technology to protect service members and civilians with intelligent, autonomous systems. Our Hardware Test Engineering team plays a critical role in ensuring the V-BAT remains the most reliable, mission-ready UAV in the industry. We design cutting-edge test solutions—custom-built electrical and mechanical systems that push our hardware to its limits in real-world and extreme environments.
 
As a Senior Electrical Engineer on our Hardware Test team, you will own the design and development of test systems that push our hardware to its limits. From designing custom PCBs and automated test sequences to developing electrical and mechanical test stands, you’ll be at the forefront of ensuring the highest reliability in aerospace hardware. This is a high-impact role where your expertise in power electronics, RF, communications, and automation will help shape the future of intelligent defense systems.

What you'll do:

  • Lead the design, validation, and deployment of advanced test systems for V-BAT’s critical components and subsystems.
  • Architect PCBs and test interfaces for power electronics, RF, and communication systems.
  • Develop automated test sequences in Python, ensuring scalability, efficiency, and repeatability.
  • Design and integrate custom test fixtures, including relays, PLCs, PCBAs, and harnessing.
  • Own and drive cross-functional design reviews, advocating for design-for-testability (DFT) improvements.
  • Work hands-on with HASS, ESS, and HALT testing, validating performance in simulated harsh environments.
  • Be a technical mentor, guiding junior engineers and contributing to Shield AI’s growing expertise in hardware test engineering.
  • Other duties as assigned. 

Required qualifications:

  • B.S. in Electrical Engineering or related STEM field.
  • Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience in hardware design and test engineering (or equivalent experience with advanced degrees).
  • Deep expertise in electrical design, mechanical, and software engineering principles as applied to hardware test systems.
  • Proven ability to design, implement, and validate multidisciplinary hardware systems in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment.
  • Track record of ownership—driving projects from concept to execution, delivering exceptional results.
  • A team-first mindset, with high standards for yourself and others, and a passion for solving complex technical challenges. 
  • Track record of working hard, being a trustworthy teammate, holding yourself and others to high standards, and being kind to others. 

Preferred qualifications:

  • Proficiency in Python or another scripting language for test automation.
  • Hands-on experience with PCB design tools (Altium, KiCAD, Eagle) and CAD software (SolidWorks, NX, CATIA).
  • Experience working in rugged, high-reliability industries like aerospace, defense, or automotive.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to pivot quickly in dynamic, evolving environments.

#LC

jobs.descriptionHtml:

Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

We are seeking a Propulsion Performance Engineer to own engine calibration and performance for the reciprocating engines that power the V-BAT platform. This role serves as the technical owner for engine calibration strategy — driving test plans, ECU tuning, and performance analysis from bench through flight test — and is accountable for the torque, power, speed, and fuel efficiency characteristics the engine delivers across its full operating envelope.

You'll work hands-on with engine hardware, electronic fuel injection and engine control systems, and engine test stands, creating and executing engine testing strategies under the direction of senior staff propulsion engineers. Candidates with a background in air-cooled or aviation two-stroke engines are especially encouraged to apply; at minimum, we're looking for someone with deep hands-on experience on reciprocating engines (four-stroke or two-stroke) who can own calibration decisions with minimal oversight. 

What You'll Do In This Role

  • Support the engine calibration strategy by defining test plans, calibration methodology, and acceptance criteria across dynamometer, bench, and flight test campaigns.
  • Perform ECU configuration and tuning (including fuel mapping, ignition timing, and injector phasing) to optimize engine performance, fuel efficiency, and reliability across the operating envelope.
  • Analyze and deliver torque, power, and fuel consumption results, identifying calibration or hardware improvement opportunities and driving corrective action.
  • Lead troubleshooting and root-cause investigations for engine testing for the development team and production teams.
  • Reduce and interpret test and flight data to validate performance against requirements, closing gaps between design intent and measured behavior.
  • Represent engine calibration and performance in design reviews, technical readiness checkpoints, and cross-functional discussions with design, controls, and flight test teams.
  • Develop and maintain calibration documentation, procedures, and performance reporting to support program milestones.
  • Support refinement of performance models for the propulsion system and the vehicle through targeted test campaigns and data review.

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 5+  years of experience in a mechanical or aerospace engineering role, with a focus on engine performance or calibration.
  • Deep hands-on experience with reciprocating (piston) engines.
  • Demonstrated experience with electronically controlled fuel injectors and fuel injection systems.
  • Proven experience with ECU configuration and engine calibration, including ownership of calibration decisions.
  • Strong ability to analyze and interpret engine torque, power, and fuel consumption data to drive engine design, ECU calibration, and vehicle performance decisions.
  • U.S. Citizenship or ability to comply with ITAR requirements.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Podium finish in FSAE competition, with at least one first place trophy in any dynamic event.
  • Background in air-cooled engines, particularly aviation two-stroke platforms.
  • Experience with dynamometer test cells and associated data acquisition systems.
  • Deep familiarity with fuel maps, ignition timing strategies, and closed-loop engine control logic.
  • Proficiency in Python or MATLAB for data reduction and calibration tooling.
  • Experience writing custom data analysis tools to automate engine performance analysis and calibration workflows.
  • Experience supporting military propulsion systems, tactical aircraft, or high-performance aerospace platforms.
  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Automated Test (R4461)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

The Hivemind Software Engineering Integration and Test team is seeking a Senior Automated Test Engineer to design, develop, and scale advanced automated testing and CI/CD infrastructure for our next-generation autonomy platform. You will help develop test frameworks that enable this software ecosystem to create, test and deploy resilient autonomy capabilities for unmanned aircraft and robotic platforms operating in complex, contested, and GPS-denied environments. You will work with a robust suite of autonomy and mission software components, including production flight code, simulation and synthetic environment tooling, mission planning and orchestration systems, operator-facing Ground Control Station (GCS) applications, telemetry and data pipelines, and cloud-native developer infrastructure. 

In this role, you will help ensure the reliability, scalability, and quality of the Hivemind ecosystem through advanced automation, validation infrastructure, and AI-assisted engineering workflows. You will develop automated test frameworks, CI/CD systems, and verification tooling that support distributed autonomy software spanning onboard edge compute, APIs, web-based operator interfaces, simulation environments, and hardware-in-the-loop systems. Working closely with software, autonomy, simulation, and systems engineering teams, you will contribute to a high-assurance development environment focused on mission-critical reliability, rapid iteration, and engineering excellence. The ideal candidate has strong experience in Python-based automation, distributed systems testing, developer tooling, and modern CI/CD practices, along with an interest in autonomy, aerospace, robotics, or safety-critical software systems. Experience leveraging AI-assisted development and intelligent automation tools to accelerate testing, debugging, analytics, and developer productivity is highly valued. 

 

What You'll Do:

    • Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks for Autonomy and UI applications.  

    • Develop scalable automated test infrastructure for functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing across distributed software and hardware environments.  

    • Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitLab using YAML configurations and shell scripting to support automated build, test, and deployment workflows.  

    • Build workflow automation tools and utilities in Python to improve test execution efficiency, reporting, environment setup, and developer productivity.  

    • Develop and maintain UI and API test automation using Go and TypeScript for modern web-based operator interfaces and mission control applications.  

    • Integrate automated testing into continuous integration environments to support rapid software delivery and high reliability standards.  

    • Collaborate closely with software, autonomy, simulation, and systems engineering teams to define verification strategies and improve software quality throughout the development lifecycle.  

    • Develop automated validation solutions for safety-critical and mission-critical aerospace software systems.  

    • Create test harnesses, simulators, stubs, and mocks to support automated verification in both simulated and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) environments.  

    • Analyze test results, troubleshoot failures, and work with development teams to isolate root causes and improve system reliability.  

    • Improve test coverage, execution speed, maintainability, and observability of automated test systems.  

    • Contribute to software quality standards, coding best practices, and automation architecture decisions.  

    • Maintain clear technical documentation for test frameworks, automation workflows, CI/CD infrastructure, and validation procedures.  

    • Support release qualification activities and ensure traceability between requirements, tests, and verification results where applicable.  

    • Represent the Integration and Test Role in design reviews and advocate for a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement.  

    • Develop AI-assisted engineering workflows and analytics tools using modern coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and related LLM-based development platforms to improve test generation, failure triage, debugging, and developer productivity.  

    • Design intelligent automation pipelines that leverage AI-assisted code generation, log analysis, test analysis, and workflow orchestration to accelerate software verification and validation processes.  

    • Evaluate and integrate emerging AI-driven software engineering tools into automated test and CI/CD ecosystems while maintaining reliability, traceability, and engineering quality standards. 

Required Qualifications:

    • 5+ years of experience building scalable, maintainable automation frameworks and/or developer tooling in Python.  

    • 5+ years of experience working with package management, dependency management, and build systems using tools such as conan, pip, setuptools, poetry, and nix or similar. 

    • 5+ years of experience building tooling for automated log collection, analytics, reporting, and failure triage. 

    • Strong understanding of asynchronous and concurrent programming in Python for scalable automation and parallel test execution.  

    • Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI, YAML, and shell scripting.  

    • Experience with automated testing of distributed systems, backend services, APIs, and web-based UIs.  

    • Familiarity with modern test frameworks, automated validation strategies, and software quality methodologies.  

    • Experience working in Linux-based development environments.  

    • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills in complex software systems.  

    • Excellent collaboration and communication skills in cross-functional engineering environments.  

Preferred Qualifications:

    • Experience integrating Python with native C/C++ libraries and applications using bindings, wrappers, subprocess interfaces, or interoperability tooling. 

    • Proficiency with Go and/or TypeScript for automation tooling or UI test development. 

    • Experience with C++ development or testing.  

    • Aerospace, robotics, autonomy, or safety-critical software experience.  

    • Familiarity with simulation, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), or embedded system testing.

Job Description:

Shield AI’s mission is to protect service members and civilians with intelligent systems. We are seeking an Autonomy Software Integration & Test Engineer to support development, integration, testing, and deployment of autonomous systems in Ukraine. 

This role is ideal for a hands-on engineer who enjoys working across software, hardware, aircraft systems, and flight operations in fast-paced field environments. The position combines autonomy software development, system integration, and real-world flight testing across unmanned and autonomous platforms. 

The ideal candidate is comfortable writing and debugging software, integrating autonomy systems onto fixed-wing, multirotor, and other unmanned or autonomous systems, troubleshooting issues in both lab and field environments, and supporting live flight operations under evolving operational conditions. This role requires an engineer who can move fluidly between software development, aircraft integration, flight testing, demonstrations, and operational troubleshooting in a rapidly growing startup environment. 

The ideal candidate demonstrates strong ownership, a bias toward action, and the ability to solve complex problems across software, hardware, and flight operations in rapidly evolving environments. 

This role will primarily support operations in the Lviv region, with occasional travel to other locations within Ukraine for demonstrations, testing, and operational support activities. 

What you'll do:

  • Develop and contribute production-quality software features and capabilities for autonomous systems  
  • Design, implement, debug, and maintain software components supporting autonomy, mission execution, system integration, and flight operations
  • Integrate autonomy software onto fixed-wing, multirotor, and other unmanned or autonomous systems  
  • Develop internal tools, automation, telemetry analysis pipelines, and test infrastructure in C++ and Python
  • Support software bring-up, system configuration, and mission readiness for flight operations  
  • Debug and troubleshoot issues across autonomy software, onboard compute, radios, networking, sensors, flight controllers, and mission systems  
  • Support simulation, SIL, HIL, VIL, ground testing, and live flight test activities  
  • Support field demonstrations and operational test events, including pre-flight setup, system validation, troubleshooting, and post-flight analysis  
  • Operate and troubleshoot Ground Control Stations (GCS) and mission support systems  
  • Capture, analyze, and review flight and system data to support root cause analysis and system improvements  
  • Work closely with autonomy, systems, hardware, and flight test teams to rapidly integrate and validate new capabilities  
  • Support rapid software iteration and operational testing in dynamic startup and field environments  
  • Contribute to operational documentation, test procedures, integration workflows, and deployment readiness activities  
  • Travel to test sites and support field operations as required  

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience  
  • 3+ years of experience developing and integrating software for robotics, autonomy, aerospace, embedded systems, or related technical fields  
  • Strong software engineering experience in C++ and Python, including development, debugging, and system integration  
  • Experience contributing to complex software systems in robotics, autonomy, aerospace, embedded systems, or related domains  
  • Experience working with Linux-based systems and development environments  
  • Hands-on experience integrating and troubleshooting hardware and software systems  
  • Experience supporting field testing, flight testing, demonstrations, or operational exercises  
  • Familiarity with MAVLink, PX4, ArduPilot, QGroundControl, or related unmanned systems technologies  
  • Experience debugging distributed or cross-disciplinary systems involving software, networking, sensors, radios, onboard compute, and mission systems  
  • Strong sense of ownership and ability to operate independently in fast-paced environments  
  • Strong problem-solving mindset and willingness to work across disciplines  
  • Ability to travel within Ukraine as required  

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience supporting autonomous aircraft or unmanned systems  
  • Experience with SIL, HIL, VIL, simulation, or flight test environments  
  • Familiarity with ROS, DDS, embedded systems, or real-time systems  
  • Experience with RF communications, datalinks, and networking systems  
  • Experience supporting live flight demonstrations or operational deployments  
  • Familiarity with flight controllers, avionics systems, and aircraft integration  
  • Experience building internal tools for testing, automation, telemetry analysis, or operational support  
  • Background in defense, robotics, aerospace, or autonomous systems  
  • Ukrainian and English language proficiency  
  • Experience operating in fast-paced and dynamic field environments

#LC

Job Description:

Are you a passionate and innovative thermal engineer looking to help develop state of the art AI and aircraft products? Are you eager to make a positive difference in the world? Do you want to work alongside mission driven and values focused teammates?  Shield AI is just the place for you!

As a Senior Thermal Engineer at Shield AI, you will own  the design, analysis, and integration of aircraft avionics thermal management systems and electronics cooling.

This role is best suited for an engineer who thrives on first-principles problem solving, is comfortable with ambiguous, open-ended challenges, and can communicate well across functions, ensuring well coordinated thermal management solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, C++ Software (R5848)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Senior C++ Software Engineer, Edge Systems to define and build the software foundations that power autonomous systems operating in demanding real-world environments. 

This role sits within the Edge Systems team, where software meets hardware. You will solve complex engineering problems spanning Linux edge computing, imaging, sensor integration, mission systems, and autonomy, building software that runs on real hardware in operational environments rather than laboratory prototypes. 

As a Senior Staff Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across the Edge Systems domain. You will shape architecture and long-term technical direction across multiple teams and products, lead the resolution of complex cross-cutting problems, and establish engineering approaches that improve the effectiveness of the broader organisation. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will continue to design, write, review, test, and debug production software, while focusing your individual contribution on the organisation’s highest-risk and highest-leverage technical problems. 

You will develop modern C++ software for Linux-based edge compute platforms, including NVIDIA Jetson-class and ARM64 systems. Your work will span sensor integration, imaging pipelines, calibration, diagnostics, deployment, developer tooling, and mission-critical applications that demand high performance, reliability, and maintainability. 

This is an application and systems software role focused on Linux-based edge computing, rather than bare-metal firmware or microcontroller development. 

No two weeks look the same. One day you might be optimising image-processing pipelines on embedded GPUs. The next you could be defining architecture for future autonomous platforms, leading the integration of new sensors, or collaborating with AI researchers to bring new capabilities into production. 

You will work alongside highly capable systems, hardware, autonomy, AI, product, and test engineers who enjoy solving difficult problems together. We believe our strongest technical leaders remain hands-on, and we expect our Senior Staff Engineers to continue writing software while multiplying the effectiveness of the engineers around them. 

What you'll do:

    Technical Leadership 

  • Own and evolve the technical direction of significant edge software capabilities spanning edge compute, imaging, sensor integration, and mission systems. 
  • Define architecture and technical strategy across multiple projects, products, and engineering teams. 
  • Lead the resolution of complex, ambiguous, or cross-cutting technical problems where ownership spans organisational boundaries. 
  • Establish reusable platform capabilities, interfaces, standards, and engineering practices adopted by multiple teams. 
  • Provide technical leadership for major design decisions, including their trade-offs, risks, migration strategies, and long-term consequences. 
  • Identify systemic technical risks and drive coordinated action before they materially affect delivery or product reliability. 
  • Mentor senior engineers and develop other technical leaders, increasing the capability and autonomy of the wider organisation. 
  • Partner with engineering, systems, autonomy, AI, product, and program leadership to translate business and product direction into sustainable technical roadmaps. 
  • Balance long-term platform investment, technical debt, operational risk, and near-term product delivery. 
  • Communicate complex technical decisions, strategy, and risks clearly to both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders. 

    • Software Engineering 

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain production C++ software for edge systems, imaging systems, mission applications, developer tooling, diagnostics, and automated testing. 
  • Build user-space Linux applications for NVIDIA Jetson, ARM64, and other edge compute platforms connected to cameras, sensors, and mission systems. 
  • Integrate RGB, NIR, and thermal cameras alongside GPS, IMU, and other sensors using operating system APIs, middleware, vendor SDKs, and hardware-facing interfaces. 
  • Develop calibration, synchronisation, data capture, observability, diagnostics, inspection, and configuration tools for complex sensor systems. 
  • Optimise software for latency, throughput, reliability, power utilisation, and thermal performance on constrained edge compute platforms. 
  • Debug challenging issues spanning application software, Linux, networking, hardware interfaces, timing, deployment, and system integration. 
  • Own technical outcomes for complex, cross-team initiatives from ambiguous problem framing through architecture, implementation, integration, verification, deployment, and sustained operation. 
  • Collaborate across systems, hardware, AI, autonomy, product, and test teams to deliver integrated capability. 

Required qualifications:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience. 
  • Extensive industry experience developing modern C++ software for Linux. 
  • Demonstrated experience developing user-space applications that interface with cameras, sensors, networking, GPUs, storage, or other hardware through operating system APIs, middleware, or vendor SDKs. 
  • Deep practical experience developing, profiling, and debugging software on Linux. 
  • Experience deploying complex C++ software to Linux-based edge compute platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson or comparable ARM64 systems. 
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including concurrency, interface design, memory management, data structures, algorithms, testing, and version control. 
  • Proven ability to diagnose complex issues across software, Linux, networking, timing, hardware integration, and deployment boundaries. 
  • Experience owning complex technical work from incomplete requirements through design, implementation, integration, verification, deployment, and support. 
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across multidisciplinary engineering teams. 

    • Successful Senior Staff Engineer candidates will demonstrate: 

  • A sustained record of defining architecture for large, complex, or mission-critical software systems. 
  • Demonstrated technical influence across multiple teams, products, or engineering disciplines. 
  • Leadership of complex initiatives where success depended on alignment across organisational boundaries. 
  • Proven technical leadership through influence, sound judgement, and credibility rather than organisational authority. 
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and developing other technical leaders. 
  • Ownership of long-term technical strategy alongside hands-on engineering and product delivery. 
  • Evidence of establishing platforms, standards, interfaces, or engineering practices adopted beyond their immediate team. 
  • Strong judgement when balancing performance, reliability, maintainability, scalability, delivery, and operational risk. 
  • The ability to communicate technical strategy, decisions, and risks to senior engineering, product, and business stakeholders. 

Preferred qualifications:

    We do not expect candidates to have all of the following. Experience in any of these areas will help you stand out. 
  • Runtime-critical, multi-threaded, or performance-sensitive C++ software. 
  • High-throughput imaging or sensor-processing pipelines, including camera integration, ISP tuning, GStreamer, FFmpeg, OpenCV, or similar technologies. 
  • Hardware-accelerated processing on edge compute platforms, including NVIDIA Jetson, CUDA, GPU compute, embedded AI accelerators, or accelerated video processing. 
  • Integration of RGB, NIR, and thermal cameras, GPS, IMU, GPUs, or comparable peripheral hardware. 
  • Robotics, aerospace, defence, autonomy, unmanned systems, automotive, or other mission-critical domains. 
  • Systems architecture, interface design, software decomposition, reliability, maintainability, and testability. 
  • Low-level Linux, vendor SDKs, driver-adjacent debugging, NixOS, edge AI inference, containerisation, or application deployment tooling. 
  • Automated testing, simulation, software-in-the-loop, or hardware-in-the-loop environments.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

Job Description:

This role is for a Computer Vision C++ Engineer to support the development of real-time perception capabilities for Shield AI's autonomous systems.

The Computer Vision Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and integrating advanced computer vision algorithms into high-performance C++ software pipelines. The role will focus on building custom perception capabilities from the ground up, with an emphasis on real-time performance, reliability, and deployment in edge compute environments. This position is required to increase the team's capacity and technical depth in real-time computer vision, image processing, and applied machine learning.

The successful candidate will bring strong C++ software engineering skills, experience developing high-performance or real-time systems, and a deep understanding of computer vision fundamentals. They should be capable of translating research concepts into deployable software and comfortable working on bespoke algorithms rather than relying only on existing libraries. Experience with areas such as object detection, image classification, target recognition, semantic segmentation, feature extraction, object tracking, video analytics, dataset curation, model evaluation, or deployment of trained perception models would be highly valuable.

The role will also support the development and integration of learned perception models into real-time computer vision pipelines. This may include adapting detection, classification, recognition, or segmentation models for operational imagery; improving model performance across varied lighting, viewpoint, background, and environmental conditions; evaluating false positives and false negatives; and working with representative datasets to improve robustness. Familiarity with combining learned models with classical computer vision techniques, optimizing inference for edge deployment, and integrating model outputs into C++ perception systems would be beneficial. Candidates with a Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Robotics, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, or a related field would be well aligned with the technical needs of the team, though strong applied industry experience is also highly relevant.

Required qualifications:

  • Degree in Computer Vision, Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field.
  • Deep proficiency in C++, with proven experience developing software in high-performance, real-time environments.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing custom computer vision algorithms from scratch, rather than exclusively applying existing libraries.
  • Solid foundational understanding of computer vision, image processing, and machine learning principles.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, performance optimization, and version control.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to serve as the electrical SME for the V-BAT Fleet Support team. In this role, you will own customer-facing engineering support for aircraft electrical issues across the fielded fleet. You will act as the bridge between Fleet Support and the avionics, electrical, software, and systems engineering teams to resolve complex technical problems quickly and thoroughly.

This role is best suited for an engineer with strong avionics and aircraft electrical troubleshooting experience who can move fluidly between schematic-level analysis, hardware debug, and field support.

What you'll do:

  • Serve as the electrical SME for Fleet Support and lead escalated investigations involving aircraft electrical and avionics issues.
  • Diagnose avionics system issues, onboard communication hardware issues, wiring and harness problems, power-distribution faults, connector failures, grounding issues, and intermittent electrical anomalies.
  • Troubleshoot aircraft electrical problems at the aircraft, subsystem, harness, connector, and line-replaceable unit levels.
  • Review and maintain schematics, pinouts, wiring diagrams, interface definitions, and troubleshooting documentation used by Fleet Support and customer teams.
  • Use standard debug equipment to isolate faults, validate corrective actions, and support return-to-service decisions.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Engineering Tooling & Observability to build the tools that help engineers develop, understand, and diagnose complex software systems. 

You will work close to the systems our engineers are building, developing tooling that makes those systems easier to understand and work with. This includes C++ and Python applications, developer-facing observability, web services, React-based user interfaces, visualisations, and engineering workflows. 

A major focus of the role is developer-facing observability. Bringing together logs, telemetry, events, faults, and system state so engineers can quickly move from "something went wrong" to "I understand what happened and where to investigate." 

You will be comfortable working within complex C++ software systems and understanding how they behave, while looking for opportunities to turn that understanding into better tools for other engineers. This could mean understanding how a component exposes diagnostic information, building services that aggregate it, or designing how that information should be presented to an engineer investigating a problem. 

The role sits at the intersection of systems software, developer experience, observability, and engineering tooling. We treat internal tooling as a product. Usability, reliability, maintainability, performance, and the experience of the engineers using it all matter. 

Our scope is focused on internal tooling products, Developer Experience, engineering-facing web services, UI/UX for system tooling, and licensing services. This is not a general DevOps or CI/CD engineering role. CI/CD platforms, build and release automation, pipeline infrastructure, build performance, and test execution pipelines sit outside the team's scope. 

What you'll do:

    As a contributor to the Australian Engineering group, you will be responsible for:
  • Design, build, and maintain engineering tools that help developers understand and diagnose complex software systems.
  • Build tooling that brings together logs, telemetry, events, faults, diagnostics, and system state to make system behaviour easier to investigate.
  • Build C++ and Python applications, libraries, services, and integrations that interact with complex onboard and distributed software systems.
  • Create tools that correlate information across software components, processes, and machines to help engineers understand what happened and where to investigate.
  • Build user interfaces and interactive visualisations using React and modern web technologies to explore system behaviour and engineering data.
  • Design effective workflows for debugging, fault investigation, system introspection, and engineering analysis.
  • Develop APIs and web services that support engineering tooling products and expose system data in useful ways.
  • Improve the Developer Experience (DX) of working with complex systems by identifying engineering friction and turning it into effective tooling.
  • Work directly with software, autonomy, systems, and test engineers to identify high-value problems and develop practical solutions.
  • Treat internal tooling as a product, incorporating feedback from engineers and continuously improving usability and effectiveness.
  • Establish reusable UI components, UX patterns, libraries, and engineering standards for system tooling.
  • Contribute to the architecture and technical direction of the Engineering Tooling capability.

Required qualifications:

  • Strong software engineering experience with modern C++, ideally C++17/20 or later.
  • Strong Python development experience.
  • Experience debugging and reasoning about complex, concurrent, distributed, or component-based software systems.
  • Experience designing and maintaining production-quality software, libraries, services, APIs, or applications.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and the ability to navigate and reason about large codebases.
  • Experience building tools for software engineers or other technical users.
  • Experience working with logs, telemetry, metrics, events, traces, faults, or other diagnostic data.
  • Ability to reason about behaviour across multiple software components and correlate information from different sources.
  • Strong Linux development and debugging skills.
  • Experience designing APIs, services, and software interfaces.
  • Ability to independently identify engineering problems worth solving and turn ambiguous needs into practical, reliable tooling.
  • Ability to make sound architectural decisions and collaborate effectively across engineering teams.
  • Strong software engineering practices, including testing, code review, maintainability, documentation, and performance awareness.
  • A product mindset toward internal engineering tools, with attention to usability and developer experience.
    •  
     
    Nice to Have
  • Experience with React, TypeScript, and modern web application development.
  • Experience with robotics, autonomous systems, embedded systems, or other complex physical systems.
  • Experience with interactive data visualisation and presenting complex engineering data effectively.
  • Experience with time-series, event, telemetry, or other high-volume engineering data systems.
  • Experience with distributed systems and messaging architectures.
  • Systems programming experience, including networking, IPC, and communication protocols.
  • Experience designing UI/UX for technical or engineering applications.
  • Experience developing desktop engineering applications.
  • Experience analysing large-scale telemetry or diagnostic datasets.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

Are you a passionate and innovative engineer looking to help develop state-of-the-art AI and robotics products? Are you eager to make a positive difference in the world? Do you want to work alongside mission-driven and values-focused teammates? Shield AI is just the place for you!

The Hivemind Quality team is committed to ensuring our autonomy platform delivers reliable, mission-ready capabilities through rigorous integration, validation, and flight testing. We work closely with autonomy, platform, and hardware teams to validate new features in simulation, hardware-in-the-loop, and real-world flight environments, ensuring our customers can confidently deploy autonomous systems in demanding operational conditions.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Flight Test Engineer passionate about autonomy development and system validation. In this role, you will develop and execute comprehensive flight test strategies that validate autonomous behaviors, software integrations, and end-to-end system performance. You will work closely with software, hardware, and product teams to reproduce real-world mission scenarios, identify product issues, and improve the quality and reliability of the Hivemind platform. You are responsible for determining test readiness, directing test conduct, managing risk, and ensuring data-driven decisions throughout development and flight test operations. 

What you'll do:

    • Lead system-level integration and flight test campaigns for Hivemind Mission Autonomy across small UAS and external platforms. 

    • Develop and execute test strategies, plans, scenarios, and success criteria that validate autonomy capabilities, software integrations, system performance, and operational customer workflows. 

    • Own test readiness and phase-gate decisions across simulation, SIL, HIL, ground, and flight testing, including entry and exit criteria, configuration control, and objective prioritization. 

    • Plan, direct, and execute fly–fix–fly campaigns, coordinating cross-functional engineering teams and test operators to enable rapid, disciplined iteration. 

    • Approve test procedures, test cards, and execution plans; lead risk assessments, hazard analyses, and mitigation planning while serving as the final authority during test conduct. 

    • Define and maintain test infrastructure, including simulation environments, flight assets, hardware configurations, multi-agent systems, and automated test pipelines. 

    • Analyze flight logs, telemetry, rosbags, and system data to identify defects, determine root causes, document anomalies and corrective actions, and ensure results are traceable to requirements and mission outcomes. 

    • Serve as the primary test interface to leadership, customers, and external stakeholders while establishing SOPs, reporting test progress and risk, and advancing industry test practices. 

Required qualifications:

    • Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 4 years and a Master's degree; or equivalent work experience. 

    • Experience in system integration and test, including SIL, HIL, simulation, and flight test environments 

    • Highly organized and methodical, with the ability to manage complex, fast-paced test campaigns 

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills for safety-of-flight processes, hazard analysis, and configuration control in flight test environments 

    • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze flight logs, telemetry, and system behavior to identify root causes. 

    • Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across software, hardware, product, and test organizations. 

    • FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate (or the ability to obtain one within a reasonable timeframe). 

Preferred qualifications:

    • Familiarity with networking, Linux operating systems, and radio communications. 

    • Experience with hardware design selection and 3D prototyping 

    • Experience with modern software interfaces such as Codex and GitLab 

    • Experience with open-source flight controller software and sensor integration 

    • Experience with debugging autonomy subsystems through ROS logs 

    • Experience developing automated test tooling, validation frameworks, or data analysis tools in CI/CD pipelines

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

About Shield AI:

Shield AI is a defense technology company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. We build autonomy systems for air, maritime, space, and other platforms operating in complex and contested environments. 

Forge is the engineering platform used to build, integrate, test, and operate Hivemind capabilities. It connects autonomy developers with the applications, services, compute, data, and workflows they need to move from local development to deployed systems. 

 

Job Description:

We are looking for a full-stack engineer interested in customer-facing products, developer tools, and AI-assisted workflows. You will partner with internal subject-matter experts to build an extensible application platform and complete applications on it. 

Shield AI’s Hivemind developers are the platform’s primary design partners and proving ground. Forge is also designed for external engineering teams to adopt, extend, and integrate into their own environments. 

You will help evolve Forge into an integrated engineering environment with shared foundations for APIs, user interfaces, extensions, model integrations, and agent tools. Working across frontend architecture, backend services, platform contracts, and deployment, you will validate the platform through real workflows. Your work will help engineers understand complex systems, develop autonomy software, investigate failures, and deliver reliable capabilities faster. 

What you'll do:

  • Build and operate a full-stack platform embedded in the workflows used to train, validate, and deploy the AI Pilot. 
  • Design a composable UI architecture that lets applications contribute widgets, dashboards, commands, and shared resource context. 
  • Define typed, versioned contracts between the platform and independently developed Forge applications. 
  • Create workflows for teams to package, publish, configure, install, upgrade, and disable applications. 
  • Enable Forge’s native AI experiences and external agent harnesses to understand active context, invoke authorized tools, navigate applications, and compose dashboards. 
  • Deliver consistent application behavior across local-development and remote-cluster environments. 
  • Partner with simulation, autonomy, and ML subject-matter experts to build initial applications, validate the platform against real workflows, and incorporate what you learn. 
  • Work across infrastructure, security, product, and design to shape the platform’s architecture and engineering practices. 

Key outcomes:

    A successful engineer in this role will help deliver the following outcomes: 
  • Applications behave consistently across local-development and remote-cluster environments, even when their deployment and service lifecycles differ. 
  • Application developers can move quickly using clear contracts, examples, documentation, and authoring guides. 
  • Hivemind teams can develop, integrate, test, and diagnose autonomy capabilities more quickly using Forge applications and platform services. 
  • Users can combine applications, tools, and shared context into persistent workflows tailored to their needs and share those workflows within their organization. 
  • Internal teams and external customers can build integrated Forge applications that extend these workflows without modifying the core platform. 
  • Forge’s embedded AI and external agent harnesses can explore and operate the same catalog of platform tools through shared contracts. 

Required qualifications:

  • Experience owning production full-stack applications from design and implementation through rollout and support. 
  • Strong proficiency with TypeScript and React or an equivalent modern web stack. 
  • Experience building production backend services in Go, Python, Rust, or a comparable language. 
  • Experience designing typed, versioned APIs and contracts between independently deployed components. 
  • Strong knowledge of web and distributed-system architecture, including state management, routing, asynchronous communication, browser security, authentication, authorization, and failure handling. 
  • Ability to build intuitive technical tools for engineers and test them at the unit, integration, and system levels. 
  • Sound judgment about when to extend an existing system, introduce an abstraction, or keep a solution intentionally small. 
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to work across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and product disciplines. 

Preferred qualifications:

    Experience owning production full-stack applications from design and implementation through rollout and support. 
  • Strong proficiency with TypeScript and React or an equivalent modern web stack. 
  • Experience building production backend services in Go, Python, Rust, or a comparable language. 
  • Experience designing typed, versioned APIs and contracts between independently deployed components. 
  • Strong knowledge of web and distributed-system architecture, including state management, routing, asynchronous communication, browser security, authentication, authorization, and failure handling. 
  • Ability to build intuitive technical tools for engineers and test them at the unit, integration, and system levels. 
  • Sound judgment about when to extend an existing system, introduce an abstraction, or keep a solution intentionally small. 
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to work across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and product disciplines. 

Why join us:

  • Connect your work directly to the mission. The platform and applications you build help engineers develop, validate, and deliver the autonomy software behind Hivemind. 
  • Define human-and-agent workflows. Design how engineers and AI agents use the same platform tools while preserving user control, security, and accountability. 
  • Own complete workflows. Work across user experience, frontend architecture, backend services, APIs, deployment, and operations. 
  • Build alongside engaged users. Partner with engineers solving autonomy, simulation, data, and infrastructure problems, and see the direct effect of your decisions.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, HMS Simulation Framework (R6058)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

As a Simulation Framework Engineer on the Simulation Framework Team, you will write the C++ and Python code, design adapters, and build custom plugins for our modeling and simulation (M&S) environments and core autonomy software. Your work is hands-on and technical, creating reusable, robust software patterns that abstract simulation details away from the core autonomy stack. Integration teams own program-level software integration; this role partners with and supports those teams by diagnosing framework, plugin, and interface issues in the simulation software the team designs and maintains.

You will write simulation plugins and software layers for DoD-recognized simulation backends including NGTS, AFSIM, Aechelon, HMSSimBlocks, and the emerging Hivemind Simulation Framework (HMSF). Rather than managing teams, you will focus on the hands-on execution of migrating HMSSimBlocks capabilities to HMSF—building baseline adapters, porting custom modules, and ensuring functional parity—while maintaining active support and backward compatibility for programs currently relying on HMSSimBlocks.

What you'll do:

  • Write, compile, and maintain baseline software adapters, plugins, and interfaces in C++ and Python for AFSIM, NGTS, Aechelon, HMSSimBlocks, and HMSF.
  • Execute the hands-on technical migration from HMSSimBlocks to HMSF, porting custom HMS simulation features to HMSF while maintaining active support for legacy HMSSimBlocks users.
  • Design, implement, and maintain a reusable CIGI plugin layer across our simulation frameworks to enable seamless visual communication with Aechelon image generators.
  • Ensure simulation frameworks and baseline plugins are designed for extensibility, writing clear templates and code architectures that allow other portfolios to plug in custom sensors or models.
  • Maintain functional parity across simulation plugins with respect to CSF (Common Scenario Format) file loading, DDS communication capabilities, GRID interface standards, and Hivemind SDK updates.
  • Support integration teams in debugging complex simulation-autonomy issues by analyzing framework behavior, network data, DDS traffic, and API call-stacks.
  • Write robust unit tests, automated integration tests, and clear code documentation to ensure simulation stability.

Required qualifications:

  • Typically requires a Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong software development background in C++ and Python within a Linux environment.
  • Solid software engineering fundamentals, including version control (Git), automated testing, and disciplined debugging.
  • Experience writing or maintaining plugins, baseline interfaces, or modeling frameworks for simulation environments such as AFSIM, NGTS, or similar.
  • Familiarity with network protocols (UDP/TCP), DDS middleware, serialization, or interface standards (such as CIGI).
  • Excellent technical troubleshooting skills and a desire to help other developers resolve integration bugs.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain an active U.S. SECRET security clearance (U.S. citizenship required).

Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

The Human Machine Teaming (HMT) Group at Shield AI is hiring an Engineer II or Senior Engineer to join our HMT Experimentation capability. At Shield AI, HMT refers to the design, management, and assurance of the adaptive relationships between operators and Hivemind-enabled mission autonomy—not just an interface problem, or a function-allocation exercise.

Working alongside the HMT Experimentation Lead, who owns HMT experimentation, research, and assessment, you will assist in establishing the HMT Experimentation Lab and help run the applied research and development (R&D) program behind our HMT design decisions. You will test whether collaborative work requirement profiles—the adaptive relationships—hold in practice, and conduct robustness testing that establishes where teaming works, degrades, and approaches failure.

If rigorous applied HMT-specific experimentation on in-development and fielded autonomous systems is what you want, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.

What you'll do:

  • Design and run HMT experiments that instantiate baseline and context-sensitive collaborative work requirements profiles and test whether these hold under varied conditions.
  • Conduct robustness and resilience testing, perturbing, for instance, communications, sensor data, autonomy behavior, workload, and time pressure to find the limits of teaming.
  • Characterize the context sensitivity of requirements profiles across environments, platforms, and operator populations.
  • Extend operator-in-the-loop (OITL) and live-virtual-constructive (LVC) testing with HMT-specific experimentation.
  • Define HMT-specific quantitative and qualitative measures of performance, effectiveness, and success, build assessment batteries for operator situation awareness, workload, decision making, calibration, reliance, and trust, prepare research protocols, and analyze human-machine system data.
  • Translate findings into prioritized recommendations, revisions to requirements profiles, and feature requests for Development Leads, and co-create a shared HMT body of knowledge.
  • Contribute evidence to the HMT maturity scale, risk assessment, and the Hivemind assurance case, and report results to engineering and customer audiences.
  • Travel to company, test, demonstration, and customer locations to conduct project work (approximately 25%).

Required qualifications:

  • Engineer II: typically requires a minimum of 2 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 0 years and a Master's degree; or a PhD without experience. Senior Engineer: typically requires a minimum of 3–5 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 2–4 years and a Master's degree; or 2 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience.
  • A degree in human factors engineering or psychology, cognitive systems engineering, applied cognitive science, industrial and systems engineering, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of human machine teaming, human factors, and human performance theory and measurement, including cognitive task analysis and knowledge elicitation.
  • Sound grasp of quasi-/experimental design, between- and within-participant designs, and control of extraneous confounds, experience conducting human participants research, proficiency with multivariate statistical analyses and tools (e.g., SPSS, R, Python), and ability to translate results into design recommendations.
  • Experience in multidisciplinary settings, and ability to work in complex, ambiguous problem spaces and produce clear and structured artifacts.
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, and written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience with human machine teaming, MUM-T, human-robot interaction, or applied artificial intelligence, specifically in mission autonomy applications such as UAV Groups 1–5.
  • Experience with developmental or operational test and evaluation, including OITL and LVC testing.
  • Experience in scenario design, and with modeling and simulation tools and methods.
  • Familiarity with trust and reliance measurement and experience with robustness, resilience, or degraded and off-nominal scenario testing.
  • Experience with mission planning, C2, and battle management concepts, processes, and doctrine, and with ground control stations or HMIs.
  • Familiarity with traceability methods, or with AI assurance frameworks.
  • Willingness to use agentic AI to speed the path from design concept to fielded product.
  • Prior work with military operators, pilots, or subject matter experts, or an aircrew background.
  • U.S. DoD Secret clearance eligible, with the ability to obtain and maintain Top Secret, SCI, and/or SAP-level access. U.S. citizenship required.

Job Description:

The Human Machine Teaming (HMT) Group at Shield AI is hiring an Engineer II or Senior Engineer to join our HMT Design capability. At Shield AI, HMT refers to the design, management, and assurance of the adaptive relationships between operators and Hivemind-enabled mission autonomy—not just an interface problem, or a function-allocation exercise. Across industry, HMT is often an ad hoc practice, staffed with HMI/UX/UI rather than HMT specialists. In this role, you will implement a systematic, standardized, yet context-sensitive approach to HMT design that is both scalable and traceable in practice.

Working alongside the HMT Design Lead, who owns the collaborative work requirement profile generation process, you will determine HMT-specific requirements across use cases, identify contextual factors that moderate requirements, and translate baselines into context-sensitive design patterns that support adaptivity. You will work with other HMT capabilities to design scenarios, refine testing procedures, and generate HMI feature requests that improve collaboration.

If you want to define how an entire company designs operator-autonomy relationships rather than one interface at a time, this is your opportunity to make a lasting and scalable impact.

What you'll do:

  • Build and maintain baseline collaborative work requirement profiles for core operational functions, and generate profile variants for edge and off-nominal cases.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Manufacturing Engineer to lead the development, implementation, and optimization of manufacturing processes for advanced aerospace systems. In this role, you will own one or more aircraft systems throughout the product lifecycle, partnering with Design Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, and Program Management to transition products from development into production. 

You will play a key role in prototype builds, new product introduction (NPI), production readiness, and production ramp-up while driving improvements in manufacturability, quality, throughput, and cost. This position may support aircraft structures, electrical systems, propulsion, mechanical systems, avionics, final integration, ground support equipment, or other complex aerospace assemblies. 

What you'll do:

    • Lead manufacturing engineering activities for assigned aircraft systems from prototype development through full-rate production. 

    • Develop, implement, and optimize manufacturing processes, production methods, and assembly sequences to improve safety, quality, cost, and throughput.  

    • Design and validate assembly tooling, fixtures, jigs, and manufacturing aids to support efficient and repeatable production.  

    • Develop and maintain work instructions, manufacturing process documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and manufacturing specifications.  

    • Partner with Design Engineering to influence product designs through Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFM/DFA) and support engineering change implementation.  

    • Lead prototype builds, production readiness activities, first article inspections, and new product introductions.  

    • Troubleshoot manufacturing issues using structured root cause analysis and implement effective corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).  

    • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on manufacturing efficiency, quality, ergonomics, safety, and production capacity.  

    • Collaborate closely with Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, and Program Management to achieve program objectives.  

    • Support supplier manufacturing readiness, process validation, and qualification activities as required.  

    • Utilize CAD software to develop tooling concepts, manufacturing aids, and production support equipment.  

    • Mentor Associate and Manufacturing Engineers while promoting engineering best practices and manufacturing standards.  

    • Support production planning, capacity planning, and manufacturing strategy for future production growth.  

Required qualifications:

    • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.  

    • 5+ years of manufacturing engineering experience supporting complex aerospace, defense, automotive, robotics, or advanced manufacturing products.  

    • Experience developing manufacturing processes, tooling, and production methods for complex assemblies.  

    • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes such as machining, composites, electrical assemblies, precision mechanical assemblies, or final system integration.  

    • Proficiency with CAD software such as CATIA, Siemens NX, SolidWorks, Creo, or equivalent.  

    • Strong understanding of engineering drawings, GD&T, tolerance analysis, and manufacturing documentation.  

    • Experience supporting prototype builds, production ramp-up, and New Product Introduction (NPI).  

    • Working knowledge of Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFM/DFA) principles.  

    • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis skills.  

    • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional technical initiatives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.  

Preferred qualifications:

    • Experience supporting military, commercial aerospace, defense, automotive, or advanced manufacturing programs.  

    • Experience with AS9100, ISO 9001, or other regulated manufacturing environments.  

    • Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Value Stream Mapping (VSM), and continuous improvement methodologies.  

    • Experience with ERP, MES, PLM, or digital manufacturing systems.  

    • Experience with automated manufacturing equipment, robotics, or advanced production technologies.  

    • Previous experience mentoring engineers or leading technical projects.
