Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Senior Manager, Mechanisms Engineering to support the development of mechanisms for our next-generation autonomous aircraft program. As a contributor on the Launch and Recovery Vehicle team you will lead the design and development of high-performance mechanisms from concept through production release. In this role, you’ll lead and contribute to the development of complex, mission-critical technologies while guiding a talented team to deliver at a high level. Blending hands-on technical work with leadership, you’ll help drive innovation, solve challenging problems, and bring cutting-edge systems from concept to reality.

What you'll do:

    Functional Excellence:

  • Directly contribute to the design, analysis, and integration of mechanical systems and subsystems for X-BAT Launch and Recovery Vehicle.
  • Establish and improve pragmatic mechanical engineering standards, templates, specifications, and best practices that increase design quality, reduce rework, and enable faster iteration.
  • Own mechanical engineering deliverables across the product lifecycle—from early concept and prototyping through test, production, and field support—with a bias toward execution and delivery.
  • Own failure mode analysis and reliability modeling for mechanical systems, establish lightweight, repeatable practices (e.g., FMEA, fault trees) that proactively identify risks, reduce field failures, and inform design tradeoffs.
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Program Management, and Flight Operations to ensure designs are buildable, testable, and reliable in real-world environments.
  • Provide hands-on technical support during ground and flight testing, demos, and field operations; rapidly troubleshoot and implement design fixes under tight timelines.

    • Team Leadership and Development:

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of mechanical engineers, providing technical guidance, regular feedback, and clear expectations for ownership and execution.
  • Recruit and hire experienced mechanical engineers to strengthen team capability, elevate technical standards, and improve mentorship depth.
  • Act as a player-coach: balance meaningful individual technical contribution with team leadership, design reviews, and day-to-day unblock of engineers.
  • Establish team norms around accountability, decision-making speed, and engineering rigor—ensuring high-quality output without slowing momentum.
  • Set clear priorities aligned with program goals; actively manage team bandwidth, identify risks early, and communicate tradeoffs to leadership.
  • Drive clear and concise technical communication, ensuring design decisions, assumptions, and tradeoffs are well-documented and understood across functions.

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in mechanical design for aerospace, ground support equipment, or related ruggedized hardware systems.
  • 3+ years of leadership/manger with demonstrated excellence in building, retaining, and leading a high performing engineering team
  • Proficiency in 3D CAD software (NX preferred) with demonstrated ability to create detailed GD&T-compliant component and assembly 3D models and drawings.
  • Proficiency in developing drawing templates/standards, and design/manufacturing specifications. 
  • Familiarity with industry standards (ASME, ISO, ASTM, or industry-specific regulatory requirements).
  • Experience with engineering analysis methods (FEA, stress, thermal, tolerance stack-up, fatigue, fluid flow as applicable) to validate design integrity.
  • Ownership of 2–3 full product development cycles from concept through release to production to on-going customer sustainment.
  • Cross-functional collaboration experience with other Engineering Functions, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Program Management, and Field Operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-ownership development environment with evolving priorities
  • Strong written and verbal technical communication skills.
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

Preferred qualifications:

  • M.S. degree in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering.
  • Experience supporting UAV, DoD, or aerospace full vehicle programs.
  • Familiarity with aerospace standards (MIL-STD, ASME Y14.5, FAA).
  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes (machining, sheet metal, injection molding, casting, additive manufacturing) and ability to design for manufacturability (DFM)
  • Knowledge of reliability modeling and analysis methods.
  • Experience using FEA tools (ANSYS, Abaqus, NASTRAN, or similar) for linear structural analysis.

Shield AI is pushing the envelope by applying advanced AI solutions to real hardware systems. An ideal candidate should aspire to be a part of this industry-changing team developing and deploying advanced technology that can truly make an impact. 
 
We are seeking a skilled and motivated leaders with 10+ years of experience to manage a technical team supporting the development, integration, and testing of perception algorithms for advanced aerospace, defense, and robotics systems. The Senior Manager of Quality will build and lead a multidisciplinary quality team while implementing scalable quality systems, risk management processes, problem-solving disciplines, and development quality practices appropriate for a rapidly growing aerospace and defense technology organization.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Revenue Accounting (R5481)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking an ambitious, experienced Senior Manager, Revenue Accounting to join our growing Accounting team at one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Defense & Aerospace. This role will lead the end-to-end revenue accounting process, including technical revenue accounting, operational revenue accounting, contract review, monthly close activities, and order-to-cash process design. The Senior Manager will serve as a key revenue accounting leader and cross-functional partner to Legal, Business Development, Revenue Operations, Program Finance, Billing, Collections, and FP&A to ensure revenue is recognized accurately, timely, and in accordance with ASC 606. This role will also help design and scale revenue accounting processes, controls, systems, and workflows to support Shield AI’s continued international growth.

What you'll do:

  • Lead the end-to-end revenue accounting process, including customer contract review, revenue recognition conclusions, monthly revenue close activities, and operational execution in accordance with ASC 606.
  • Review revenue-related account reconciliations, including deferred revenue, unbilled receivables, contract assets, contract liabilities, accounts receivable, and other order-to-cash related balances.
  • Manage and lead the preparation, review, and approval of customer contracts, ensuring appropriate revenue recognition while partnering with Sales, Legal, Business Development, Revenue Operations, and Program Finance on deal structure, contractual terms, and revenue guidance implementation.
  • Serve as one of the company’s subject matter experts on ASC 606, providing technical accounting guidance on complex revenue arrangements, non-standard contract terms, variable consideration, contract modifications, performance obligations, and other revenue recognition matters.
  • Own and evolve revenue accounting policies, including SSP analyses, allocation methodologies, and revenue recognition positions as new products, pricing models, geographies, and contract structures are introduced.
  • Design, document, and improve order-to-cash processes to ensure accuracy, scalability, operational efficiency, and strong internal controls across contract review, billing, revenue recognition, collections handoffs, and reporting.
  • Identify process gaps, control risks, and system limitations within the revenue accounting and order-to-cash lifecycle, and lead initiatives to improve process quality, automation, scalability, and audit readiness.
  • Support internal and external audits by preparing and reviewing audit schedules, responding to technical accounting inquiries, and ensuring revenue accounting documentation is complete, accurate, and well-controlled.
  • Mentor and develop revenue accounting team members, providing coaching, review, prioritization, and guidance to support team growth and operational excellence.

Required qualifications:

  • 8+ years of relevant accounting experience, including significant experience in technical revenue accounting under ASC 606 and/or IFRS 15.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA preferred.
  • Strong revenue recognition experience, including experience reviewing complex customer contracts and assessing accounting conclusions under ASC 606.
  • Experience leading or managing revenue accounting close activities, including review of journal entries, account reconciliations, and revenue-related balance sheet accounts.
  • Deep understanding of order-to-cash processes and how technical accounting decisions impact billing, collections, revenue recognition, reporting, and controls.
  • Experience designing, improving, or scaling revenue accounting and order-to-cash processes in a high-growth or complex business environment.
  • Experience with revenue recognition, ERP, CRM, and/or order-to-cash systems, such as Salesforce or equivalent tools.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex technical accounting issues into clear, actionable guidance for cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Legal, Sales, Business Development, Revenue Operations, Billing, Collections, Program Finance, FP&A, Systems, and external auditors.
  • Strong understanding of internal controls, audit requirements, and SOX compliance protocols.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance technical accounting rigor with operational practicality and business partnership.
  • Data-driven mindset with a proactive approach to process improvement, automation, and scalable operations.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Big 4 public accounting experience preferred.
  • Public company experience preferred.
  • Experience with international expansion, including EMEA revenue accounting considerations.
  • Experience in high-growth technology, SaaS, PaaS, Defense, Aerospace, manufacturing, or complex contract environments.
  • Experience with long-term contracts, milestone billing, project-based revenue recognition, government contracts, or complex commercial arrangements.
  • Experience implementing or optimizing revenue recognition, billing, ERP, CRM, or order-to-cash systems.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

As the Senior Manager of Software Test, you will lead the verification and validation of autonomy, mission-oriented, avionics software for Shield AI’s next-gen aircraft systems. These platforms demand the highest levels of system integrity, operational reliability, and test rigor. Your role will center around designing scalable, automated test infrastructure, validating mission-critical behaviors across simulation and real aircraft environments, and enabling rapid, safe deployment of software to flight operations. You’ll partner closely with engineering, product, and flight test teams to ensure the system is testable, traceable, and always ready for mission.  
  
This role focuses on accelerating software maturity and validation through rigorous, automated, and traceable testing practices for the VBAT platform.  

What you'll do:

  • Build a world class software and system test infrastructure for rapid software deployments   
  • Own end-to-end system test strategy for software-in-the-loop (SIL), hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and vehicle-in-the-loop (VIL) environments—scaling them for continuous integration and rapid release cycles.  
  • Design and implement mission-critical system test cases validating autonomous behaviors, requirements compliance, and operational edge cases across nominal, safety-critical, and degraded conditions.  
  • Coordinate and execute flight test and software release campaigns, working cross-functionally with autonomy, embedded systems, flight ops, and safety engineering teams.

Required qualifications:

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or related field 
  • 8+ years of experience in software testing, systems testing, or verification & validation for complex, safety-critical or mission-critical systems (autonomy, aerospace, defense, robotics, UAVs, etc.) 
  • 3+ years of experience leading teams, including some experience managing other managers 
  • Strong proficiency in test automation, scripting, data analysis, and test infrastructure development 
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated test frameworks (SIL, HIL, VIL, CI/CD pipelines) 
  • Experience validating autonomous behaviors or distributed real-time systems 
  • Deep understanding of software verification methodologies, including requirements traceability, test planning, and regression testing 
  • Experience with hardware-in-the-loop testbeds, embedded systems, or avionics integration 
  • Ability to design system-level test cases including edge cases, degraded modes, and safety-critical scenarios 
  • Strong ability to work cross-functionally with autonomy, avionics, embedded, and flight ops teams 
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills, especially around test plans, procedures, and safety considerations

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience testing unmanned aircraft systems (UAS), rotorcraft, or airborne mission systems 
  • Knowledge of DO-178C, MIL-STD-882, STANAG, or other safety/airworthiness frameworks 
  • Experience with simulation tools (Gazebo, Isaac, ROS/ROS2 simulation, custom autonomy sims, etc.) 
  • Experience with continuous integration systems (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Buildkite, etc.) 
  • Knowledge of autonomy algorithms (navigation, planning, perception) sufficient to design adversarial or mission-based test scenarios 
  • Comfort operating in dynamic R&D environments where rapid iteration and tight feedback loops are the norm

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Strategic Finance (R5566)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

We build advanced autonomous systems for defense markets—complex hardware and software products that demand world-class financial modeling, rigorous strategic analysis, and the ability to turn complexity into clarity.

We seek a Senior Strategic Finance Lead with deep Aerospace & Defense (A&D) experience, a strong strategic or corporate finance background in a publicly traded company, and a proven track record architecting and owning long-range financial models. You will serve as the analytical engine of Corporate Finance: designing the company’s fully integrated long-range three‑statement and unit economics model, driving enterprise-level financial strategy, and producing investor-grade outputs that shape decisions at the C-suite, Board, and ultimately public investors.

Candidates must bring elite modeling expertise (IB/PE/HF/Equity Research), mastery of complex HW/SW unit economics, and comfort operating in a fast-paced, high‑growth environment.

What you'll do:

    Own and Build the Strategic Financial Model

  • Architect and maintain a fully integrated, scalable, three‑statement model grounded in unit economics, operational drivers, and industry benchmarks.
  • Lead the Long Range Plan (LRP), including scenario modeling, sensitivities, and valuation frameworks.
  • Translate production ramps, R&D investments, contract timing, government milestones, and GTM strategy directly into financial outcomes.
  • Deliver investor-grade outputs including valuations, strategic insights, and Board-ready narratives.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of risks, opportunities, capital needs, and strategic inflection points.

    • Digitize & Scale Modeling Infrastructure

  • Partner with data engineering/systems teams to evolve modeling from Excel into modern cloud-based planning tools.
  • Design modular, scalable model architectures; use Excel only where it provides meaningful analytical leverage.
  • Integrate automation and analytics to improve clarity, reduce manual work, and increase decision velocity.

    • Analyze the Business Like an Investor

  • Benchmark peers across defense, autonomy, robotics, aerospace, and industrial tech.
  • Build competitor profiles, KPI benchmarks, and market analyses that inform strategy.
  • Develop a point of view on unit economics, efficiency, scale, profitability, and capital allocation.
  • Support M&A modeling, valuation, synergy analysis, and diligence.
  • Provide strategic insights that go beyond the numbers.

    • Lead Cash Flow & Liquidity Modeling

  • Build rolling cash flow forecasts across working capital, inventory, milestone payments, production cycles, and CapEx.
  • Model government contract payment timing, production curves, and program cash profiles.
  • Identify liquidity risks early and support capital allocation and financing strategies.

    • Partner Across the Company

  • Work closely with the VP FP&A, CFO, CEO, and senior leaders on forward-looking financial strategy.
  • Translate engineering, program, and operations plans into financial impacts.
  • Connect short-term forecasting with the long-range plan.
  • Present insights that accelerate execution and elevate decision quality.
  • Take full accountability for forecast accuracy, improving results with each actualized quarter.

Required qualifications:

  • 8–10 years of experience, including significant time in investment banking, PE, hedge funds, or equity research.
  • Direct strategic finance leadership experience in a publicly traded company.
  • Deep A&D industry exposure (defense, aerospace, autonomy, robotics, industrial tech, or complex HW/SW).
  • Proven ownership of scalable three‑statement models, LRP development, valuations, sensitivities, and unit economics.
  • Exceptional Excel modeling capability; fluent in multi‑scenario three‑statement modeling, beat-and-raise frameworks, and driver-based forecasting.
  • Strong GAAP proficiency and command of financial statement mechanics.
  • Demonstrated ability to distill complex financial and technical information into clear insights for executives, Board, and investors.
  • Thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments with high accuracy and strong judgment.
  • Systems-oriented mindset; comfortable partnering with data and systems teams.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Familiarity with government contract economics, milestone‑based revenue, and program accounting.
  • M&A experience including modeling, valuation, and diligence.
  • Exposure to manufacturing scale, supply chain dynamics, and hardware production cycles.

Who you are:

  • An analytical athlete with exceptional modeling intuition and attention to detail.
  • A structured, clear thinker who simplifies complexity without losing nuance.
  • Fast, accurate, and calm under pressure.
  • Curious, forward-looking, and driven to understand what truly moves the business.
  • A strong communicator who elevates decision quality across the company.
  • Mission-driven and energized by solving complex, high‑impact problems.

Why this role matters:

    You will build the strategic financial model that defines how the business is understood—internally, at the Board level, and eventually by public investors. Your work will guide product strategy, capital allocation, investments, and long-range ambitions. This is Strategic Finance at its highest level: high complexity, high visibility, high impact.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

As a Senior Systems Integration Engineer, you will lead the design and integration of complex aircraft systems from concept through production. You will own subsystem-level integration activities, including installation design, equipment packaging, routing, interface definition, and manufacturing support, while ensuring compatibility across structures, avionics, propulsion, and other aircraft systems.

You will serve as the technical lead for integration work statements, coordinating with multidisciplinary engineering teams to resolve integration challenges, drive design decisions, and deliver robust, manufacturable solutions that meet program objectives.

The ideal candidate is an experienced mechanical engineer who combines strong aircraft design fundamentals with systems-level thinking. They have demonstrated success leading subsystem integration efforts, proactively identifying technical risks, mentoring junior engineers, and collaborating effectively across engineering disciplines to deliver integrated aircraft solutions.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the mechanical integration of complete aircraft subsystems from concept through production, ensuring compatibility across structural, electrical, avionics, propulsion, and manufacturing interfaces.
  • Develop installation architecture for complex aircraft systems, including subsystem packaging, equipment mounting, and routing of electrical and fluid systems.
  • Lead the design of complex machined, composite, fabricated, and sheet metal assemblies requiring advanced engineering judgment.
  • Develop and review installation drawings, assembly documentation, and configuration baselines to ensure design consistency and production readiness.
  • Perform advanced tolerance analyses, structural hand calculations, and engineering trade studies supporting design decisions.
  • Coordinate subsystem integration activities during prototype builds, aircraft assembly, and production.
  • Mentor junior engineers in CAD modeling, GD&T application, installation design, and engineering best practices.
  • Coordinate suppliers and internal stakeholders to resolve technical issues affecting integration, manufacturability, schedule, or cost.
  • Support technical planning, schedule development, and project execution for assigned work packages."

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in aircraft, aerospace, defense, robotics, or complex electromechanical system development.
  • Demonstrated experience designing machined, fabricated, composite, and sheet metal components from concept through production release.
  • Demonstrated experience leading mechanical integration of aircraft subsystems or complex assemblies.
  • Advanced CAD proficiency with NX, SolidWorks, CATIA, Creo, or equivalent.
  • Experience managing engineering data, product structures, Bills of Material (BOMs), and drawing releases using PLM systems such as Teamcenter, Windchill, or 3DEXPERIENCE.
  • Working knowledge of aircraft installation practices, subsystem packaging, interface management, equipment mounting, and maintainability considerations.
  • Experience developing installation layouts and routing solutions for EWIS, hydraulic, fuel, pneumatic, ECS, or similar mechanical systems.
  • Experience developing part drawings, assembly drawings, and installation drawings.
  • Working knowledge of EWIS, hydraulic, fuel, pneumatic, or ECS routing design.
  • Strong knowledge of GD&T, ASME Y14.5, tolerance stack-up, and drawing release processes.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing, prototype builds, production issue resolution, or MRB activity.
  • Ability to coordinate across Manufacturing, Stress, Systems, Avionics, Supply Chain, and Test teams."

Preferred Qualifications

  • Aircraft integration experience on UAV, military, commercial, eVTOL, or autonomous aircraft programs.
  • Experience performing structural hand calculations, margin assessments, or preliminary stress analysis.
  • Experience with FEA including static, modal, vibration, fatigue, or thermal analysis.
  • Hands-on experience supporting build, production, testing, or hardware validation activities.
  • Experience managing technical scope, schedule, risk, or supplier coordination for subsystem work packages.
  • Familiarity with aircraft-level requirements, interface control, and configuration management."

Job Description 
 
This position will be based San Mateo, CA.

Shield AI is seeking a highly skilled Senior Network Engineer to help advance and secure our mission-critical global infrastructure. You will design, deploy, and maintain resilient network systems that power Shield AI’s enterprise and development environments—spanning data centers, on-premises sites, and public cloud networks.

You’ll partner with cross-functional teams to innovate, automate, and optimize network performance, availability, and security for operations supporting both classified and unclassified workloads. Limited travel to Shield AI sites may be required.

 

What you'll do:

    Network Engineering
    * Experience with public cloud networking in Azure and AWS, including secure connectivity models (e.g., ExpressRoute, Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN / vWAN).
    * Design, architect, and implement routing, switching, WLAN, and firewall infrastructure across data centers and remote offices.

    * Plan and execute network and firewall changes in accordance with change-management and security governance processes.

    * Configure and maintain secure connectivity services (e.g., VPN/ZTNA, HTTPS, SFTP).
    * Create and maintain clear operational and configuration documentation; mentor operational teams on processes and procedures.
    * Engage vendors and strategic partners for escalated troubleshooting, lifecycle planning, and technology evaluations.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

About Shield AI:

Shield AI is building the world’s best AI pilot. Our autonomous systems, including V-BAT and Hivemind Enterprise, operate in the most contested environments in the world. As next-generation aircraft programs transition from development into production, operational agility and production discipline are critical to delivering mission-ready systems while enabling rapid innovation.

We are seeking a Senior Production Planner for Development Programs to drive production planning and execution for developmental and prototype aircraft builds. This role operates at the intersection of Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Program Management to ensure aircraft build schedules remain executable despite evolving designs, changing priorities, and material constraints.

 

Job Description:

The Senior Production Planner – Development Programs is responsible for developing, maintaining, and executing production plans for prototype and developmental aircraft programs. Unlike traditional production environments, this role must navigate incomplete engineering definition, evolving bills of material, shifting program priorities, and dynamic supply chain conditions while maintaining progress toward key build and flight test milestones.

You will serve as a critical coordination point between Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and Program Management to translate rapidly changing program requirements into actionable production plans.

 

What you'll do:

  • Develop and maintain detailed production schedules for prototype aircraft builds, major assemblies, and integration activities
  • Translate engineering release plans, build priorities, and program milestones into executable manufacturing schedules
  • Release and manage work orders in support of aircraft builds, including builds with incomplete engineering definition or evolving configurations or bills of material
  • Coordinate schedule adjustments resulting from engineering changes, design revisions, and shifting program priorities
  • Monitor production progress and proactively identify risks to key build, integration, and flight test milestones
  • Coordinate temporary planning structures and workarounds to enable manufacturing progress while maintaining configuration control
  • Facilitate rapid schedule recovery plans when design, material, or technical issues affect build progress
  • Partner closely with Supply Chain to align material availability with build requirements and timelines
  • Support ERP/MRP system accuracy through effective planning and work order management

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in production planning, manufacturing planning, production control, or supply chain operations
  • Experience supporting complex hardware, aerospace, defense, automotive, robotics, or other highly engineered products
  • Experience working within ERP/MRP systems (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Costpoint, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, work order management, bills of material, and production scheduling
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and highly dynamic environment
  • Ability to obtain/maintain a security clearance

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience supporting prototype, NPI (New Product Introduction), or developmental manufacturing programs
  • Experience in UAV, aerospace, defense, or aircraft production environments
  • Familiarity with engineering change management and configuration control processes
  • APICS CPIM certification

Why Shield AI:

    At Shield AI, prototype aircraft builds are where innovation becomes reality. Every developmental aircraft completed advances the future of autonomous aviation and accelerates mission capability for our customers.

    This role sits at the center of that effort, helping transform evolving designs into flight-ready aircraft while building the production foundation for future scale.

    If you are excited about solving complex manufacturing challenges and enabling next-generation autonomous aircraft programs, we want to hear from you.

    Join us in building the world's best AI pilot.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

We are seeking an experienced Senior PX Program Manager to lead the delivery, optimization, adoption, and continuous improvement of strategic Talent Acquisition (TA) programs and priority People Experience (PX) initiatives. This role combines program management, recruiting operations, process optimization, and change management to strengthen how the organization attracts, assesses, selects, and hires talent.

In close partnership with Talent Acquisition leaders, recruiters, recruiting coordinators, hiring teams, PX Systems, and cross-functional stakeholders, this individual will translate recruiting strategy into scalable programs, operating models, and implementation plans. They will lead complex initiatives, improve end-to-end hiring processes, clarify roles and decision rights, establish governance, and use data to drive efficiency, quality, adoption, and an exceptional candidate and hiring-manager experience.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in program and project management, process improvement, change management, and stakeholder engagement, along with experience supporting Talent Acquisition or other high-volume People functions. This is a full-time role responsible for advancing critical TA and PX priorities, strengthening operating rigor, and developing efficient, repeatable approaches that support organizational growth.

Key Responsibilities

    Senior Program Manager - Talent Acquisition Programs

    We are seeking an experienced Senior PX Program Manager to lead the delivery, optimization, adoption, and continuous improvement of strategic Talent Acquisition (TA) programs and priority People Experience (PX) initiatives. This role combines program management, recruiting operations, process optimization, and change management to strengthen how the organization attracts, assesses, selects, and hires talent.

    In close partnership with Talent Acquisition leaders, recruiters, recruiting coordinators, hiring teams, PX Systems, and cross-functional stakeholders, this individual will translate recruiting strategy into scalable programs, operating models, and implementation plans. They will lead complex initiatives, improve end-to-end hiring processes, clarify roles and decision rights, establish governance, and use data to drive efficiency, quality, adoption, and an exceptional candidate and hiring-manager experience.

    The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in program and project management, process improvement, change management, and stakeholder engagement, along with experience supporting Talent Acquisition or other high-volume People functions. This is a full-time role responsible for advancing critical TA and PX priorities, strengthening operating rigor, and developing efficient, repeatable approaches that support organizational growth.

    Key Responsibilities

    Talent Acquisition Program Delivery

    • Lead the planning, coordination, execution, and launch of complex TA programs and cross-functional PX initiatives, such as recruiting process optimization, interviewer enablement, hiring capacity planning, candidate experience, recruiting technology implementations, and talent-program rollouts.
    • Partner with TA and PX leaders to define program scope, objectives, milestones, timelines, risks, dependencies, resources, and success measures.
    • Translate strategic hiring priorities into actionable roadmaps, workstreams, implementation plans, and sustainable operating models.
    • Maintain integrated program plans and operating rhythms; monitor progress and proactively manage risks, issues, dependencies, and decisions.
    • Drive alignment and accountability across recruiters, coordinators, sourcers, hiring managers, interviewers, systems teams, and other partners to achieve milestones and intended outcomes.
    • Ensure programs transition effectively from implementation to sustainable business-as-usual operations with clear ownership, documentation, and performance measures.

      • Recruiting Process Optimization and Operational Excellence

      • Lead end-to-end assessment and optimization of priority TA processes, including workforce demand intake, requisition launch, sourcing, screening, interviewing, selection, offer management, preboarding, and recruiting operations.
      • Map current-state processes and design future-state workflows that improve speed, quality, consistency, compliance, candidate experience, hiring-manager experience, and operational effectiveness.
      • Identify process gaps, bottlenecks, redundancies, manual work, inconsistent practices, and unclear ownership; determine root causes and develop practical, scalable solutions.
      • Partner with TA leaders and subject-matter experts to clarify roles, decision rights, handoffs, service expectations, escalation paths, and operating mechanisms.
      • Develop and implement standardized playbooks, SOPs, templates, toolkits, and governance practices that enable consistent execution across recruiting teams and hiring stakeholders.
      • Partner with PX Systems and other stakeholders to improve ATS workflows, reporting, integrations, automation, and the effective use of recruiting technology.
      • Embed continuous improvement practices into TA programs and processes using operational data, stakeholder feedback, candidate insights, and lessons learned.

        • Change Management and Adoption

        • Develop and execute change management strategies that support successful adoption and long-term sustainability of new TA programs, systems, tools, and processes.
        • Assess stakeholder impacts and organizational readiness, then create communication, engagement, training, enablement, and reinforcement plans.
        • Partner with TA leaders, recruiters, hiring managers, interviewers, and subject-matter experts to facilitate change and minimize disruption.
        • Track adoption, stakeholder readiness, and effectiveness; use findings to adjust implementation plans and improve future initiatives.
        • Ensure redesigned processes are supported by clear documentation, training materials, communications, ownership, and reinforcement mechanisms.

          • Stakeholder Leadership and Cross-Functional Collaboration

          • Build trusted relationships across Talent Acquisition, PX, Finance, Legal, IT, business leadership, and hiring teams.
          • Facilitate stakeholder alignment, decision-making, process design, and issue resolution across multiple workstreams.
          • Lead working sessions to identify root causes, evaluate options and tradeoffs, and align stakeholders on practical solutions.
          • Coordinate cross-functional efforts to ensure cohesive program delivery and integration with broader workforce and business priorities.
          • Escalate risks, tradeoffs, and decisions appropriately and provide clear recommendations that enable timely resolution.
          • Deliver concise, executive-ready communications on program status, recruiting process performance, risks, outcomes, and recommendations.

            • Governance, Analytics, and Operating Effectiveness

            • Establish governance models, operating rhythms, and reporting mechanisms for assigned TA and PX programs and processes.
            • Maintain key program artifacts, including project plans, process maps, action plans, decision logs, risk registers, and operating documentation.
            • Use quantitative and qualitative data to identify opportunities, inform recommendations, measure outcomes, and support ongoing improvement.

Required Qualifications

    • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Industrial Engineering, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
    • 8+ years of experience leading complex programs, process improvements, transformations, or organizational change within Talent Acquisition, HR, People Operations, Operations, or a related environment.
    • Demonstrated success managing cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholders and workstreams in a high-growth or similarly dynamic organization.
    • Strong program and project management skills, including planning, governance, risk and dependency management, execution, and performance measurement.
    • Experience supporting Talent Acquisition programs and a working understanding of the end-to-end recruiting lifecycle and the needs of candidates, recruiters, and hiring teams.
    • Experience assessing and redesigning end-to-end processes, identifying root causes, clarifying roles and handoffs, and implementing scalable solutions, frameworks, playbooks, or SOPs.
    • Hands-on change management experience, including stakeholder analysis, communications, training, enablement, adoption, and reinforcement.
    • Ability to use recruiting, operational, survey, adoption, and other quantitative and qualitative data to guide decisions and measure impact.
    • Excellent communication, facilitation, analytical, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to bring structure to ambiguity and influence outcomes without direct authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading high-impact TA initiatives, such as recruiting transformation, process redesign, interviewer enablement, candidate experience, workforce planning, recruiting analytics, or technology implementations.
  • Experience supporting high-volume recruiting, recruiting operations, HR shared services, or other scaled People functions in technology, aerospace, defense, or another complex or rapidly growing environment.
  • Experience implementing or optimizing ATS, HRIS, recruiting platforms, automation, integrations, process-mapping tools, or data-visualization solutions.
  • Formal training or certification in program, change, or process improvement methodologies, such as PMP, Prosci, Lean, Six Sigma, or Agile.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description: 

The Senior Program Manager will lead the execution and growth of Navy Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) programs. This role serves as the primary interface between US Navy stakeholders, business development, engineering, operations, and executive leadership to identify opportunities, shape task orders, and successfully deliver mission-critical capabilities to operational customers. 

The candidate will possess deep US Navy experience, understand how requirements transition into funded task orders, and will have a proven track record of success leading complex defense programs from opportunity identification through execution. This individual will ensure exceptional customer satisfaction and operational outcomes for Shield AI customers. 

What you'll do:

  • Deliver proven, exceptional, and reliable performance in support of Navy missions through flawless program management and leadership 
  • Effectively collaborate and lead relevant stakeholders to successfully deliver programs early, under budget, and with exceptional technical performance 
  • Develop and maintain trusted relationships with Navy operational, acquisition, and technical stakeholders. Serve as the primary customer-facing lead for assigned programs 
  • Complete critical path analyses including the evaluation of potential means to accelerate the pace or mitigate identified risks  
  • Translate evolving customer requirements into executable plans across engineering, operations, logistics, and sustainment teams 
  • Astutely balance and rebalance shifting customer priories related to cost, schedule, and technical parameters of programs 
  • Drive program execution across multiple concurrent task orders and customer organizations. 
  • Lead staffing plans, execution strategies, risk assessments, and program activities 
  • Establish and maintain accurate program schedules, financial forecasts, staffing plans, and risk registers 
  • Drive accurate and timely tracking and reporting of budget, resource utilization, contract performance, and project management metrics 
  • Establish and lead a consistent cadence of well-organized, well-facilitated, and effective meetings, including driving all preparation and follow up activities 
  • Support the growth and maturation of Shield AI's Navy portfolio while positioning the company for follow-on awards and expanded mission scope 
  • Support an environment where accountability and program execution excellence are core 

Required qualifications:

  • 8+ years of Program Management experience supporting Department of Defense programs. 
  • Demonstrated successful experience running advanced programs consisting of multiple interrelated projects, in a self-directed manner 
  • Direct experience supporting Navy operational, acquisition, ISR, aviation, maritime, or intelligence communities 
  • Proven experience managing customer-facing defense programs with responsibility for cost, schedule, and performance 
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams across engineering, operations, logistics, and business functions 
  • Demonstrated experience developing, shaping, capturing, or executing government contracts and task orders 
  • Strong business and financial acumen with experience managing complex program financials 
  • Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills 
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and programs in a fast-paced environment 
  • Demonstrated success driving long-term business objectives  
  • Experience with scheduling tools such as Microsoft Project or Smartsheet 
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed  
  • Demonstrated alignment with Shield AI's values and leadership principles, including accountability, trust, collaboration, and servant leadership 
  • Active Secret Security Clearance 

Preferred qualifications:

  • Former Navy experience (active duty or civilian) 
  • Experience supporting unmanned aerial systems, aviation operations, ISR programs, or defense technology programs 
  • Familiarity with U.S. Navy operational, acquisition, and technical organizations 
  • Experience supporting deployed operations, expeditionary operations, or global logistics networks 
  • Experience transitioning new capabilities into operational fleet use 
  • PMP certification or equivalent program management training 
  • Undergraduate degree in engineering, business, or operations management

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

The Senior Project Manager, Finance & ERP Transformation is a senior project delivery leader within the PMO responsible for managing complex Oracle Fusion ERP and enterprise transformation initiatives across multiple workstreams. This role drives delivery from initiation through go-live and stabilization, ensuring tight schedule management, strong cross-functional coordination, proactive risk and issue escalation, and disciplined governance throughout the project lifecycle.
 
The role requires someone who can understand technical concepts, dependencies, and delivery risks well enough to coordinate effectively across functional, technical, integration, data, and testing teams, but who is not expected to serve as the hands-on technical lead or provide technical solution ownership. Success is defined by on-time execution, stakeholder alignment, effective governance, and sustainable business adoption of ERP-enabled change.

What you'll do:

  • Lead end-to-end project management for Oracle Fusion ERP implementations, enhancements, migrations, and transformation programs from charter through go-live and hypercare.
  • Manage multiple concurrent workstreams and maintain an integrated project plan covering business, functional, technical, data, testing, and deployment activities.
  • Build and maintain core project management deliverables including schedules, milestone plans, RAID logs, dependency trackers, RACI matrices, and executive status reporting.  
  • Coordinate closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, systems integrators, and vendor partners to align scope, timing, deliverables, and decisions.
  • Facilitate planning, requirements, fit-gap, and workstream checkpoint sessions with functional leads and business process owners.
  • Drive governance routines, executive updates, decision forums, and escalation paths, while clearly communicating risks, issues, dependencies, and required actions.  
  • Actively manage the project schedule, critical path, overdue actions, and cross-workstream blockers to keep delivery on track.
  • Coordinate delivery activities across integrations, reporting, data migration, testing, cutover, and deployment without acting as the technical authority for solution design.
  • Partner with program leadership and finance stakeholders on budget tracking, forecast updates, variance reporting, and go-live readiness activities.
  • Manage vendor and systems integrator performance against plans, milestones, and contractual commitments.

Required qualifications:

  • 6+ years of project management experience, including 5+ years leading ERP programs or large enterprise transformation initiatives in mid-to-large organizations.
  • Demonstrated experience leading Oracle Fusion ERP projects or closely related Oracle ERP transformation programs.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously while maintaining a tightly controlled integrated schedule and clear accountability across teams.
  • Strong understanding of ERP delivery lifecycles, including planning, design, build, test, data migration, cutover, go-live, and stabilization.
  • Ability to understand technical concepts, integration dependencies, environment readiness, data migration risks, and testing implications sufficiently to coordinate teams and drive delivery, without being the primary technical resource.
  • Strong command of project management fundamentals including scope, schedule, RAID management, dependency tracking, status reporting, and governance.
  • Experience working with executive sponsors, business process owners, IT leaders, vendors, and third-party systems integrators.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and organizational skills, with the ability to drive action and elevate issues clearly and promptly.
  • PMP certification or equivalent is preferred.
  • We are ONLY seeking candidates local to the Bay Area (and willing to commute to San Mateo, CA). At this time, we will not be relocating candidates.

Preferred qualifications:

    Experience in a PMO or enterprise transformation office supporting large cross-functional programs is preferred. Experience with Oracle Fusion workstreams such as Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Projects, HCM, or Reporting/Analytics is helpful. Additional value comes from cloud ERP transformation experience, enterprise governance exposure, and prior experience as a business analyst, functional lead, or ERP power user.

jobs.title: Senior Proposal Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The primary function of this role is the leading and managing of international government and commercial proposals across Shield AI’s India business. The BD Ops team is looking for this candidate to have strong technical writing experience, capable of conflating complex technical ideas into succinct prose.

The candidate should also have excellent verbal communication and team coordination skills to facilitate contributions from teams across the Shield AI team. In this capacity the proposal manager will be able to support our growing number of proposals and manage, write, and respond to requests for information.   

    Leadership skills:
  • Lead India proposal efforts, align stakeholders, and communicate key customer, market, and BD strategy insights.
  • Strong communicator: Strong oral and written communication skills. (Technical writing experience preferred.) Strong presentation skills. Ability to communicate seamlessly at all levels of Shield AI and customer organizations. 
  • Attention to detail in a fast-paced environment: Be rigorous and go fast is one of Shield AI’s leadership traits and, possibly, the most relevant one for BD Ops. Our ideal candidate must always work with efficiency and a keen attention to detail. Both are critical to supporting on time, compliant Bids/Proposals and related deliverables. 
  • Organization and time management: Strong organizational and time management skills enabling the tracking and execution of multiple workstreams with stakeholders across Shield AI.
  • BD Ops serves as the primary cross-functional lead for Bids/Proposals across product lines and geographic regions. We manage the proposal lifecycle from start to finish including kickoff, collaboration with stakeholders, color reviews, and management reviews with senior leaders/executives. We are ultimately responsible for everything that does or does not happen in the Bid/Proposal process. 
  • The ideal candidate will demonstrate the ability to be flexible, work hard, hold themself and others to high standards, embrace teammates, and act with kindness.  

What you will do: 

  • Manage competing priorities across proposal and other deliverable (WPs, RFIs, ROMs, etc.) development in the fast-paced environment of the Int’l BD Ops team. 
  • Lead end-to-end proposal execution from pre-RFP planning through submission and closeout. 
  • Drive cross-functional proposal teams to deliver compliant, high-quality submissions on schedule.
  • Continuously improve proposal processes, tools, templates, and best practices.
  • Mentor proposal contributors and foster high-performing, collaborative teams.
  • Support India GTM team with briefing and presentation development for customer engagements. 
  • Support customer meetings, demonstrations, and GTM events as required. 
  • Provide additional support to BD Ops and GTM team leadership as needed.  

Required qualifications

  • 2-4+ years of Government of India / Indian Ministry of Defence or international government proposal development or BD operations experience.  
  • In lieu of direct government proposal experience, have 3+ years of experience working with Government of India or international government requirements.  
  • Bachelor's degree in business, communication, marketing, engineering, or equivalent industry experience.  
  • Strong record of academic achievement. 
  • Experience with proposal methodologies (e.g. Shipley), compliance matrices, and implementing project management tools and processes. 
  • Proven record of leadership in a professional setting.  
  • Ability to communicate complex, technical ideas effectively – both orally and in writing.

jobs.title: Senior Propulsion Design Engineer (R4641)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

We are seeking a Senior Propulsion Design Engineer to support the development and delivery of propulsion hardware for the X-BAT platform, a next-generation UAV powered by a low-bypass turbofan engine. This role spans the full lifecycle of propulsion system components - from early layout and design through production release, test support, and flight operations.

You will be a key contributor to turning propulsion architecture into manufacturable, testable, and flight-ready hardware across the engine, fuel, oil, and bleed air systems. This role is hands-on, detail-oriented, and highly cross-functional - requiring close collaboration with propulsion REs, technicians, machinists, production, controls, airframe, and flight test teams.

What you will do in this role:

  • Own the design and release of propulsion hardware supporting the engine, fuel, oil, and bleed air systems.
  • Develop and maintain CAD models, drawings, and assemblies using Siemens NX with proper GD&T.
  • Translate propulsion architecture and requirements into hardware that is manufacturable, testable, and robust in flight.
  • Work directly with the machine shop, production, and technicians to support builds, resolve non-conformances, and drive iterative improvements.
  • Support test campaigns by providing hardware design support, instrumentation accommodation, and rapid iteration based on test findings.
  • Apply engineering judgment and analysis (e.g., hand calcs, ANSYS, FEA, GFSSP, REFPROP) to support sizing, load cases, and design validation.
  • Support configuration management, BOM control, and change processes using Teamcenter or equivalent PLM.
  • Participate in design reviews, interface control efforts, and root cause investigations related to propulsion hardware.

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in aerospace hardware design, preferably supporting propulsion systems.
  • Proficiency in CAD modeling and drawing creation (NX preferred) with sound application of GD&T.
  • Experience working directly with production, technicians, and machine shops to resolve real-world build issues.
  • Understanding of design for manufacturing, including machining limitations, tolerance stack-ups, and assembly workflows.
  • Some hands-on experience developing assembly guidance and supporting hardware builds and test integration.
  • U.S. Citizenship or ability to comply with ITAR requirements.
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with jet propulsion systems on UAVs or tactical aircraft.
  • Familiarity with GFSSP, REFPROP, ANSYS, or FEA to support design trade studies and validation.
  • Ability to write Python scripts for design automation, analysis, or data processing.
  • Experience with interface control, fastener selection for high-vibration environments, and high-temperature materials.
  • Experience designing hardware in test-driven development environments with rapid iteration cycles.
  • M.S. in Aerospace Engineering or a related discipline.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

We are seeking a highly skilled Propulsion Technician to join our X-BAT Propulsion Engineering team, specializing in UAV propulsion systems. In this role, you will be responsible for the assembly, testing, troubleshooting, and maintenance of low-bypass turbofan engines in both test cell environments and pre/post-flight operations. Our team owns the engine from start to finish, requiring technicians with a high level of expertise, attention to detail, and a strong problem-solving mindset.

We are particularly looking for candidates with an A&P license, prior experience working with aircraft engines, and a background in aerospace companies or military aviation maintenance. If you are a self-starter, high-energy technician who thrives in a hands-on, fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.

What you will do in this role:

  • Conduct engine assembly, disassembly, and integration for UAV propulsion systems.
  • Perform pre-flight and post-flight inspections, ensuring all propulsion systems meet operational standards.
  • Operate test cells for engine validation, tuning, and troubleshooting.
  • Diagnose and resolve mechanical, electrical, and performance issues related to propulsion systems.
  • Work closely with engineers and flight test teams to ensure system readiness.
  • Maintain detailed records of maintenance activities, inspections, and modifications.
  • Follow strict safety protocols and standard operating procedures in handling high-performance UAV propulsion systems.

Required qualifications:

  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience working on aircraft engines (military or civilian).
  • Prior experience at an aerospace company or military aviation unit.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with gas turbine, reciprocating, or hybrid propulsion systems.
  • Ability to interpret technical manuals, schematics, and engineering documents.
  • Comfortable working in high-energy, high-precision environments.
  • Strong safety mindset, with meticulous attention to detail.
  • U.S. Citizenship or ability to comply with ITAR requirements.
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Airframe & Powerplant (A&P) License.
  • Military background, particularly in jet propulsion, UAVs, or rotary-wing aircraft.
  • Experience with unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) propulsion.
  • Knowledge of fuel systems, ignition systems, and advanced propulsion technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with engine dynamometers, test cells, or ground support equipment.
  • FAA Powerplant or military equivalent engine qualifications.
  • Ability to work independently, taking ownership of full-cycle propulsion system maintenance.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

We are seeking a Senior Propulsion Test Engineer to lead the planning and execution of propulsion test campaigns for the X-BAT platform. This role is responsible for end-to-end ownership of propulsion test activities—from test architecture and test stand design through execution, data analysis, and iteration - supporting a low-bypass turbofan-powered Group 5 UAV.

You will serve as the focal point for propulsion testing, ensuring test results accurately characterize engine and subsystem performance, de-risk integration, and inform flight readiness decisions. This role is hands-on, data-driven, and highly cross-functional - requiring close collaboration with propulsion engineers, design engineers, technicians, controls, airframe, and flight test teams.

What you will do in this role:

  • Own the propulsion test program from requirements through execution, data review, and test-to-flight handoff.
  • Architect, design, analyze, and build test stands and fixtures for engine, fuel, oil, bleed air, and TVC-related testing.
  • Define and implement instrumentation plans, DAQ architecture, calibration methods, and test procedures.
  • Lead ground test campaigns, including performance mapping, transient response, and edge-of-envelope testing.
  • Analyze test data to validate performance, identify anomalies, and drive design or control updates.
  • Partner with propulsion REs and controls engineers to ensure test coverage closes risk against CONOPS and mission profiles.
  • Drive root cause investigations for test anomalies and implement corrective actions.
  • Author test plans, reports, and readiness reviews; represent propulsion test in design and flight readiness reviews.

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in propulsion or engine testing in aerospace development environments.
  • Hands-on experience with engine test cells, test stand design, instrumentation, and DAQ systems.
  • Strong understanding of gas turbine engine performance, transients, and test methodologies.
  • Proficiency in Python (or similar) for data reduction, automation, and analysis workflows.
  • Experience supporting flight test readiness and test-to-flight transitions.
  • U.S. Citizenship or ability to comply with ITAR requirements.
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience testing low-bypass turbofan engines or propulsion subsystems on UAVs or tactical aircraft.
  • Familiarity with REFPROP, GFSSP, ANSYS, or FEA to support test interpretation and correlation.
  • Experience designing structural test fixtures, load paths, thermal management, and safety systems for hot-fire environments.
  • Background in controls integration, actuator testing (e.g., TVC), and transient characterization.
  • Experience operating in a test-driven, hardware-centric aerospace development environment.
  • M.S. in Aerospace Engineering or a related discipline.

jobs.title: Senior Recruiting Coordinator (R5646)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

The Senior Recruiting Coordinator – EMEA is an individual contributor responsible for providing high-level operational and administrative support to the Talent Acquisition function, with primary ownership of complex interview scheduling, candidate travel coordination, and recruiting operations across EMEA.

This role independently manages high-volume and complex interview logistics across multiple countries, time zones, and stakeholder groups while delivering a seamless and high-touch candidate experience. The Recruiting Coordinator partners closely with recruiters, hiring managers, executives, and cross-functional teams to anticipate and resolve coordination challenges and support the successful execution of global hiring initiatives.

As an experienced member of the Talent Acquisition team, this role also serves as a resource for recruiting coordination best practices, identifies opportunities to improve operational processes, and helps establish scalable and consistent ways of working as the organization grows.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Interview Coordination

  • Independently manage high-volume and complex interview scheduling across multiple countries and global time zones
  • Coordinate complex calendars involving candidates, interview panels, hiring managers, executives, and other key stakeholders
  • Arrange virtual and in-person interviews, including multi-stage and multi-day interview processes
  • Anticipate scheduling constraints and proactively identify solutions to minimize delays and ensure an efficient hiring process
  • Prepare and distribute accurate interview confirmations, calendar invitations, interview schedules, and relevant materials
  • Manage last-minute scheduling changes and competing priorities with professionalism, urgency, and sound judgment
  • Ensure interview details and candidate activity are accurately maintained within Talent Acquisition systems
  • Partner with recruiters and hiring teams to determine effective scheduling approaches for complex or business-critical searches
  • Serve as a resource to the Talent Acquisition team on interview coordination practices and processes

Candidate Travel & Logistics

  • Independently coordinate domestic and international candidate travel, including flights and accommodations
  • Prepare and distribute detailed candidate itineraries and ensure candidates have the information necessary for a seamless interview experience
  • Coordinate complex or time-sensitive travel arrangements across multiple EMEA locations
  • Manage travel changes, cancellations, disruptions, and other unexpected issues while minimizing impact to candidates and interview teams
  • Ensure candidate travel arrangements comply with applicable company travel policies and budget guidelines
  • Partner with internal stakeholders and external vendors, as appropriate, to resolve travel and logistical issues
  • Identify opportunities to improve candidate travel processes, documentation, and operational consistency

Candidate Experience

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process, providing timely, professional, and high-touch support
  • Deliver clear and proactive communication to candidates across multiple countries and time zones
  • Anticipate candidate questions and logistical needs and proactively address issues that could affect the interview experience
  • Ensure a consistent, organized, and positive candidate experience throughout all stages of interview coordination
  • Exercise discretion and professionalism when supporting sensitive, confidential, executive, or business-critical searches
  • Partner with recruiters and hiring teams to continuously improve the candidate experience

Recruiting Operations Support

  • Maintain accurate, complete, and timely candidate and interview data within Applicant Tracking Systems and other Talent Acquisition tools
  • Support recruiting metrics, reporting, audits, and operational tracking as needed
  • Monitor coordination workflows and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, scalability, and stakeholder experience
  • Recommend and support implementation of improvements to scheduling, candidate travel, documentation, and recruiting coordination processes
