We’re looking for a  Senior Staff Talent Sourcer who lives and breathes talent discovery - someone who can take a complex, highly specialized corporate hiring need and translate it into a precision sourcing strategy. You’ll be the go-to expert for talent intelligence, market mapping, proactive candidate generation, and pipeline cultivation across our Finance, Legal, People, Operations, Strategy, IT, and other corporate functions.

This isn’t just a "find resumes" role - it’s about building intelligence, relationships, and repeatable systems that fuel our engineering hiring engine. As a Senior Staff Talent Sourcer, you'll serve as a strategic partner to recruiters and hiring leaders while leveraging modern AI tools, market intelligence, and scalable sourcing practices to help us identify and hire world-class engineering talent.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Own the top of funnel: Partner closely with recruiters and hiring leaders to define target profiles and build deep, data-informed sourcing strategies across Finance, Accounting, Legal, People, Operations, Strategy, IT, Procurement, Facilities, and other G&A and corporate disciplines.
  • Map the market: Develop comprehensive talent landscapes by company, skillset, geography, and organizational structure; identify hidden talent pools, competitor insights, and emerging talent trends to inform recruiting strategy and workforce planning.
  • Generate and engage: Use advanced Boolean search techniques, sourcing platforms, and creative sourcing channels (LinkedIn Recruiter, SeekOut, HireEZ, ClearanceJobs, GitHub, engineering communities, niche aerospace networks, conferences, referrals, and more) to identify, engage, and attract exceptional technical talent.
  • Build pipelines proactively: Cultivate long-term relationships with passive, cleared, and highly specialized engineering talent to enable just-in-time hiring across strategic programs.
  • Leverage AI to scale sourcing: Design, build, and continuously improve AI-powered sourcing workflows, research agents, and practical automations that increase recruiter productivity, accelerate candidate discovery, enhance market intelligence, and improve operational efficiency.
  • Build repeatable sourcing systems: Use AI tools and workflow automation to create structured market maps, talent intelligence reports, outreach content, sourcing documentation, and scalable recruiting processes that can be leveraged across the Talent Acquisition organization.
  • Be the sourcing SME: Serve as the subject matter expert on technical sourcing by coaching recruiters and hiring managers on market insights, sourcing strategy, talent availability, competitive intelligence, candidate engagement best practices, and emerging recruiting technologies.
  • Partner for impact: Collaborate cross-functionally with Talent Acquisition Operations, Employer Brand, University Recruiting, and Engineering leaders to optimize recruiting strategies, outbound messaging, candidate experience, and operational excellence.
  • Track and iterate: Use recruiting analytics, experimentation, and storytelling to measure sourcing effectiveness, optimize outreach strategies, improve conversion rates, and continuously evolve sourcing practices.

  • 8+ years of sourcing experience, ideally supporting G&A, corporate functions, or other complex, high-growth organizations.
  • Proven track record in market mapping, competitive intelligence, and candidate generation for highly specialized technical roles.
  • Deep expertise in advanced Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, HireEZ, SeekOut, ClearanceJobs, GitHub, and other modern sourcing platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a consultative partner to recruiters, hiring managers, and senior engineering leaders, influencing hiring strategy through market insights and talent intelligence.
  • Hands-on experience building or leveraging AI-powered sourcing workflows, agentic AI tools, workflow automations, or practical AI solutions that improve recruiting or business processes.
  • Direct experience using AI development environments or coding assistants (such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar tools) to create repeatable sourcing workflows, structured research outputs, market intelligence, process automation, or operational documentation.
  • Experience building and maintaining long-term relationships with passive, cleared, or niche engineering talent.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills with the ability to engage highly technical candidates and influence stakeholders.
  • Strong judgment, curiosity, and a continuous improvement mindset with the ability to evaluate and adopt emerging AI technologies to improve recruiting outcomes.
  • Highly organized, data-driven, and able to operate autonomously in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Hivemind Catalyst accelerates the adoption of autonomy by enabling customers to rapidly develop, integrate, test, and deploy sovereign autonomous capabilities on their own platforms. 

As a Senior Staff Technical Program Manager for Hivemind Catalyst, you will operate at the intersection of technology, strategy, business development, and execution. You will help customers define their autonomy roadmaps, shape technical solutions, drive software alignment across internal teams, and ensure successful execution of customer programs from initial engagement through delivery.

Job Description:

jobs.title: Senior Supervisor, Engineering Technician (R5375)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

We are growing the Avionics Engineering team to support the development, integration, test, production, and field support of flight-critical aircraft systems. Our team is responsible for avionics hardware and electrical systems that support communications, compute, autonomy, power, telemetry, sensors, and other mission-critical aircraft functions.

You will directly supervise a team of professional and skilled engineering technicians supporting integration, testing, debugging. This role is both a hands-on technical leadership position and a people leadership position. You will execute assignments based on defined objectives and established processes while providing guidance, mentorship, and daily direction to the technician team.

You will work closely with electrical engineers, mechanical engineers, production, quality, supply chain, maintenance technicians, flight support team members, subordinate supervisors, and cross-functional peers to ensure avionics hardware is built, tested, debugged, documented, and supported safely and effectively. This role requires the ability to read and interpret harness schematics, PCBA schematics, wiring diagrams, engineering drawings, test procedures, and work instructions.

The ideal candidate is a technically credible leader who can guide a team through complex, high-consequence avionics work; embed training into daily execution; analyze data and relevant factors; exercise sound judgment; interpret policies and procedures.

What you'll do:

  • Directly supervise professional and skilled engineering technicians supporting avionics system testing, integration, debugging, production support, maintenance support, and flight support activities.
  • Execute team assignments based on defined objectives, approved processes, engineering direction, production priorities, and program schedules.
  • Read, interpret, and apply harness schematics, PCBA schematics, wiring diagrams, interface control documents, engineering drawings, test procedures, work instructions, and production documentation.
  • Support avionics integration and test activities from bench-level checkout through subsystem, aircraft, production, maintenance, and flight-support environments.
  • Work closely with engineers to support hardware bring-up, design verification, test execution, root-cause investigations, corrective actions, and design or process improvements.
  • Partner with production teams to resolve build issues, installation problems, test failures, rework needs, hardware readiness concerns, and schedule constraints.
  • Collaborate with quality teams to ensure work complies with inspection requirements, workmanship standards, configuration control expectations, nonconformance processes, and approved procedures.
  • Coordinate with supply chain teams to communicate material shortages, suspect hardware, part replacement needs, supplier issues, and impacts to build, test, or flight-readiness schedules.
  • Support maintenance technicians and flight support team members during aircraft checkout, avionics troubleshooting, system modification, ground test, and flight readiness activities.
  • Administer company policies and procedures directly affecting employees, including expectations related to safety, quality, attendance, work assignments, training, performance, compliance, and conduct.
  • Interpret policies, procedures, and work instructions to determine appropriate action when resolving routine employee, operational, quality, or technical execution issues.
  • Analyze data and relevant factors, including test results, failure trends, technician workload, schedule performance, hardware status, quality findings, material availability, and operational risks.
  • Develop, manage, and adjust routine operational plans to support daily priorities, weekly execution, production needs, integration milestones, maintenance activities, flight support, and monthly targets.
  • Use and oversee use of electrical and avionics test equipment, including multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, signal generators, breakout boxes, bus analyzers, automated test equipment, and related lab or production tools.
  • Drive continuous improvement in technician training, troubleshooting methods, test procedures, documentation quality, tooling, workflow, and operational execution.

Required qualifications:

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience with avionics systems, aircraft electrical systems, electronics, harnesses, PCBAs, integrated test environments, or complex hardware systems.
  • 2+ years of experience directly supervising, leading, training, or coordinating skilled technicians in an engineering, production, test, aerospace, aviation, maintenance, or advanced manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to read and interpret harness schematics, PCBA schematics, wiring diagrams, engineering drawings, test procedures, and work instructions.
  • Experience performing avionics or electrical troubleshooting across wiring, connectors, PCBAs, power systems, sensors, communication interfaces, test equipment, and integrated systems.
  • Experience using electrical and avionics test equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, signal generators, analyzers, breakout boxes, and automated test systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide guidance and training to technicians during hands-on technical work.
  • Demonstrated ability to execute assignments based on defined objectives, established processes, schedule priorities, and operational targets.
  • Experience administering workplace policies, reinforcing safety and quality standards, and supporting employee performance expectations.
  • Ability to analyze technical data, test results, operational constraints, schedule risks, quality findings, and resource availability to determine appropriate next steps.
  • Sound judgment in prioritizing work, assigning resources, escalating risks, and making decisions within defined objectives and processes.
  • Ability to work effectively with engineering, production, quality, supply chain, maintenance technicians, flight support team members, subordinate supervisors, and functional peers.

 The Senior Systems Administrator is responsible for the administration, support, optimization, and continuous improvement of the enterprise IT infrastructure supporting Shield AI's business operations. This role designs, implements, maintains, and troubleshoots enterprise systems across cloud, endpoint, identity, server, and collaboration platforms while ensuring secure, reliable, and scalable services.

The Senior Systems Administrator partners with Infrastructure, Networking, Security, and Engineering teams to deliver operational excellence, improve system reliability, automate administrative processes, and support strategic IT initiatives. This position serves as a technical lead for enterprise infrastructure projects and provides advanced troubleshooting for complex operational issues.

What You'll Do

  • Administer, maintain, and optimize enterprise Windows, Linux, and macOS systems supporting corporate business operations.
  • Design, implement, configure, and support enterprise infrastructure including cloud services, identity management, endpoint management, collaboration platforms, and core IT systems.
  • Analyze system performance, availability, and operational metrics to proactively improve reliability, scalability, and security.
  • Administer Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID, Group Policy, authentication services, and role-based access controls.
  • Deploy, maintain, and support endpoint management platforms including Microsoft Intune, JAMF, and related management technologies.
  • Plan and execute infrastructure upgrades, migrations, patch management, and lifecycle replacement initiatives.
  • Lead technical implementation of enterprise IT projects while coordinating with Infrastructure, Security, Networking, and business stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, operating system, cloud, and application issues using root cause analysis methodologies.
  • Support LAN/WAN connectivity, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and network-related troubleshooting in partnership with networking teams.
  • Develop automation using PowerShell, Bash, or similar scripting languages to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual administration.
  • Maintain accurate system documentation, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and knowledge base articles.
  • Manage enterprise hardware and software assets throughout their lifecycle including procurement, deployment, maintenance, and decommissioning.
  • Participate in incident response, change management, disaster recovery planning, and business continuity activities.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and perform scheduled maintenance outside normal business hours as required.
  • Mentor junior administrators and provide technical guidance across the Enterprise IT organization.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of progressively responsible experience administering enterprise IT infrastructure and systems.
  • Strong experience supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS operating systems within enterprise environments.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory, Azure AD (Entra ID), Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and identity management.
  • Experience administering Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and Intune.
  • Experience managing endpoint platforms such as JAMF, Intune, or Microsoft Endpoint Manager.
  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, routing, VPN, DNS, firewalls, and network troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting enterprise cloud infrastructure and SaaS platforms.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and root cause analysis skills across operating systems, infrastructure, and enterprise applications.
  • Experience implementing system upgrades, migrations, and enterprise infrastructure projects.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Bash, or similar tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high operational standards.
  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and support planned maintenance activities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting hybrid cloud environments including Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V.
  • Familiarity with enterprise monitoring and observability platforms.
  • Experience administering ITSM and asset management platforms such as Jira Service Management and Snipe-IT.
  • Working knowledge of ITIL service management practices including Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management.
  • Industry certifications such as Microsoft Certified, Azure Administrator, CompTIA Server+, Security+, VMware VCP, Cisco, or ITIL Foundation.
  • Experience supporting highly secure or regulated enterprise environments.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer - Autonomy & Software
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Systems Engineer, Autonomy & Software at Shield AI is responsible for solving complex systems engineering challenges associated with the development, integration, and deployment of advanced autonomous systems for defense applications.

This role sits at the intersection of systems engineering, software engineering, and autonomy. The Systems Engineer works across multidisciplinary engineering teams to translate mission and customer needs into system requirements, architectures, interfaces, and verification strategies while maintaining a deep technical understanding of the software and autonomy capabilities being delivered.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in software and autonomy, is comfortable developing and debugging software in C++ and Python, and has significant experience applying systems engineering principles within complex defense programs. They should be equally comfortable working at the system level and diving into technical implementation when required.

What you’ll do

  • Apply systems engineering principles to the development and integration of autonomous systems for defense applications.
  • Translate operational needs, mission objectives, and customer requirements into clear system, subsystem, software, and autonomy requirements.
  • Develop and maintain system architectures, functional decompositions, interface definitions, Interface Control Documents, requirements traceability, and verification strategies.
  • Work closely with autonomy, software, guidance, navigation and control, avionics, hardware, test, and platform engineering teams to ensure successful system integration.
  • Define and manage interfaces between Hivemind Autonomy, vehicle systems, mission systems, sensors, communications, payloads, and external systems.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of the underlying autonomy and software architecture, including how system level requirements translate into software behavior and implementation.
  • Develop software, prototypes, analysis tools, test infrastructure, and engineering utilities using C++ and Python when required to solve integration and system level engineering problems.
  • Use code, simulation, logs, telemetry, and other engineering data to investigate system behavior, diagnose failures, validate assumptions, and support technical decision making.
  • Lead and support system integration activities across simulation, software in the loop, hardware in the loop, ground test, and flight test environments.

Required Qualifications

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience developing, integrating, or delivering complex software intensive systems, preferably within aerospace, defense, robotics, or autonomous systems.
  • Strong software engineering background with hands on experience developing and debugging software in C++ and Python.
  • Experience with autonomous or robotic systems, including familiarity with areas such as perception, planning, estimation, guidance, navigation, controls, or mission autonomy.
  • Strong understanding of systems engineering principles and their application to complex defense systems.
  • Experience developing and managing system and subsystem requirements, including requirements decomposition, allocation, traceability, and verification.
  • Experience developing system architectures, functional architectures, interface definitions, Interface Control Documents, and other system level engineering artifacts.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:
As a Senior Systems Engineer on Shield AI’s next gen UAS program, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and integrating cutting-edge autonomous aircraft systems for national defense. You will lead the technical execution of system architecture, ensuring seamless integration of avionics, autonomy, propulsion, sensor payloads, and mission-critical systems.
 
This position requires a deep understanding of aerospace systems engineering, autonomy, and complex system integration. You will work cross-functionally with teams in hardware, software, autonomy, flight operations, and manufacturing to develop a scalable, mission-ready platform capable of operating in contested environments.
 
Your expertise will be critical in defining system requirements and architectures through model-based systems engineering, conducting trade studies, ensuring compliance with military and aviation standards, and supporting the aircraft through flight testing and operational deployment.

What You'll Do:

  • Perform System Architecture & Design: Develop and refine the system architecture for the next gen UAS, ensuring seamless integration of avionics, autonomy, propulsion, sensor payloads, and mission systems.
  • Define and document system-level behavior, including modes, states, transitions, and fault responses
  • Support safety analyses (FHA, FMEA, FTA) by defining behavior under fault conditions
  • Define and Manage System Requirements: Establish top-level requirements, decompose them into subsystems, and maintain traceability across the development lifecycle.
  • Autonomy & AI Integration: Work closely with autonomy and software teams to integrate AI-driven flight control, decision-making, and mission execution capabilities.
  • Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE): Utilize SysML, DOORS, or other MBSE tools to create digital system models, conduct trade studies, and optimize system performance.
  • Risk Management & Trade Studies: Conduct trade studies to evaluate design alternatives, assess technical risks, and ensure the best engineering solutions for mission effectiveness.
  • Stakeholder & Customer Engagement: Work closely with DoD stakeholders, industry partners, and government agencies to align system capabilities with operational requirements.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with hardware, autonomy, software, propulsion, and flight operations teams to drive seamless system integration and rapid development cycles.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in systems engineering for aerospace, defense, or autonomous aircraft systems.
  • Demonstrated experience defining system behavior logic and operational modes
  • Deep expertise in system architecture, avionics integration, and autonomy-driven flight systems.
  • Proficiency in MBSE, DOORS, SysML, CAMEO, or similar system modeling tools for complex systems design and analysis.
  • Experience with Group 4 or Group 5 UAS, military aircraft, or autonomous airborne platforms.
  • Strong background in flight testing, system integration, and performance validation.
  • Knowledge of DoD acquisition processes, MIL-STDs, FAA airworthiness certification, and airborne system safety standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive complex projects to successful completion.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile development environment with shifting priorities.
  • Worked on developmental program from clean sheet to first flight
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience developing AI-driven autonomy for unmanned aircraft.
  • Expertise in ISR, EW, and advanced sensor integration for airborne platforms.
  • Familiarity with modular open system architectures (MOSA) and Government Reference Architectures (GRA) for defense applications.
  • Prior experience working with defense primes, DoD stakeholders, or government R&D programs.
  • Active Secret or Top Secret clearance (or ability to obtain one).

jobs.descriptionHtml:

Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

As we scale rapidly across EMEA and APJ regions, we’re looking for a highly driven Senior Talent Sourcer who lives and breathes talent discovery - someone who can take a complex, highly specialized needs and translate it into a precision sourcing strategy. You’ll be the go-to expert for market mapping, proactive candidate generation, and pipeline cultivation across our Go-to-Market and Engineering groups.

This isn’t just a "find resumes" role - it’s about building intelligence, relationships, and repeatable systems that fuel our engineering hiring engine. As a Senior Talent Sourcer, you'll serve as a strategic partner to recruiters and hiring leaders while leveraging modern AI tools, market intelligence, and scalable sourcing practices to help us identify and hire world-class engineering talent.

What you'll do:

  • Own the top of funnel: Partner closely with recruiters and hiring leaders to define target profiles and build deep, data-informed sourcing strategies across Go-To-Market, G&A, Electrical, Mechanical, Software, Embedded, AI/ML, Systems, Manufacturing, and other disciplines across the organization.
  • Map the market: Develop comprehensive talent landscapes by company, skillset, geography, and organizational structure; identify hidden talent pools, competitor insights, and emerging talent trends to inform recruiting strategy and workforce planning.
  • Generate and engage: Use advanced Boolean search techniques, sourcing platforms, and creative sourcing channels (LinkedIn Recruiter, SeekOut, HireEZ, ClearanceJobs, GitHub, engineering communities, niche aerospace networks, conferences, referrals, and more) to identify, engage, and attract exceptional technical talent.
  • Build pipelines proactively: Cultivate long-term relationships with passive, cleared, and highly specialized engineering talent to enable just-in-time hiring across strategic programs.
  • Leverage AI to scale sourcing: Design, build, and continuously improve AI-powered sourcing workflows, research agents, and practical automations that increase recruiter productivity, accelerate candidate discovery, enhance market intelligence, and improve operational efficiency.
  • Build repeatable sourcing systems: Use AI tools and workflow automation to create structured market maps, talent intelligence reports, outreach content, sourcing documentation, and scalable recruiting processes that can be leveraged across the Talent Acquisition organization.
  • Be the sourcing SME: Serve as the subject matter expert on technical sourcing by coaching recruiters and hiring managers on market insights, sourcing strategy, talent availability, competitive intelligence, candidate engagement best practices, and emerging recruiting technologies.
  • Partner for impact: Collaborate cross-functionally with Talent Acquisition Operations, Employer Brand, University Recruiting, and Engineering leaders to optimize recruiting strategies, outbound messaging, candidate experience, and operational excellence.
  • Track and iterate: Use recruiting analytics, experimentation, and storytelling to measure sourcing effectiveness, optimize outreach strategies, improve conversion rates, and continuously evolve sourcing practices.

Required qualifications:

  • 5+ years of talent sourcing experience, ideally in aerospace, defense, autonomy, or other complex hardware/software industries.
  • Proven track record in market mapping, competitive intelligence, and candidate generation for highly specialized technical roles.
  • Deep expertise in advanced Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, HireEZ, SeekOut, ClearanceJobs, GitHub, and other modern sourcing platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a consultative partner to recruiters, hiring managers, and senior engineering leaders, influencing hiring strategy through market insights and talent intelligence.
  • Hands-on experience building or leveraging AI-powered sourcing workflows, agentic AI tools, workflow automations, or practical AI solutions that improve recruiting or business processes.
  • Experience building and maintaining long-term relationships with passive, cleared, or niche engineering talent.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills with the ability to engage highly technical candidates and influence stakeholders.
  • Strong judgment, curiosity, and a continuous improvement mindset with the ability to evaluate and adopt emerging AI technologies to improve recruiting outcomes.
  • Highly organized, data-driven, and able to operate autonomously in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience supporting aerospace, robotics, autonomy, AI/ML, or advanced vehicle engineering organizations.
  • Experience navigating export control, ITAR, EAR, or security-cleared recruiting environments.
  • Familiarity with Ashby and recruiting analytics, CRM, or talent intelligence platforms.
  • Experience supporting high-growth, venture-backed technology organizations.
  • Demonstrated passion for staying ahead of emerging recruiting technologies, sourcing methodologies, and AI advancements.
 
Our international teammates receive a comprehensive total rewards package aligned to your country office location. For full details on compensation and benefits, please consult your talent acquisition partner.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

The Demonstration Team - Senior Associate Air Vehicle Operator (AVO) is responsible for planning, executing, and leading domestic and international unmanned aircraft operations in support of customer demonstrations, evaluations, training events, operational exercises, and business development activities. 

This position serves as one of the primary customer-facing representatives of the company and plays a critical role in showcasing the capabilities of the V-BAT system to military, government, and commercial customers worldwide. The successful candidate must consistently demonstrate exceptional aviation judgment, professionalism, technical expertise, and adaptability while operating in dynamic and often austere environments. 

Unlike traditional flight operations, Demonstration Team AVOs are expected to independently execute missions with limited support while simultaneously serving as operators, instructors, maintainers, mission planners, technical advisors, and customer liaisons. Success in this role requires the ability to rapidly solve complex technical and operational problems while maintaining a relentless commitment to safety and customer satisfaction. 

The ideal candidate thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys frequent travel, embraces uncertainty, and is motivated by building customer confidence through exceptional operational execution. 

What you'll do:

  • Customer-Focused Flight Operations- Safely executes complex demonstrations while building customer confidence through professional, disciplined, and mission-focused flight operations.
  • Mission Planning & Operational Leadership- Plans and leads all aspects of flight operations including risk management, airspace coordination, contingency planning, crew coordination, and mission execution.
  • Technical Troubleshooting & Systems Knowledge- Rapidly identifies, diagnoses, and resolves aircraft, payload, datalink, and ground system issues to maximize mission success and aircraft availability.
  • Instruction, Mentorship & Team Development- Develops customers and teammates through classroom instruction, simulator training, live-flight instruction, mentorship, and standardization.
  • Adaptability & Independent Decision-Making- Thrives in rapidly changing domestic and international environments by exercising sound judgment, solving problems independently, and maintaining operational effectiveness under pressure. 

Required Qualifications:

    • Minimum 1,000 documented unmanned flight hours or 250 manned flight hours   

    • Ability to obtain and maintain an FAA Class II Medical Certificate  

    • Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret DoD Security Clearance  

    • Ability to pass required background investigations, drug screenings, and customer medical/dental requirements  

    • Willingness and ability to travel 60–75%, including frequent CONUS and OCONUS deployments  

    • Demonstrated experience operating independently in dynamic, high-tempo, and austere environments  

    • Strong aviation decision-making, operational risk management, and safety mindset  

    • Excellent verbal communication and professional customer engagement skills

Preferred Qualifications:

    • FAA Private Pilot Certificate (PPL) or FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate 

    • FAA Instrument Rating and/or Commercial Pilot Certificate  

    • Previous instructor qualification in manned or unmanned aviation  

    • Prior military aviation or UAS operational experience  

    • Experience supporting DoD, allied, or international military operations  

    • Maritime or shipboard UAS operational experience  

    • Experience leading customer demonstrations, operational evaluations, or flight operations  

    • Experience troubleshooting aircraft, payload, datalink, or ground control systems 

    • Familiarity with ISR payloads, SATCOM, BVLOS operations, and tactical communications  

    • Experience coordinating international deployments, logistics, or expeditionary operations

A Senior Associate V-BAT Operator, AVO, assigned to Field Integration and Test (FIT), supports V-BAT field integration activities and flight operations in CONUS and OCONUS environments. This role supports customer site surveys, system installations, calibration events, aircraft operational checks, training support, and operational handoff activities in coordination with Engineering and Customer Operations teams. 

This position extends beyond traditional AVO duties. FIT AVOs support site survey planning and execution, installation readiness, aircraft and ground system setup, calibration support, and post-calibration operational checks. After calibration activities, the FIT AVO works with Deployment Operations to verify aircraft readiness, confirm operational usability and set deployed operators up for successful customer operations. 

FIT AVOs support DoD, coalition, and international customers in maritime and land-based environments. This includes austere, high-tempo, shipboard, expeditionary, and customer test environments. Senior Associates are expected to model professionalism, enforce safety standards, mentor junior operators, and contribute to system readiness, customer confidence, and mission success.

jobs.title: Senior V-BAT Air Vehicle Operator, Production Flight Test (R4844)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

The Production Flight Test V-BAT Air Vehicle Operator is responsible for safely operating unmanned aircraft systems during production acceptance testing, system validation, troubleshooting, and delivery activities. This role works closely with flight test personnel, engineering, production, quality, maintenance, and program teams to verify that each aircraft meets established performance, configuration, and airworthiness requirements. 

The ideal candidate is a disciplined and technically capable operator who can perform effectively in a fast-paced flight-test environment. This individual must be comfortable working through changing priorities, identifying and documenting aircraft discrepancies, and making sound operational decisions while maintaining safety and procedural compliance. 

What you'll do:

    • Serve as the Air Vehicle Operator during production, acceptance, regression, and troubleshooting flights. 

    • Safely operate the aircraft throughout all phases of flight in accordance with approved procedures, limitations, and test cards. 

    • Conduct mission planning, preflight preparation, system configuration, and post-flight activities. 

    • Review aircraft records, configurations, maintenance status, weather, airspace, and operational risk before flight. 

    • Coordinate with flight test engineers, maintainers, production personnel, and other members of the flight crew. 

    • Identify abnormal system behavior and support real-time troubleshooting during ground and flight operations. 

    • Accurately document flight results, aircraft discrepancies, test-card completion, and operational observations. 

    • Support the creation and disposition of nonconformance reports, corrective actions, and retest requirements. 

    • Participate in flight briefs, debriefs, safety reviews, and operational risk assessments. 

    • Provide clear feedback to engineering and production teams regarding aircraft performance, system functionality, and recurring issues. 

    • Maintain proficiency and qualification on assigned aircraft, ground-control systems, and operating procedures. 

    • Support aircraft delivery, customer acceptance activities, demonstrations, and field operations as required. 

    • Assist with the development and improvement of checklists, test procedures, training materials, and flight-test processes. 

    • Maintain a professional, safety-focused work environment and exercise stop-work authority when unsafe conditions exist. 

    • Work flexible schedules, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, or extended shifts, based on weather and production requirements. 

Required Qualifications:

    • Minimum of 2000 documented unmanned flight hours or 1000 manned flight hours 

    • Experience conducting production acceptance flights, developmental testing, operational testing, or customer acceptance testing. 

    • Knowledge of aircraft maintenance documentation, quality systems, and nonconformance-reporting processes. 

    • Experience operating in controlled, restricted, or special-use airspace.

jobs.title: Senior Vibrations Test Engineer (R5091)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

Do you enjoy working in a dynamic lab environment and contributing to hardware that can directly impact the safety of service members and civilians? Shield AI is looking for a hands-on Vibration Test Engineer to help validate the next generation of intelligent autonomous systems through rigorous dynamic testing.

The Mechanical Test team's mission is to inform and improve Shield AI hardware design by quantifying product performance through custom measurement systems, specialized testing, and rigorous analysis. As a Vibration Test Engineer, you will serve as the team's subject matter expert in vibration and structural dynamics, leading efforts to characterize hardware response, validate analytical models, and ensure products can withstand demanding operational environments.

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about structural dynamics, curious about how complex systems behave under dynamic loading, and excited to solve challenging engineering problems in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. You will partner closely with Mechanical Design, Analysis, Flight Test, Manufacturing, and Reliability teams to develop test strategies, investigate failures, and improve hardware performance throughout the product lifecycle.

Success in this role requires deep technical expertise in vibration testing, strong analytical thinking, exceptional organization, and the ability to communicate complex technical findings to cross-functional engineering teams.

What you'll do:

  • Lead the planning, execution, and analysis of vibration test programs supporting product development, qualification, and flight readiness.
  • Design, build, and deploy instrumented test setups for vibration, modal, structural, and environmental testing using industry-standard measurement equipment.
  • Execute shaker table testing including sine sweep, random vibration, sine-on-random, resonance search, dwell, and shock testing.
  • Perform experimental modal analysis to characterize structural dynamics and validate finite element models.
  • Develop fixture designs and test methodologies that accurately replicate operational loading conditions while minimizing fixture influence.
  • Instrument hardware using accelerometers, strain gauges, force sensors, displacement sensors, and other dynamic measurement systems.
  • Analyze vibration response data using frequency-domain and time-domain techniques to identify resonances, mode shapes, damping characteristics, and potential failure mechanisms.
  • Partner closely with Mechanical Design and Structural Analysis engineers to correlate test results with analytical models and improve future designs.
  • Investigate vibration-related hardware issues, perform root cause analysis, and recommend design improvements.
  • Develop comprehensive test plans, procedures, reports, and technical presentations that clearly communicate results and engineering recommendations.
  • Maintain vibration testing equipment, data acquisition systems, instrumentation, and calibration records.
  • Support environmental qualification testing and other mechanical test activities as needed.

Required qualifications:

  • B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Hands-on experience performing vibration testing of mechanical or aerospace systems through industry, research, internships, or competitive engineering projects.
  • Experience operating electrodynamic shaker systems and associated vibration control software.
  • Experience with accelerometers, signal conditioning, data acquisition systems, and dynamic instrumentation.
  • Working knowledge of structural dynamics, vibration theory, modal analysis, and frequency response functions.
  • Experience performing or supporting experimental modal testing and finite element model correlation.
  • Familiarity with MIL-STD-810 vibration and shock testing or equivalent aerospace qualification standards.
  • Experience interpreting vibration data and identifying resonances, structural response characteristics, and failure modes.
  • Working knowledge of CAD software (NX preferred).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical findings to multidisciplinary teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of technical work, drive projects independently, and deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced engineering environment.
  • Ability to obtain a Secret//Special Access Required (S//SAR) security clearance is desired.

Preferred qualifications:

  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical field with an emphasis in structural dynamics or vibration.
  • Experience designing vibration test fixtures and specialized dynamic test equipment.
  • Experience using vibration control and data acquisition platforms such as Data Physics, Brüel & Kjær (HBK), Crystal Instruments, m+p International, LMS/Simcenter Testlab, or similar systems.
  • Experience with finite element analysis software (ANSYS, Abaqus, Nastran, or equivalent) and test-analysis correlation.
  • Experience with strain gauge testing, digital image correlation (DIC), or other advanced structural measurement techniques.
  • Experience supporting aerospace, defense, robotics, UAV, or other high-reliability hardware development programs.
  • Experience with Design of Experiments (DOE), root cause analysis, and failure investigation.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Engineer, C++ Software - Edge Systems (R5191)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Senior / Staff C++ Software Engineer, Edge Systems to help define and build the software foundations that power autonomous systems operating in demanding real-world environments. 

This role sits within the Edge Systems team, where software meets hardware. You'll solve complex engineering problems spanning Linux edge computing, imaging, sensor integration, mission systems, and autonomy, building software that runs on real hardware in operational environments rather than laboratory prototypes. 

As one of our senior technical contributors, you'll combine hands-on software engineering with technical ownership. You'll influence architecture, mentor engineers, guide technical direction, and help shape the long-term evolution of our edge software platform while remaining close to implementation. 

You will develop modern C++ applications for Linux-based edge compute platforms, including NVIDIA Jetson-class systems, ARM64, and Windows systems. Your work will span sensor integration, imaging pipelines, calibration, diagnostics, deployment, developer tooling, and mission-critical applications that demand high performance, reliability, and maintainability. 

This is an application and systems software role, focused on Linux-based edge computing rather than bare-metal firmware or microcontroller development. 

No two weeks look the same. One day you might be optimising image-processing pipelines on embedded GPUs. The next you could be designing software architecture for future autonomous platforms, integrating new sensors, or collaborating with AI researchers to bring new capabilities into production. 

You'll work alongside highly capable systems, hardware, autonomy, AI, product, and test engineers who enjoy solving difficult problems together. We believe our strongest technical leaders remain hands-on, and we expect our Staff Engineers to continue writing software while multiplying the effectiveness of the engineers around them. 

This position may be hired at Senior or Staff Engineer level depending on experience. Responsibilities and scope will be aligned to the successful candidate. 

What you'll do:

    Technical Leadership

    • Lead the technical direction of significant edge software capabilities spanning edge compute, imaging, sensor integration, and mission systems. 

    • Influence software architecture across multiple projects and engineering teams. 

    • Drive engineering excellence through design reviews, technical standards, and pragmatic engineering practices. 

    • Mentor and coach engineers, helping raise the technical capability of the wider organisation. 

    • Partner with systems, autonomy, AI, and product teams to translate long-term capability into engineering roadmaps. 

    • Identify technical risks early and guide teams toward robust, maintainable solutions. 

    • Balance long-term architectural investment with practical product delivery. 

      • Software Engineering

      • Design, develop, test, and maintain production C++ software for edge systems, imaging systems, mission applications, developer tooling, and automated test infrastructure. 

      • Build user-space Windows and Linux applications for NVIDIA Jetson, ARM64, and other edge compute platforms connected to cameras, sensors, and mission systems. 

      • Integrate RGB, NIR, and thermal cameras alongside GPS, IMU, and other sensors using interfaces such as MIPI CSI, GMSL, Ethernet, serial, or comparable hardware-facing protocols. 

      • Develop calibration, synchronisation, data capture, diagnostics, inspection, and configuration tools for complex sensor systems. 

      • Optimise software for latency, throughput, reliability, power consumption, and thermal performance on constrained edge compute platforms. 

      • Debug challenging issues spanning application software, Linux, networking, hardware interfaces, timing, deployment, and system integration. 

      • Own technical outcomes from ambiguous requirements through design, implementation, integration, verification, and delivery. 

      • Collaborate across systems, hardware, AI, autonomy, product, and test teams to deliver integrated capability. 

       

Required qualifications:

    • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience. 

    • Strong commercial experience developing modern C++ software for Linux. 

    • Demonstrated experience developing user-space applications that interface with cameras, sensors, networking, GPUs, storage, or other hardware through operating system APIs, middleware, or vendor SDKs. 

    • Practical experience developing and debugging software on Linux. 

    • Experience developing complex C++ applications on Linux, Windows, or both. Experience deploying software to Linux-based edge compute platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson or comparable ARM64 systems is highly regarded. 

    • Strong software engineering fundamentals including concurrency, interfaces, memory management, data structures, algorithms, testing, and version control. 

    • Proven ability to diagnose complex issues across software, Linux, networking, timing, hardware integration, and deployment boundaries. 

    • Experience owning technical work from incomplete requirements through design, implementation, integration, verification, and delivery. 

    • Excellent collaboration skills across multidisciplinary engineering teams. 

Preferred qualifications:

    We do not expect candidates to have all of the following. Experience in any of these areas will help you stand out. 

    • Runtime-critical, multi-threaded, or performance-sensitive C++ software. 

    • High-throughput imaging or sensor processing pipelines, including camera integration, ISP tuning, GStreamer, FFmpeg, OpenCV, or similar technologies. 

    • Hardware-accelerated processing on edge compute platforms including NVIDIA Jetson, Qualcomm Snapdragon, CUDA, GPU compute, embedded AI accelerators, or accelerated video processing. 

    • Integration of RGB, NIR, and thermal cameras, GPS, IMU, GPUs, or comparable peripheral hardware. 

    • Robotics, aerospace, defence, autonomy, unmanned systems, automotive, or other mission-critical domains. 

    • Systems architecture, interface design, software decomposition, reliability, maintainability, and testability. 

    • Low-level Linux, vendor SDKs, driver-adjacent debugging, NixOS, edge AI inference, containerisation, or deployment tooling. 

    • Automated testing, simulation, software-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, CI/CD, or deployment infrastructure. 

Additional Experience for Staff Level Engineers:

    While we hire across multiple experience levels, successful Staff Engineer candidates will typically demonstrate several of the following: 

    • Experience defining architecture for large or technically complex software systems. 

    • A track record of influencing technical direction across multiple teams or products. 

    • Proven technical leadership through influence rather than organisational authority. 

    • Experience mentoring senior engineers and helping grow engineering capability across an organisation. 

    • Ownership of long-term technical strategy alongside day-to-day software delivery. 

    • Strong judgement when balancing performance, reliability, maintainability, scalability, and delivery. 

    • Experience establishing engineering standards, reusable frameworks, or software platforms adopted by multiple teams.

Shield AI is seeking an International Aechelon / Simulation Sales Specialist to help drive growth of the Aechelon simulation portfolio across international markets. This role will serve as a specialist seller within GTM, partnering with regional sales leaders and account teams to identify, shape, and advance simulation opportunities with customers and partners. 

The International Aechelon / Simulation Sales Specialist will combine product and market knowledge with strong commercial execution. This person will help position the Aechelon portfolio, support customer engagement, and drive opportunity development across priority international regions. The role is designed for a mission-focused, customer-facing professional who can work across functions, support complex pursuits, and help translate simulation capabilities into customer value. 

Why This Role Matters 

Simulation is a key growth lever for Shield AI and an important part of how customers train, rehearse, and prepare for mission success. As Shield AI integrates Aechelon and scales its simulation go-to-market efforts, this role will provide dedicated specialist sales support to regional teams and help accelerate growth in international markets. 

This is an overlay-style role for someone who can combine solution selling, customer engagement, pursuit support, and strong internal collaboration. Success in this position requires ownership, responsiveness, commercial judgment, and the ability to operate effectively across teams, regions, and time zones. 

What you will do:

    Specialist Sales Support 

    • Serve as the specialist sales resource for the Aechelon simulation portfolio across priority international markets. 

      • Partner with regional sales leaders, account owners, and business development teams to identify, qualify, and advance simulation opportunities. 

        • Support account strategy, opportunity planning, and customer engagement efforts related to the Aechelon portfolio. 

          • Help drive pipeline development for simulation opportunities and maintain visibility into key pursuits, risks, and next steps. 

            • Customer and Partner Engagement 

            • Participate in customer meetings, capability discussions, demonstrations, and follow-up actions to help progress opportunities. 

              • Articulate the value of Aechelon’s simulation offerings in a clear, mission-relevant, and customer-oriented way. 

                • Support relationship development with international defense, government, and partner stakeholders. 

                  • Help connect customer requirements to product capabilities in coordination with sales, product, and technical teams. 

                    • Pursuit and Deal Support 

                    • Support the development of customer-facing materials, presentations, proposals, and competitive positioning for simulation opportunities. 

                      • Coordinate with internal teams to support demos, strategic pursuits, bids, and executive engagements. 

                        • Contribute market, customer, and competitive insight to improve positioning and increase win probability. 

                          • Help drive disciplined follow-up and execution across active opportunities. 

                            • Cross-Functional Alignment 

                            • Partner closely with GTM, International, Product, Marketing, and Operations to support simulation growth initiatives. 

                              • Provide field feedback to improve messaging, enablement, campaign focus, and product positioning. 

                                • Contribute to business reporting, opportunity updates, and operating cadence as needed. 

                                  • Help ensure internal alignment on priorities, customer engagement plans, and support needs. 

                                    • What Success Looks Like 

                                    • International simulation opportunities are identified early, well supported, and advanced with clear coordination and momentum. 

                                      • Regional sales teams have strong specialist support for Aechelon-related customer discussions, positioning, and pursuits. 

                                        • Customer interactions clearly connect simulation capabilities to training, rehearsal, readiness, and mission outcomes. 

                                          • Cross-functional teams are aligned in support of international simulation growth priorities.

        • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders. 

          • Commercial acumen and the ability to position technical solutions in terms of customer value and mission relevance. 

            • Strong organizational skills and follow-through, including the ability to manage multiple active opportunities and stakeholder needs. 

              • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed. 

Preferred Qualifications:

    • Experience in simulation, training, mission systems, enterprise software, autonomy, aerospace, or defense technology. 

      • Familiarity with international sales motions, government or defense procurement, and partner-driven growth models. 

        • Experience working in a specialist seller or overlay role in support of regional sales teams. 

          • Background supporting multi-region customers, channel partners, or strategic international pursuits.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

We are seeking skilled, experienced embedded software engineers with relevant experience in C++ in embedded systems to join our X-BAT Embedded Software Team focused on developing complex avionics software that merges hardware and embedded applications for cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV). 

The Embedded Software Engineer works with in a high pace environment with a cross-functional team of program stakeholders, electrical engineers, Guidance, Navigation and Controls (GNC) engineers, systems engineers, test engineers and the autonomy team, to design and develop software systems which utilize modern aerospace sensors, state-of-the-art UAV avionics. 

What you'll do:

  • Develop high-quality C/C++ code tailored specifically for X-Bat aircraft, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and safety.  
  • Leading cross-functional teams to create systems of software features to implement advanced robotic avionics capabilities. 
  • Own complex software capabilities from design to production. 
  • Participate in architecture, design, and code reviews.  
  • Integrate software from multiple departments to include firmware, software test and verification, Autonomy AI, and Ground Control Stations (GCS)  
  • Develop software systems to implement and integrate interfaces to modern avionics sensors, sub-systems, and payloads  
  • Facilitate the design process for updates to the software system architecture   
  • Use modern software development tools and processes to capture our existing architecture and design future architectures  
  • Collaborating to define and extend systems engineering processes   
  • Report status, risks, accomplishments, expectations to senior leadership     
  • Design and implement systems capable of conducting tests across various environments, including virtualized hardware and hardware-in-the-loop simulations, to facilitate thorough evaluation of software functionality and performance.  
  • Develop innovative tools to enhance the frequency and reliability of software deployment, test execution, and data analysis within a continuous integration and release system, fostering improved efficiency and productivity in software development workflows.  
  • Create prototypes to validate critical design concepts and assess technical limitations, providing tangible evidence of feasibility and informing decision-making processes.  

Required qualifications:

  • Strong embedded software development experience in C/C++.  
  • Strong understanding of Oriented Object Programming and modern C++ features. 
  • Strong knowledge of embedded software, BSPs or other systems software components. 
  • Strong understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, and network protocols fundamentals. 
  • Demonstrated track record of assuming ownership over development processes and features and delivering outstanding outcomes. 
  • Experience producing high-quality technical documentation, including architecture, detailed designs, and test plans. 
  • Proven track record of successfully shipping products, showcasing the ability to navigate through development cycles, overcome obstacles, and deliver high-quality solutions to meet project deadlines and exceed client expectations in a fast-paced environment   
  • Proactively identify opportunities for improvement within software development projects, demonstrating initiative to propose and implement innovative solutions that enhance efficiency, quality, and overall project success and X-Bat reliability   
  • B.S., M.S, PhD degree in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science or STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) discipline, such as Aerospace, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering.
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Proven background in thriving within fast-paced environments, within startup or R&D settings. 
  • Proven experience in development of military aircrafts.  
  • Compliance with DO-178C 
  • Demonstrated adaptability, agility, and the ability to innovate under pressure to meet dynamic project demands and drive successful outcomes. 
  • Familiar with FPGA development using SystemVerilog.   
  • Real Time Operating System (RTOS) experience.

jobs.title: Software Engineer C++ (R5716)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

This role sits within the Edge Systems team, where software meets hardware. You will contribute to production software spanning Linux edge computing, imaging, sensor integration, diagnostics, deployment, and mission applications. Your work will run on real systems, not only in simulations or laboratory prototypes. 

You will develop modern C++ software for Linux-based edge compute platforms, including NVIDIA Jetson-class and ARM64 systems. You will integrate sensors, diagnose system behaviour, improve performance, and deliver reliable software as part of a multidisciplinary team, with scope and autonomy matched to your experience. 

This is an application and systems software role focused on Linux-based edge computing. It is not primarily a bare-metal firmware or microcontroller-development role. 

Linux is the primary deployment environment, but some supporting tools may run on or interface with Windows-based systems, making cross-platform experience valuable. 

We welcome recent graduates and engineers with a few years of relevant experience. You do not need to match every technology below. We value sound fundamentals, practical curiosity, and evidence that you enjoy solving software-and-hardware problems. 

What you'll do:

    • Develop, test, debug, and maintain C++ software for edge systems, imaging systems, mission applications, diagnostics, and developer tools. 

    • Build applications for NVIDIA Jetson, and other edge compute platforms connected to cameras, sensors, and mission systems. 

    • Contribute to calibration, synchronisation, data capture, observability, inspection, and configuration tools for complex sensor systems. 

    • Investigate issues across application software, Linux, networking, hardware interfaces, timing, deployment, and system integration, collaborating across disciplines when problems cross domain boundaries. 

    • Write clear, maintainable code and participate in code reviews, automated testing, documentation, and team design discussions. 

    • Collaborate with systems, hardware, AI, autonomy, product, and test engineers to deliver integrated capability. 

    • Own well-defined components and technical problems, taking on broader and more complex work as your skills and domain knowledge grow. 

Required qualifications:

    • A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 

    • A solid foundation in C++, demonstrated through university work, internships, personal or open-source projects, or industry experience. 

     

    • Practical experience developing, building, or debugging software on Linux or Windows, with an interest in working primarily on Linux-based edge systems. 

    • Understanding of core software-engineering concepts such as memory and resource management, data structures, interfaces, testing, and version control. 

    • Some experience building software that interacts with hardware, sensors, networks, robotics, imaging systems, or other physical devices. 

    • A methodical approach to debugging and a willingness to investigate problems beyond a single function or source file. 

    • The ability to communicate clearly, seek feedback, and collaborate effectively with engineers from different disciplines. 

    • Curiosity, initiative, and a desire to grow into broader technical ownership over time. 

Clearance & Export Control Requirements:

  • Eligibility to obtain an Australian NV1 (Secret) clearance.
  • Ability to access and handle ITAR‑controlled and Australian export‑controlled technical data.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Autonomy Behaviors (R5202)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

The Autonomy Capabilities Team develops functionality to automate single- and multi-agent teams of platforms in pursuit of mission objectives and acts as a central discipline-aligned focal-point for encouraging consistent usage of technical approaches across business portfolios.  This team operates at all levels of the command-and-control hierarchy (from advanced control laws, through motion planning, and up to advanced tactical behaviors and multi-agent coordination) and across a multitude of mission sets, platform types, and operational domains (e.g., air, sea, space).  The team puts a strong emphasis on both fundamentals (e.g., aircraft kinematics/dynamics, trajectory design, optimization, information fusion, efficient algorithms, etc.) and software integration skillsets (e.g. structures, protocols, threading, interface management, etc.) to bring market-differentiating capabilities to customers that seamlessly operate within their integration contexts. 

This position is perfect for an individual who enjoys solving complex problems across a diverse set of programs and integration contexts. An ideal candidate is expected to address operational system needs through a multitude of advanced methodologies that blend traditional control system approaches with advanced optimization. Developed solutions are expected to be integrated into real-world platforms with near-term program impacts and rewards and so balancing theory with practice and rigorous implementation is paramount.  

What You'll Do:

  • Implement tactical autonomy software features that enable unmanned platforms to perform complex missions across air, land, sea, and space domains
  • Develop and test behaviors supporting coordination, target engagement, reconnaissance, and survivability in contested scenarios
  • Participate in the software development lifecycle, including implementation, testing, debugging, and supporting verification and validation efforts
  • Collaborate with senior engineers to integrate software components with broader system elements (e.g., sensor processing, communications, and actuation)
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following established engineering standards and team practices
  • Support integration and testing across simulation and real-world environments
  • Work with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and support successful feature delivery
  • Continue building expertise in software engineering, autonomy, and robotics systems
  • Travel up to 20% to support testing, integration, and collaboration with partner teams

Required Qualifications:

  • BS in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in production-level C++ software development
  • 2-3 years of experience in one or more of the following: software sub-system scheduling and integration, behavior planning, task and resource allocation, motion planning, optimization, or flight controls
  • Experience with collaborative software development tools for version control, issue tracking, code reviews, release management
  • Ability to contribute to the design, development, and integration of complex software systems as part of a multi-disciplinary team
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills and ability to learn new technologies in a fast-paced environment
  • Willingness to collaborate closely with teammates and support team objectives
  • Interest in growing technical skills and, over time, providing guidance to more junior engineers
  • Desire to work in a highly collaborative, fast paced, and mission-driven environment
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Exposure to systems operating at different technology readiness levels (TRLs) through academic, research, or internship experience
  • Experience in the delivery of a military mission system
  • Familiarity with mission systems integration concepts, testing, or demonstrations
  • Experience (academic or project-based) in one or more of the following areas:
  • Motion planning, behavior planning, or multi-agent coordination
  • Expose to autonomy, control, or decision-making systems
