jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

The Autonomy Capabilities Team develops functionality to automate single- and multi-agent teams of platforms in pursuit of mission objectives and acts as a central discipline-aligned focal-point for encouraging consistent usage of technical approaches across business portfolios.  This team operates at all levels of the command-and-control hierarchy (from advanced control laws, through motion planning, and up to advanced tactical behaviors and multi-agent coordination) and across a multitude of mission sets, platform types, and operational domains (e.g., air, sea, space).  The team puts a strong emphasis on both fundamentals (e.g., aircraft kinematics/dynamics, trajectory design, optimization, information fusion, efficient algorithms, etc.) and software integration skillsets (e.g. structures, protocols, threading, interface management, etc.) to bring market-differentiating capabilities to customers that seamlessly operate within their integration contexts. 

This position is perfect for an individual who enjoys solving complex problems across a diverse set of programs and integration contexts. An ideal candidate is expected to address operational system needs through a multitude of advanced methodologies that blend traditional control system approaches with advanced optimization. Developed solutions are expected to be integrated into real-world platforms with near-term program impacts and rewards and so balancing theory with practice and rigorous implementation is paramount.  

About the Job:

    Focusing on the maritime portfolio, you’ll be creating autonomy capabilities for USVs, UUVs, and cooperating UAVs that enable them to perform advanced single- and multi-agent teaming missions beyond conventional motion planning and waypoint following.  The functionality you add will enable teams to use their diverse payloads and maneuvering characteristics to search for, localize, and pursue targets while avoiding sensed threats and obstacles that pose a risk to platform safety.  In many of these applications, you’ll have the opportunity to build capabilities from the ground up and be the first to integrate them onto new platforms.  You’ll traditionally start with shorter-term R&D efforts or aligned customer programs but with the intent that successful efforts will grow into larger, multi-year programs.  
     
    As a Staff Engineer, you will lead the technical delivery of complex autonomy capabilities and demonstrate the ability to operate in significantly more grey space than more junior engineers, helping customers shape their requirements, define technical approaches for the team, and drive technical execution throughout the development process.  You will combine your deep technical expertise with systems-level thinking to deliver scalable and operationally ready autonomy solutions. 

What you'll do:

    • Robust Motion Planning – Automate unmanned surface vehicle (USV) and/or unmanned underwater vehicle (UUV) maneuvering through advanced motion planning and adherence to safety constraints including keep-out volumes, cooperative and uncooperative vehicles, and depth limitations 

    • Localization and Tracking – Employ cutting edge approaches for passive and active localization by defining fusion modalities, sensor requirements, and observability-aware maneuvering capabilities to maximize information gleaned from single- or multi-agent sensor networks 

    • Safe Maritime Operations – Keep vehicle safety as a central focus within autonomous behavior architectures to provide run-time assurance, ensure COLREGS adherence, and build operator trust in advanced mission autonomy 

    • Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Collaboration – Develop distributed optimization and task allocation approaches for heterogenous teaming in order to accomplish mission objectives by maximally utilizing the diverse capabilities of agents to overall team advantage 

    • Rigorous Software Development – Develop high-performance software modules that are well-tested, have clear interfaces and span-of-control, and are ready for mid-to-high Technology Readiness Level (TRL) insertions 

    • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross-functional teams including perception, planning, simulation, hardware, and operational test to ensure seamless integration of autonomy solutions on real-world platforms 

    • Deployment & Test Support – Deploy autonomy capabilities to real surface vehicles, supporting integration and demonstration events as well as analysis of mission logs to verify software performance and validate system operational effect 

    • R&D and Road-mapping – Contribute to autonomy roadmaps by researching and prototyping new algorithms, identifying tactical capability gaps, and proposing novel solutions that advance Shield AI’s mission 

    • Travel Requirement – Members of this team typically travel around 25% of the year (to different office locations, customer sites, and flight integration events). 

Required Qualifications:

  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, and/or similar degree, or equivalent practical experience
  • Typically requires a minimum of 7 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or 4 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as C++ and Python, and familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS).
  • Significant background in robotics technologies related to motion planning, behavior modeling, decision-making, or autonomous system design. 
  • Significant experience with unmanned system technologies and accompanying algorithms (ideally in the space domain specifically) 
  • Experience with simulation tools and environments (e.g., AFSIM, NGTS) for testing and validation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and optimize system performance.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment.
  • Ability to obtain a SECRET clearance. 

Preferred Qualifications:

    • Experience in multiple aerospace domains (e.g., air, land, sea, space) 

    • Experience across a breadth of methodologies from classical control through optimization and applied ML/RL 

    • Background in collaborative behaviors and swarm robotics 

    • Familiarity with domain-relevant DoD or government programs 

    • Hands-on experience supporting integration events, customer demos, and/or live exercises

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:
Are you a passionate and innovative engineer looking to help develop state-of-the-art AI and robotics products? Are you eager to make a positive difference in the world? Do you want to work alongside mission-driven and values-focused teammates? Shield AI is just the place for you!  
 
The Hivemind Quality team is committed to ensuring our autonomy platform delivers a seamless developer experience and enables customers to build world-class autonomous systems. We focus on integrating, validating, and continuously improving the Hivemind ecosystem—spanning autonomy behaviors, sensor processing, multi-agent coordination, ground-control systems, and embedded platforms. Our mission is to ensure that autonomy developers can efficiently build, test, and deploy autonomous applications that meet real-world mission objectives. 
 
We are seeking an experienced Software Integration Engineer passionate about autonomy development. In this role, you will become a power user of the Hivemind SDK, deeply understanding its capabilities and identifying gaps from a customer perspective. You will develop and validate customer use cases, evaluate the ease of use for autonomy developers, and provide actionable feedback to Engineering and Product teams. You will play a critical role in integrating new autonomy capabilities into the platform, assessing feature completeness, and anticipating novel customer workflows and edge cases. This position bridges the gap between engineering development and real-world autonomy applications—ensuring our platform empowers customers to build reliable, mission-ready autonomous systems. 

What you'll do:

  • Become a systems integration expert for autonomous robotics: Develop deep expertise in our AI-powered autonomy stack.
  • Learn to configure, deploy, and integrate multi-agent systems across simulation, hardware-in-the-loop, and flight platforms.
  • Understand the full system end-to-end—from sensor inputs to autonomous behaviors.
  • Integrate new capabilities into the autonomy stack: Collaborate cross-functionally with development teams to bring autonomy algorithms, perception pipelines, middleware, and platform interfaces into the integrated product. Ensure seamless interoperability between components.
  • Enable platform bring-up and validation: Lead the integration of autonomy software onto new robotic hardware platforms.
  • Configure sensor drivers, communication interfaces, and platform adapters to enable full autonomy stack functionality on prototype and production vehicles.
  • Develop integration tooling & infrastructure: Architect and implement integration frameworks, deployment scripts, and configuration management tools that streamline bringing new capabilities into Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), and flight environments.
  • Support cross-platform compatibility: Work with other integration engineers to ensure the autonomy stack operates reliably across all supported platforms, operating systems, and deployment configurations. Identify and resolve integration issues across system boundaries.
  • Analyze system behavior and root-cause issues: Evaluate system logs, telemetry, and rosbag data to diagnose integration defects. Collaborate with developers to isolate issues to specific subsystems and drive resolution. Create analysis tooling to accelerate debugging.
  • Optimize integration workflows and CI/CD: Partner with DevOps teams to streamline integration pipelines, reduce build-to-deploy cycle times, and ensure robust continuous integration of new features. Define integration checkpoints and criteria for release readiness.
  • Validate system requirements and interface contracts: Work with engineers to ensure integrated capabilities meet product requirements and interface specifications. Assist in developing tooling to verify end-to-end system compliance and traceability.

Required qualifications:

  • Typically requires a minimum of 7 years of related experience with a bachelor’s degree in CS, Comp Eng, Robotics, or a related field; or 6 years and a master’s degree; or 4 years with a PhD.  
  • Proficiency in programming languages including Python or C++.  
  • Experience with autonomous systems or server applications or middleware.  
  • Demonstrated experience designing integration workflows, communicating system dependencies, and triaging and reporting integration defects across subsystem boundaries.
  • Proficiency with simulation tools and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing environments.  
  • Strong expertise with CI/CD pipelines.   
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proven track record of delivering high-quality software solutions.  
  • Excellent communication skills, capable of collaborating effectively across various teams and presenting to customers or technical leadership.  

Preferred qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience building complex systems with a strong understanding of software architecture and design principles.   
  • Experience with hardware or embedded systems.   
  • Expert knowledge of Python.  
  • Experience with ROS.   
  • Experience with white box testing  
  • Familiarity with networking, operating-systems, and radio communications.  
  • Experience designing automated tooling for testing for GUI applications.  
  • Experience designing automated tooling for testing server applications.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

This role is for a Computer Vision C++ Engineer to support the development of real-time perception capabilities for Shield AI's autonomous systems.

The Computer Vision Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and integrating advanced computer vision algorithms into high-performance C++ software pipelines. The role will focus on building custom perception capabilities from the ground up, with an emphasis on real-time performance, reliability, and deployment in edge compute environments. This position is required to increase the team's capacity and technical depth in real-time computer vision, image processing, and applied machine learning.

The successful candidate will bring strong C++ software engineering skills, experience developing high-performance or real-time systems, and a deep understanding of computer vision fundamentals. They should be capable of translating research concepts into deployable software and comfortable working on bespoke algorithms rather than relying only on existing libraries. Experience with areas such as camera calibration, multi-view geometry, geospatial registration, 3D reconstruction, image rectification, sensor alignment, coordinate transformations, or target localization would be highly valuable.

The role will also support the development of geometry-based computer vision pipelines, including applications such as camera modelling, intrinsic and extrinsic calibration, image-to-world projection, geolocation from imagery, visual registration, and multi-sensor spatial alignment. Familiarity with photogrammetry, epipolar geometry, bundle adjustment, terrain or map-based registration, and deployment of geometry algorithms into real-time C++ systems would be beneficial. Candidates with a Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Robotics, Computer Vision, Geomatics, Photogrammetry, or a related field would be well aligned with the technical needs of the team, though strong applied industry experience is also highly relevant.

Required qualifications:

  • Degree in Computer Vision, Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field.
  • Deep proficiency in C++, with proven experience developing software in high-performance, real-time environments.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing custom computer vision algorithms from scratch, rather than exclusively applying existing libraries.
  • Solid foundational understanding of computer vision, image processing, and machine learning principles.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, performance optimization, and version control.
  • Proven ability to own technical work from ambiguous requirements through algorithm design, implementation, integration, and delivery.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary cross-functional teams, including AI experts, robotics engineers, and optical engineers, to deliver reliable edge solutions. 

Preferred qualifications:

    We do not expect candidates to have all of the following. Experience in any of these areas will help you stand out.
  • Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience with object detection, target tracking, 3D reconstruction, SLAM, camera calibration, or behaviour analysis.
  • Background in automated video surveillance or other related real-time vision systems.
  • Familiarity with industry-standard vision toolkits, such as OpenCV.
  • Exposure to deep learning methodologies for image classification, recognition, or sequence modelling.
  • Practical experience integrating deep learning models into broader computer vision systems for real-time deployment scenarios.
  • Previous experience in the Defence sector, autonomous unmanned systems, or similar mission-critical domains.

You will own the analysis pipelines, tooling, standards, and metrics that help the team understand fleet-wide system performance derived from information from software and hardware systems. You will work closely with DevOps, Flight Software, Flight Test, Production, Quality, and Operations teams to turn complex aircraft data into actionable engineering insight.

  • Conduct fleet-wide studies to identify trends in hardware quality, system performance, reliability, and operational behavior 
  • Analyze flight-critical sensor performance, GNSS-denied navigation performance, communications behavior, and other aircraft subsystems that are critical to mission success 
  • Standardize the team’s analysis methods across online tools, Jupyter notebooks, automated Python scripts, and legacy Matlab workflows 
  • Define best practices for analysis methods, data review, documentation, validation, reproducibility, and contribution workflows

  • Work with Software, GNC, Embedded, Flight Test, Systems, Production, Quality, and Operations teams to define metrics that reflect aircraft performance and product health 
  • Support anomaly investigations, root-cause analysis, release readiness, production quality improvements, and customer-impacting fleet investigations with rigorous data analysis 
  • Mentor engineers on effective data analysis practices and raise the quality bar for data-driven engineering decisions across the V-BAT team

  • Experience working with large, messy datasets from deployed products, test events, simulations, production systems, or operational environments

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to influence cross-functional engineering, production, quality, and operations teams

  • Experience with anomaly detection, trend analysis, statistical process control, reliability analysis, regression detection, or automated validation of complex systems

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Data Platform (R5659)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

We are looking for a Staff Data Platform Engineer to help define and build the data foundation of the AI Factory. 

The Data Platform provides a unifying, knowledge-graph-centered API layer for human and agentic workflows. It connects configurations, requirements, software versions, test executions, files, signals, training data, and results through stable identities and typed relationships. It also provides consistent access to the storage and compute systems behind those data products. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will design platform architecture, implement production software, evaluate storage and compute technologies, establish data-modeling patterns, and work directly with teams collecting and consuming mission-critical data. Success requires balancing developer productivity, semantic clarity, operational reliability, system performance, portability, and long-term maintainability. 

What you'll do:

  • Develop a unifying Graph API: Lead the architecture and implementation of the knowledge graph and multi-modal API layer that serves as the backbone for human, service, and agentic workflows. 
  • Own DataOps infrastructure: Research, optimize, and maintain the storage, indexing, query, ingestion, and compute infrastructure used throughout the data lifecycle. 
  • Establish best-practices: Establish durable, best-practice patterns for schema modeling, relationships, lineage, and schema evolution. 
  • Turbocharge agentic data access: Build APIs that enable agents to retrieve structured, connected, and explainable context rather than relying only on keyword or vector similarity. 
  • Develop reference architectures: Establish recommended storage and compute profiles, deployment patterns, benchmarks, and operational guidance for both internal and customer-managed infrastructure. 
  • Advise downstream teams: Partner directly with autonomy, ML, test, infrastructure, product, and customer-facing teams to turn real workflows into reusable platform capabilities from modeling to integrations. 
  • Build first-party integrations: Deliver integrations that make important data easy to collect and aggregate, including data produced by simulations, test infrastructure, training systems, and edge devices. 
  • Improve developer experience: Create self-service APIs, SDKs, tools, examples, and diagnostics that make correct data modeling and ingestion the easiest path. 
  • Drive technical direction: Evaluate emerging data and AI infrastructure technologies, make principled build-versus-buy decisions, and guide implementation across team boundaries. 
  • Raise operational quality: Establish expectations for observability, performance, reliability, security, data integrity, disaster recovery, and lifecycle management. 

Key outcomes:

  • Human and agentic workflows use one coherent API for discovering data, traversing relationships, and accessing specialized payloads. 
  • Teams spend their time deciding how to model and use data rather than repeatedly deciding where and how to store it. 
  • Data produced at the edge, in simulation, during testing, and in training flows into reusable platform models with minimal integration friction. 
  • Portable and operational platform capabilities across all deployment environments. 
  • Downstream teams can adopt the platform through stable APIs and SDKs instead of custom point-to-point integrations. 

Required qualifications:

  • Significant experience designing and operating distributed data solutions, storage systems, or data-intensive backend services. 
  • Strong software engineering skills and a record of delivering production systems in languages such as Go and Python. 
  • Deep understanding of data modeling, API design, schema evolution, identity, consistency, indexing, query planning, and data lifecycle concerns. 
  • Experience working across multiple storage modalities, such as relational or graph databases, object storage, analytical or columnar systems, and file storage. 
  • Experience designing reliable ingestion and access paths for high-volume or operationally important data. 
  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes, Linux, networking, security, storage, observability, and distributed-systems fundamentals. 
  • Experience deploying data infrastructure across cloud or customer-managed environments using modern Infrastructure as Code and platform engineering practices. 
  • Ability to evaluate technologies through prototypes, benchmarks, operational requirements, and total lifecycle cost rather than feature lists alone. 
  • Experience defining architecture and technical standards while remaining hands-on in implementation and debugging. 
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with ML researchers, autonomy engineers, test teams, platform engineers, and product stakeholders. 
  • Clear technical communication and the ability to make complex data architecture understandable to both specialists and downstream users. 

Bonus qualifications and relevant technologies:

    Experience in any of the following is beneficial but not required: 
  • Experience with specialized modern databases (eg graph, OLAP, etc...)  
  • Graph-backed retrieval, agent tooling, structured RAG, provenance-aware context construction, or explainable retrieval systems. 
  • S3-compatible APIs, cloud object storage, content-addressable storage, multipart transfer, or large-file lifecycle management. 
  • Apache Arrow, Parquet, columnar formats, time-series data, or high-performance analytical query systems. 
  • OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, WebSockets, generated SDKs, and long-lived public API contracts. 
  • Kubernetes storage and data operators, Terraform, Helm, GitOps, and repeatable platform distribution. 
  • Distributed execution technologies such as Ray and experience connecting workflow execution to data lineage and artifact management. 
  • Streaming and ingestion technologies such as Kafka, NATS, Redpanda, or comparable event-driven systems. 
  • Data and analysis in a robotics or AI domain. 
  • ML data lifecycle systems, experiment tracking, dataset management, evaluation infrastructure, feature or artifact stores, and model versioning. 
  • Observability tools, distributed tracing, and benchmarking. 
  • Data security, authorization, governance, retention, classification, and auditability across shared platforms. 

Why join us:

    The Data Platform is foundational to how Shield AI builds, evaluates, certifies, and improves autonomy. This role offers the opportunity to shape both a core internal platform and a reference architecture delivered into demanding customer environments. 

    Your work will determine how effectively engineers and agents can find trusted context, understand provenance, aggregate data from distributed systems, and turn operational experience into better intelligent systems. You will work at the intersection of data systems, AI infrastructure, autonomy, distributed computing, and defense while helping establish the architecture that supports the next generation of mission-critical AI development.

Founded in 2015, Shield AI is building intelligent, autonomous aircraft that protect service members and civilians around the world. As we scale production, we're building more than a factory—we're building an AI-native manufacturing ecosystem that will define the future of aerospace production. 

Build the AI Factory of the Future

From implementing our Manufacturing Execution System (MES) to deploying AI-powered manufacturing solutions, you'll help define how autonomous aircraft are built for years to come.

Job Description:

At Shield AI, we are developing autonomy solutions that enhance mission effectiveness and operational decision-making. Our Vision Systems / Hivemind Vision portfolio applies computer vision and AI/ML technologies to help defense, government, and commercial customers gain actionable information from optical sensors. 

As a Vision Systems Demonstration & Training Specialist on the demonstration and training team, you will support customer demonstrations, operator training, and operational adoption across the portfolio. Working closely with product management, engineering, and business development, you will help customers understand, evaluate, and effectively employ our capabilities. 

This role requires operational credibility, technical fluency, and a strong instinct for teaching and customer engagement. The ideal candidate understands the demands facing sensor operators and intelligence teams—including real-time workload, competing mission priorities, and the challenges of integrating multiple sensors and information sources—and brings that perspective to every demonstration, training event, and customer interaction. 

What you'll do:

    Demonstration & Operational Support: 

  • Plan and execute customer flight plans for demonstrations that connect product capabilities to specific mission needs and operational workflows. 
  • Prepare and operate Vision Systems software, sensor interfaces, and associated mission equipment during demonstrations, exercises, and evaluations. 
  • Support equipment readiness, system configuration, connectivity checks, and field troubleshooting in coordination with engineering and flight operations personnel. 
  • Apply crew resource management and operational risk management principles to event preparation, execution, and debriefing. 
  • Assist in development of realistic scenarios, demonstration plans, briefing materials, and measures of success in coordination with product management and business development. 

    • Training & Standardization: 

  • Develop and deliver operator training, practical exercises, and supporting materials for customers and internal teams. 
  • Teach system operation, effective employment, and capability limitations in the context of the customer’s mission. 
  • Assess operator proficiency and adapt instruction to different experience levels and operational backgrounds. 
  • Develop and maintain procedures, checklists, instructional guides, and standardized demonstration materials. 
  • Capture lessons learned and incorporate them into training content and operational practices. 

    • Customer Engagement & Adoption: 

  • Build trusted relationships with operators, instructors, intelligence personnel, and customer program teams. 
  • Understand customer challenges and help translate them into practical approaches for employing Vision Systems capabilities. 
  • Support customer onboarding, operational familiarization, and follow-up engagement after demonstrations and training. 
  • Communicate clearly with operational, technical, and leadership audiences, setting realistic expectations for system performance and employment. 
  • Help customers understand how product outputs fit into existing mission systems, tactical applications, and intelligence workflows. 

    • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Product Feedback: 

  • Translate customer observations into clear descriptions of operational needs, usability issues, and opportunities for improvement. 
  • Partner with product management and engineering to evaluate new capabilities and validate them against representative operational scenarios. 
  • Support integration and field-test activities through mission-system operation, data collection, issue documentation, and operational feedback. 
  • Contribute to concepts of operation, application guidance, and customer-facing technical materials. 
  • Coordinate with business development and marketing to ensure demonstrations and messaging accurately represent product capabilities and operational value. 

Required qualifications:

  • Significant experience in airborne ISR sensor operations, operational intelligence support, or a closely related mission-system or field applications role. 
  • Practical understanding of EO/IR sensor employment, particularly gimballed sensors and full-motion video, including real-time task management, crew coordination, and operation alongside other intelligence sensors. 
  • Understanding of ISR collection and processing, exploitation, and dissemination (PED), including how sensor outputs support operational decisions. 
  • Working familiarity with mission-system interfaces, tactical applications, communications networks, and data links used to exchange sensor information and intelligence products. 
  • Familiarity with joint ISR collection and dynamic targeting. 
  • Understanding of crew resource management (CRM) and operational risk management (ORM). 
  • Demonstrated ability to instruct, mentor, or deliver effective operational and technical briefings. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to both technical and operational audiences. 
  • Strong interpersonal skills, sound judgment, and demonstrated empathy for end users. 
  • Ability to learn new software and mission systems, troubleshoot operational issues, and work independently during customer engagements. 
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally for demonstrations, training, exercises, and customer support. 
    • Relevant military, contractor, or industry experience may substitute for formal academic qualifications. 

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience as an airborne sensor operator in manned and unmanned ISR platforms, maritime patrol, special operations, or comparable multi-sensor mission environments. 
  • Instructor, evaluator, or standardization experience, including development of curricula, qualification standards, or operating procedures. 
  • Experience supporting joint or special operations customers through military service or government-contracted ISR programs. 
  • Experience GRP 1, 2 and 3 UAS on platforms such as the MC-12, U-28, AC-130, P-8, or comparable contractor-operated ISR aircraft. 
  • Aviation safety experience or comparable responsibility for safety programs, operational risk assessment, and incident prevention. 
  • Experience employing EO/IR sensors alongside radar, signals intelligence, or other collection systems. 
  • Experience integrating sensors or mission systems on airborne platforms, or supporting operational test and evaluation. 
  • Customer-facing experience with a sensor, mission-system, or defense technology provider. 
  • Familiarity with automated target detection and recognition, computer vision, or multi-sensor fusion applications.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Flight Test (R6064)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

As a Hivemind Solutions Staff Integration & Flight Test Engineer (ACP Programs), you will serve as a key contributor for the integration, verification, and flight test of Hivemind AI Pilot capabilities on Group 5 UAS/Autonomous Collaborative Platforms (ACP). 

You will translate program objectives into executable integration and flight test plans across multiple test environments.  Using disciplined test, analysis, and feedback methodologies, you will drive rapid capability maturation while maintaining rigorous safety, configuration control, and mission assurance standards. 

This role serves as the technical contributor for integration and flight test execution on assigned ACP programs, responsible for coordinating test readiness, managing technical and safety risk, and leading day-to-day test execution.  Here, you will serve as the primary focal point to facilitate coordination across internal program leadership and functional teams, OEM partners, and government customers and stakeholders to deliver high-impact autonomy capabilities at scale.  Successful candidates are curious engineers who use disciplined integration and flight test to generate knowledge, reduce technical risk, and accelerate delivery of operational capability. 

What you'll do:

  • Develop and execute detailed integration and flight test plans that support the overall program verification and test strategy across simulation, SIL, HIL, ground, and flight test environments 
  • Coordinate readiness of simulation environments, integration laboratories, aircraft, and flight test assets required to execute program objectives 
  • Apply aviation knowledge, aircraft performance and operational mission understanding to develop safe, efficient, and operationally relevant integration and flight test plans 
  • Define test objectives, performance metrics, and success criteria, ensuring traceability from requirements to test outcomes and operational capability 
  • Lead and support aircraft integration and flight test activities, including system configuration, software integration, mission planning, real-time troubleshooting, flight execution support, and post-flight data analysis 
  • Coordinate with platform OEMs, government ranges, and flight operations personnel to establish test readiness criteria and ensure technical and safety requirements are satisfied prior to test execution 
  • Coordinate cross-functional execution across software, hardware, systems engineering, flight operations, safety, and program leadership teams 
  • Evaluate test results, identify technical issues, and recommend corrective actions to improve system performance and accelerate capability maturation 

Required qualifications:

  • Typically requires 8+ years of experience with a Bachelor’s degree, or 6+ years with a Master’s 
  • Demonstrated experience planning, conducting, and evaluating flight test of aircraft systems in military or defense aviation environments 
  • Strong understanding of safety-of-flight principles, risk management, and disciplined test execution in aviation environments 
  • Demonstrated understanding of aircraft performance, flight operations, and environmental effects influencing aircraft mission planning, test execution, and safety 
  • Experience with system-level verification & validation across multiple test environments (SIL, HIL, simulation, and flight) 
  • Experience working cross-functionally across software, hardware, avionics, systems engineering, safety, and program teams 
  • Experience with scripting or software tools (Python preferred) for test automation, data analysis, or system validation 
  • Ability to effectively communicate with pilots, operators, and engineers to develop executable flight test objectives, mission plans, and risk mitigations 
  • Excellent technical leadership and communication skills, including briefing to program leadership and external customers 
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a SECRET clearance; U.S. citizenship required 

Preferred qualifications:

  • Military aviation experience as aircrew, flight test engineer, mission systems operator, or engineer supporting military aircraft development or test programs 
  • Prior role as Flight Test Director, Test Conductor, or Lead Flight Test Engineer on full-scale aircraft programs 
  • Understanding of military air operations, mission planning, and Concepts of Operations (CONOPS) supporting autonomous aircraft employment 
  • Experience supporting Autonomous Collaborative Platforms (ACP), loyal wingman concepts, or multi-vehicle autonomous systems 
  • Familiarity with DoD acquisition and developmental test processes 
  • Experience operating in or supporting government flight test ranges and operational environments 
  • Background in autonomy, AI/ML-enabled systems, or human-machine teaming in aviation contexts 
  • Experience with airworthiness processes, flight clearance, and configuration control for aircraft systems 
  • Familiarity with tools such as Git, Jira/Azure DevOps, and CI/CD pipelines 
  • Active SECRET clearance

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Fluid and Mechanical Systems (RX) (R6000)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:
As a Staff (L4) Fluid and Mechanical Systems Engineer, you will be a hands-on multi-disciplinary owner of fluid-system layouts, thermal transport hardware, and adjacent mechanical design for a Group 5 UAV fighter aircraft. You will apply first-principles engineering to develop ram-air circuits, liquid cooling systems, ECS/TMS fluid architecture, and supporting mechanical installations that are buildable, maintainable, and ready for vehicle integration. This position requires a balance of technical rigor, rapid decision-making, and hands-on engineering to efficiently transition concepts into operational capability. The ideal candidate is comfortable solving complex problems, taking ownership, working within an accelerated aircraft development environment, and is motivated by getting meaningful capability into the hands of operators quickly.

What you'll do:

  • Fluid System Layouts: Develop and mature aircraft fluid system layouts for ram-air circuits, liquid cooling loops, ECS/TMS fluid circuits, and hydraulic distribution as applicable, including routing, packaging, and installation concepts.
  • Fluid and Thermal Sizing: Perform pressure-drop, flow-balance, pump and reservoir sizing, and thermal-transport capacity calculations to establish system performance and hardware requirements.
  • Modeling and Analysis: Build and maintain fluid and thermal system models using Flowmaster, AMESim, GFSSP, or equivalent tools to support design decisions, trade assessments, and requirements verification.
  • Mechanical Design Support: Design supporting mechanical hardware, brackets, mounts, line supports, and installation provisions; perform tolerance analysis, clearance assessments, hand calculations, and basic FEA as needed.
  • Component and Hardware Selection: Select and specify pumps, valves, heat exchangers, accumulators, filters, lines, fittings, actuators, and associated hardware for fluid and actuated system installations.
  • Vehicle Integration: Resolve interfaces with structures, EWIS, thermal management, electrical power, and adjacent mechanical systems, including routing, maintainability, and installation-clearance requirements.
  • System Robustness: Support failure mode analysis, contamination control, leak prevention, and system-level redundancy definition for assigned fluid and actuated systems.
  • Hardware and Supplier Execution: Support component sourcing, technical specifications, supplier technical execution, prototype assembly, and test-fixture development.
  • Qualification and Hardware Delivery: Define and execute qualification test plans per MIL-STD-810, using results to mature the design into production-ready hardware and support MIL-HDBK-516 Airworthiness Certification.

Required qualifications:

  • Clearance required: US Citizens Only & Must have an Active Secret or higher clearance.
  • Experience: 7 to 12 years of fluid systems design, thermal systems analysis, or mechanical systems installation experience in aerospace or a comparable regulated industry.
  • Education: B.S. or M.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Core Fundamentals: Deep mastery of thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, heat transfer, mechanical design fundamentals, and tolerance stack-up methodologies.
  • Modeling and Analysis: Demonstrated capability with fluid system sizing and analysis, including pressure drop, flow networks, heat transfer, and 1D fluid or thermal system modeling.
  • System Layout and Integration: Demonstrated ability to create fluid-system layouts and mechanical installations that satisfy routing, packaging, maintainability, structural-interface, and vehicle-integration requirements.
  • CAD and PLM: Experience in 3D CAD modeling, routing, layouts, and drawing release with Siemens NX, CATIA, Creo, SolidWorks, or equivalent PLM workflows.
  • Mechanical Design: Hands-on capability designing brackets, mounts, supports, and installation hardware using hand calculations, tolerance analysis, and basic structural analysis.
  • Hardware and Supplier Execution: Proven track record sourcing COTS/custom aerospace components, driving suppliers to schedule, and assembling benchtop or vehicle-level test setups.
  • Autonomy: Demonstrated ability to self-direct, prioritize technical tasks without oversight, and deliver functional hardware under tight timelines.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Aircraft ram-air, liquid cooling, hydraulic, fuel, or thermal transport loop design experience.
  • ECS or thermal management system design and integration experience.
  • Experience with electro-mechanical or electro-hydrostatic actuation systems and associated mechanical installations.
  • Familiarity with MIL-STD-810, MIL-HDBK-516, and airworthiness verification planning for fluid and mechanical systems.
  • Hands-on prototype-build, fabrication, or mechanical assembly experience in a rapid R&D environment.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Fuel Systems (R5900)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description

    We are seeking a highly motivated Staff Fuel System Engineer to support the design, development, integration, and fielding of a next-generation autonomous aircraft system. This position requires a balance of technical rigor, rapid decision-making, and hands-on engineering to efficiently transition concepts into operational capability. The ideal candidate is comfortable solving complex problems, taking ownership, working within an accelerated aircraft development environment, and is motivated by getting meaningful capability into the hands of operators quickly.

    You will serve as the Responsible Engineer (RE) for the aircraft fuel system, owning technical execution from requirements and architecture through design, procurement, integration, build, test, flight, and operational support. This role requires strong thermofluid fundamentals, engineering judgment, and the ability to understand fuel system behavior across demanding aircraft operating conditions while serving as the focal point between propulsion, vehicle teams, suppliers, and flight operations.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the Responsible Engineer for the aircraft fuel system, owning requirements, architecture, interfaces, hardware, and technical decisions from concept through operational deployment.
  • Design, size, and integrate fuel tanks, pumps, valves, plumbing, venting and pressurization systems, filtration, level sensing, and associated fuel system hardware.
  • Analyze fuel system performance across the aircraft operating envelope, including pressure and flow requirements, transient engine demand, elevated-G maneuvering, tank depletion, slosh, vapor pressure, cavitation, vapor ingestion, and thermal effects.
  • Lead technical design reviews, supplier engagements, and hardware procurement while ensuring the fuel system meets performance, mass, thermal, reliability, safety, and mission requirements.
  • Plan and execute component, subsystem, and vehicle-level testing, including instrumentation, procedures, data acquisition, performance validation, and flight readiness.
  • Analyze ground and flight data to validate system performance, quantify margin, identify anomalies, and drive hardware or operational improvements.
  • Lead failure investigations and root cause efforts using analysis, inspection, testing, and data to develop effective corrective actions.
  • Work hands-on with design engineers, technicians, propulsion, controls, airframe, manufacturing, supply chain, test, and flight teams to build, integrate, troubleshoot, and iterate flight hardware.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 7+ years of experience in aerospace fuel systems, fluid systems, propulsion, or related aircraft system development, with demonstrated ownership of complex aerospace hardware.
  • Strong understanding of thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and compressible and incompressible flow.
  • Strong understanding of aerospace fuel system design, including pressure losses, pump performance, venting, vapor pressure, cavitation, transient flow behavior, and thermal effects.
  • Hands-on experience with fluid system hardware integration, instrumentation, testing, flight support, and technical failure investigations.
  • Strong proficiency in Python or similar tools for engineering analysis, data reduction, and model correlation.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently drive ambiguous technical problems to measurable results in a fast-paced development environment.
  • U.S. Citizenship and active security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing fuel systems for high-performance aircraft, tactical aircraft, UAVs, or similar aerospace platforms.
  • Experience designing fuel systems for elevated-G maneuvering, aggressive vehicle dynamics, or challenging fuel delivery conditions.
  • Experience with fuel tanks, pumps, valves, regulators, level sensing, venting, pressurization, and fuel system control hardware.
  • Familiarity with GFSSP, REFPROP, CFD, ANSYS, FEA, or similar thermal-fluid analysis tools.
  • Experience working with aerospace suppliers through component selection, procurement, development, qualification, and integration.
  • Background in rocket propulsion or propellant systems with experience transferable to aerospace fuel system design, analysis, integration, or test.
  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

Job Description:

As a GenAI Tooling & Developer Experience Engineer on the HMS DevOps Team, you will design, develop, and maintain the GenAI tooling that accelerates the development velocity of your fellow software engineers. You will collaborate with robotics and autonomy software engineers to understand their workflows, remove friction, and enable effective GenAI-assisted development in both commercial and government environments while meeting requirements for secure, controlled data. 

You will build the automation, infrastructure, and integration layers that make GenAI useful across the software engineering organization. You will streamline processes across GitLab, Jira, and Confluence so colleagues spend less time coordinating work and more time creating software. You will apply your expertise in C++, Python, build systems, and developer tooling to provide more power and context to our developers and GenAI tools. 

This is a high-leverage role where your impact scales through the work of others: every improvement you make to GenAI tooling, automation, and developer workflows will help engineers across HMS move faster, work more securely, and spend more time solving the hardest robotics and autonomy problems. 

What you'll do:

  • Design, develop, and maintain GenAI-enabled developer tools for C++, Python, and Node.js software projects. 
  • Partner with robotics and autonomy engineers to identify high-friction workflows and convert them into secure, repeatable GenAI-assisted tooling. 
  • Extend our custom GenAI harness with Python or Bash tools, secure LLM routing, audited execution paths, and local containerized environments. 
  • Build integrations across GitLab, Jira, Confluence, and internal developer systems to provide GenAI tools with useful engineering context. 
  • Improve build, test, and developer-environment workflows, including GenAI-assisted adoption of reproducible Nix development environments. 
  • Support engineers adopting GenAI tooling through documentation, examples, troubleshooting, and feedback-driven improvements. 

Required qualifications:

  • Typically requires a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • Fluent with GenAI-assisted development. You can pair with AI tools to explore ideas, generate code, debug issues, and quickly turn rough concepts into working prototypes.  
  • Hands-on experience building LLM-powered tools for software development. 
  • Direct experience writing scripts (Bash, Python) and utilizing webhooks/APIs to automate and integrate engineering tools (such as Jira, Confluence, and GitLab). 
  • Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, multi-stage builds) and package managers (such as Conan, Poetry, or Nix). 
  • Familiarity with deploying and managing application workloads in cloud environments (such as Azure Gov Cloud or AWS). 
  • Experience with secure software development practices, secret management, and identity providers (Active Directory, Entra ID). 
  • Ability to obtain and maintain an active U.S. SECRET security clearance (U.S. citizenship required).

  • Practical experience building, maintaining, and scaling enterprise CI/CD systems. 
  • Experience developing tools in CUI and ITAR environments.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

We’re looking for an experienced Staff Engineer, Human Machine Interface to join our Hivemind Solutions team and lead the development of operator-facing software for autonomous uncrewed systems. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role spanning HMI, mission systems, and autonomous-platform integration. You will help build the ground-control, mission-planning, command-and-control, and debrief tools through which operators understand, supervise, and control complex autonomous systems. 

You will bring strong frontend engineering experience across modern web and/or desktop technologies, supported by practical C++ and backend or distributed-systems foundations. You will work closely with autonomy, systems, flight-test, product, and operational teams to turn sophisticated platform capabilities into clear, responsive, and mission-effective operator experiences. 

What you'll do:

  • Lead technical direction and architecture for HMI capabilities across Hivemind Solutions products. 
  • Design and deliver applications for mission planning, command and control, vehicle and payload supervision, system health, and post-mission debrief. 
  • Build map-centric and data-rich interfaces that clearly convey vehicle state, autonomy intent, mission status, constraints, alerts, and degraded conditions. 
  • Develop HMI using appropriate frontend technologies, including web frameworks such as React and TypeScript, and native desktop frameworks such as Qt/QML where appropriate. 
  • Design robust data flows and interfaces between frontends, C++ services, backend systems, autonomy software, vehicle interfaces, simulation, payloads, telemetry, and video sources. 
  • Define and negotiate APIs, data models, schemas, interface contracts, and ICDs with internal teams and external partners. 
  • Lead technical design reviews, code reviews, architecture decisions, and engineering practices for quality, performance, maintainability, and release readiness. 
  • Support simulation, operator-in-the-loop testing, system integration, flight test, field activity, and customer demonstrations. 
  • Debug complex HMI and mission-system issues spanning application performance, memory use, data freshness, networking, messaging, video, and vehicle integration. 
  • Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across frontend, HMI, and mission-system software. 

Required qualifications:

  • A tertiary qualification in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, or a related discipline; 
  • Significant professional experience delivering complex user-facing software, ideally as a staff, principal, lead, or senior technical engineer. 
  • Strong experience with one or more modern HMI/frontend technology stacks, such as React, TypeScript, HTML/CSS, Qt/QML, or comparable web and desktop frameworks. 
  • Strong C++ fundamentals and experience contributing to production native software, backend services, integrations, or performance-sensitive systems. 
  • Experience with APIs, distributed systems, asynchronous data flows, messaging, service integration, data models, and client/server architectures. 
  • Experience developing interfaces that consume real-time, operationally significant, or high-rate data. 
  • Demonstrated experience owning software capabilities from architecture through integration, testing, deployment, and operational support. 
  • Strong debugging, profiling, technical communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
  • Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical decisions. 
  • Ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government security clearance. 

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with uncrewed systems, aviation, robotics, autonomy, ground control stations, mission management, command and control, defence systems, or other mission-critical technology. 
  • Experience with geospatial or map-based applications, telemetry visualisation, sensor or payload control, live video, or mission replay/debrief tools. 
  • Familiarity with any of MAVLink, ROS/ROS 2, DDS, REST, WebSockets, STANAG 4586, or related mission-system technologies. 
  • Experience with real-time, edge, bandwidth-constrained, disconnected, or degraded-network environments. 
  • Familiarity with RTSP, WebRTC, GStreamer, H.264/H.265, GPU-accelerated visualisation, or multimedia pipelines. 
  • Experience with human factors, operator workflows, autonomy supervision, alerting, mode awareness, usability testing, or human-autonomy teaming. 
  • Experience supporting field integration, flight test, range activity, customer demonstrations, or operational troubleshooting. 
  • Defence industry experience and/or an existing Australian Government security clearance.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

We are seeking a highly motivated Staff Advance Industrial Engineer to design, optimize, and scale world-class manufacturing systems for advanced aerospace products. In this role, you will lead factory and production system design, including facility layouts, material flow, line balancing, capacity planning, and production readiness. You will also play a critical role in planning and executing greenfield manufacturing facilities, developing factory concepts from the ground up, including production layouts, infrastructure requirements, equipment planning, material flow strategies, and manufacturing standards. 

Partnering with Manufacturing Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Facilities, Quality, EHS, and Program Management, you will develop efficient, scalable, and data-driven manufacturing solutions that enable rapid production growth. This is a high-impact role responsible for transforming manufacturing concepts into production-ready factories while driving safety, quality, throughput, and operational excellence. 

What you'll do:

    • Lead factory layout development, production line design, and manufacturing system optimization for new and existing production programs.  

    • Support the planning and execution of greenfield manufacturing facilities, including factory master planning, space allocation, utility requirements, equipment placement, production flow, and long-term capacity planning.  

    • Develop manufacturing concepts from initial factory planning through production launch, ensuring scalability, flexibility, and operational efficiency.  

    • Design and optimize material flow, point-of-use storage, supermarkets, kitting strategies, replenishment systems, tugger routes, and warehouse logistics.  

    • Develop detailed 2D factory layouts and 3D manufacturing models, including equipment placement, utilities, workstations, safety zones, production support infrastructure, and future expansion plans.  

    • Perform capacity planning, line balancing, takt time analysis, labor planning, buffer sizing, and bottleneck analysis to achieve production targets.  

    • Conduct time studies, ergonomic assessments, spaghetti diagrams, and workflow analyses to improve productivity and eliminate waste.  

    • Develop manufacturing standards for material presentation, packaging, FIFO management, visual controls, workstation design, and factory operating standards.  

    • Lead cross-functional factory design reviews with Manufacturing Engineering, Production, Facilities, Supply Chain, Quality, EHS, and Program Management.  

    • Utilize discrete-event simulation tools to model production throughput, identify constraints, validate factory designs, and optimize manufacturing strategies before implementation.  

    • Support facility construction, equipment installation, tape-outs, utility coordination, commissioning, and production readiness activities during factory launches.  

    • Drive Lean Manufacturing initiatives including 5S, visual management, standardized work, continuous improvement, and value stream optimization.  

    • Develop and maintain factory design standards, launch playbooks, production system guidelines, and manufacturing best practices to support future factory expansions and replication.  

     

    Tools & Skills 

    • AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Revit, Visio, or equivalent CAD/layout software  

    • Siemens Plant Simulation, FlexSim, AnyLogic, or equivalent discrete-event simulation software  

    • Time studies, MTM/MOST, work measurement, and labor analysis  

    • Capacity modeling, line balancing, takt planning, and production system design  

    • Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Value Stream Mapping (VSM), 5S, Kanban, and Visual Management  

    • Material flow analysis, warehouse and logistics design  

    • Factory master planning and facility layout development  

    • Strong analytical, project management, and cross-functional leadership skills  

Required qualifications:

    • Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.  

    • 8+ years of experience in industrial engineering, factory design, manufacturing systems, production planning, advanced manufacturing engineering, or greenfield facility development.  

    • Experience designing factory layouts, production lines, and scalable manufacturing systems for complex products.  

    • Experience supporting greenfield manufacturing projects, facility expansions, or major production line launches.  

    • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes including machining, composites, electrical assemblies, precision mechanical assemblies, and final integration.  

    • Experience supporting production ramp-up, new product introduction (NPI), and manufacturing process development.  

    • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects in a fast-paced, high-growth manufacturing environment.  

    • Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.  

Preferred qualifications:

    • Aerospace, defense, automotive, or advanced manufacturing industry experience.  

    • Experience leading greenfield factory development, factory relocation, or major manufacturing expansion projects.  

    • Knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, or other regulated manufacturing environments.  

    • Experience with automated material handling systems, robotics, AGVs/AMRs, automated storage systems, or Industry 4.0 technologies.  

    • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, Black Belt, or equivalent continuous improvement certification.  

    • Experience with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), ERP systems, digital factory technologies, and production simulation software.

Job Description:

The Staff Industrial Engineer, Sustainment Analytics, leads data-driven sustainment decisions by integrating maintenance, FRACAS, failure and repair, supply-chain, operational demand, configuration, labor, and fleet-trend data to identify drivers of downtime, maintenance burden, readiness risk, and lifecycle cost. The role translates these insights into structured analyses, defensible trade studies, and actionable recommendations that optimize maintenance levels, repair capability, spares, manpower, support equipment, processes, and sustainment strategy—improving fleet readiness, repair throughput, maintenance effectiveness, and total cost of ownership.

The engineer partners closely with Fleet Support Engineering, Reliability and Maintainability Engineering, Product Engineering, Reliability Data Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Finance, and Operations to ensure sustainment decisions improve fleet availability, customer support, affordability, and long-term system performance.

What you'll do:

  • Own sustainment decision analysis for fielded aircraft systems, including maintenance-level determinations; repair-versus-replace, repair-location, and repair-capability assessments; spares optimization; manpower analysis; and support-equipment trade studies.
  • Build and maintain integrated fleet-readiness and availability models that link reliability, maintainability, maintenance demand, repair turnaround time, inventory and supply lead times, labor availability, operational utilization, repair capacity, and cost to readiness outcomes.
  • Develop repair-versus-replace and repair-network business cases that assess discard, organizational/field-level repair, depot or centralized repair, supplier return, and redesign alternatives using repair yield, turnaround time, labor, test-equipment requirements, supply lead times, fleet impact, risk, and lifecycle cost.
  • Analyze maintenance records, work orders, failure and repair history, supply and logistics data, labor data, and fleet operations data to identify recurring maintenance burdens, demand drivers, capacity constraints, bottlenecks, readiness risks, and high-value sustainment opportunities.
  • Develop demand forecasts, spares recommendations, and provisioning strategies using failure rates, consumption history, repair turnaround times, operational tempo, lead times, service-level targets, and deployment requirements.
  • Perform manpower, workload, capacity, and skill-mix analyses to define staffing needs, identify workload constraints and maintenance bottlenecks, and improve repair throughput and maintenance effectiveness.
  • Evaluate investments in support equipment, test equipment, tooling, facilities, and repair capability by quantifying capacity, utilization, cost, risk reduction, readiness impact, return on investment, and total lifecycle value.
  • Develop lifecycle-cost models and economic trade studies to inform sustainment planning, maintenance-program changes, provisioning decisions, repair-network strategy, and leadership investment decisions.
  • Apply Pareto, trend, statistical, sensitivity, and scenario analyses to prioritize actions that improve fleet availability, reduce downtime, lower sustainment cost, and mitigate readiness risk.
  • Translate complex analyses into clear recommendations, decision packages, executive-ready briefings, and prioritized action plans for sustainment leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Establish repeatable sustainment analytics processes, including data standards, modeling methods, decision criteria, assumptions management, and lessons-learned feedback loops; mature the capability toward predictive maintenance, condition-based maintenance, and proactive fleet-health decision support.

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Systems Engineering, Operations Research, Data Analytics, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience considered.
  • 5+ years of experience in industrial engineering, sustainment, logistics, supportability, maintenance, operations research, fleet operations, aviation sustainment, defense logistics, or other complex hardware-support environments.
  • Demonstrated experience using maintenance, reliability, repair, inventory, supply-chain, production, fleet-operations, or fielded-hardware data to develop quantitative analyses and recommendations related to availability, readiness, repair capability, logistics, labor, capacity, cost, and operational performance.
  • Experience performing repair-versus-replace, make-versus-buy, repair-capability, or comparable sustainment trade studies; able to build structured models, quantify assumptions, conduct sensitivity analyses, compare alternatives, and communicate uncertainty and risk.
  • Proficiency with SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, Excel, R, MATLAB, or comparable tools for data analysis, modeling, visualization, and reporting.
  • Ability to integrate technical, operational, supply-chain, labor, and financial inputs into practical, data-driven recommendations for complex sustainment decisions while balancing analytical rigor, data limitations, operational urgency, customer impact, fleet readiness, cost, and long-term sustainment needs.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to work with engineering, fleet support, supply chain, manufacturing, finance, operations, and analytics teams; develop clear decision packages, technical analyses, recommendations, and leadership-level summaries; and independently drive decisions without direct authority.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Familiarity with aviation, defense, aerospace manufacturing, unmanned systems, aircraft sustainment and deployed hardware systems.
  • Familiarity with RCCA, FRACAS, PQDR, AS9100, service bulletins, maintenance releases, supply chain and workforce management.
  • Proficiency with data analysis and visualization tools such as SQL, Excel, Python, Salesforce, Foundry, or similar platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to collect, clean, join, and structure data from multiple operational, maintenance, failure, or quality systems.
  • Experience developing metrics, dashboards, or recurring reports that improved decision-making, increased visibility, or reduced manual reporting effort.
  • Demonstrated success identifying and correcting data-quality, traceability, or reporting issues before they affected technical or business decisions.
  • Ability to translate complex data into clear, decision-ready information for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience supporting military, government, international, or deployed aviation customers.
  • Familiarity with ITAR, export-controlled technical data, or controlled customer environments.
  • Active Secret or Top Secret clearance.

Candidates for this role will deploy, integrate, maintain, and support Shield AI's advanced vision and detection systems in laboratory, production, customer, and field environments. These systems combine imaging sensors, onboard processing, and intelligent detection capabilities in ruggedized camera pods and gimbals for crewed and uncrewed fixed-wing and rotary-wing aircraft. We are looking for a hands-on integration engineer who can bridge software, electrical, and mechanical disciplines; manage hardware and software configurations with precision; troubleshoot effectively; and represent Shield AI with customers and mission partners. 

What You'll Do:

  • Install, integrate, configure, and support deployment of vision systems including: camera pods, imaging sensors, onboard processing hardware, and associated electronic assemblies on crewed and uncrewed aircraft and supporting test assets
  • Load, configure, update, and validate software releases in accordance with release instructions and configuration-control processes
  • Perform system bring-up, functional checkout, acceptance testing, and post-installation verification of sensor, compute, power, network, and aircraft interfaces
  • Maintain accurate hardware and software configuration records, including serial numbers, part numbers, software versions, installation status, service history, spares, and returned-material activity
  • Read and apply mechanical drawings, installation drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, pinouts, interface-control documents, work instructions, and technical manuals
  • Perform basic wiring and electro-mechanical work, including connector inspection, continuity checks, pin verification, cable routing, termination, and minor harness rework when authorized by approved procedures
  • Diagnose and resolve software, electrical, network, sensor, and mechanical integration issues using logs, built-in diagnostics, test equipment, drawings, and controlled troubleshooting methods
  • Document field issues, troubleshooting steps, test results, repairs, configuration changes, and corrective actions in clear service reports and engineering-tracking systems
  • Coordinate with engineering, production, quality, program, and customer teams to resolve issues, implement approved changes, and communicate operational feedback
  • Support customer deployments, demonstrations, operational exercises, and evaluations, including site readiness, equipment staging, installation planning, shipping and receiving, tool control, inventory, and field-service logistics
  • Provide hands-on customer support, operator and maintainer familiarization, and technical guidance for system operation, routine maintenance, and fault isolation
  • Follow applicable safety, quality, airworthiness, cybersecurity, export-control, and configuration-management requirements while traveling to customer, test, and operational sites 

Required Qualifications:

  • Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of experience in field service, aerospace integration, electronics, avionics, mechatronics, or a related technical discipline with a Bachelor's or Associate's degree; or equivalent practical experience.
  • Hands-on experience installing, integrating, maintaining, or troubleshooting electro-mechanical systems, electronic assemblies, sensors, computing hardware, or airborne payloads.
  • Experience installing, configuring, updating, and verifying software or firmware on fielded systems while following release and configuration-control procedures.
  • Ability to read and work from wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, mechanical and installation drawings, pinouts, work instructions, and technical manuals.
  • Familiarity with Linux- and Windows-based systems, command-line tools, software deployment workflows, networking, and log collection.
  • Competence with basic wiring and electrical troubleshooting, including safe use of digital multimeters, continuity testing, connector inspection, pin verification, cable routing, and basic termination or rework.
  • Strong hardware accountability and documentation skills, including asset, serial-number, inventory, maintenance, and software-version tracking.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot across software, electrical, network, and mechanical interfaces and to clearly document findings and corrective actions.
  • Strong customer-facing communication, organization, and teamwork skills, with the ability and willingness to travel approximately 50% to support customer integration, deployments, demonstrations, exercises, evaluations, and other field activities, including work outside standard hours when required.
  • Ability to obtain a SECRET clearance. 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Field-service, deployment, or integration experience in the aerospace, defense, robotics, or other mission-critical equipment industry.
  • Experience with electro-optical or infrared imaging systems, camera systems, optical sensors, ruggedized sensor pods, or airborne mission payloads.
  • Experience integrating equipment on crewed or uncrewed fixed-wing or rotary-wing aircraft.
  • Experience with aviation or military wiring practices, cable and connector assembly, soldering or crimping, and standards such as IPC/WHMA-A-620.
  • Experience using oscilloscopes, power supplies, network analyzers, serial interfaces, Ethernet, CAN, or other common integration and diagnostic tools.
  • Experience with configuration-management, asset-management, inventory, enterprise resource planning, product lifecycle management, or maintenance-tracking systems.
  • Experience providing customer training, technical demonstrations, service documentation, or remote and on-site technical support.
  • Familiarity with FAA, DoD, or U.S. test-site operations, aviation safety practices, and airworthiness expectations.
