We are looking for an exceptional Sr Staff Technical Program Manager to lead the integration of Shield AI’s Hivemind autonomy stack onto next-generation aircraft platforms, guiding programs from concept through production and operational deployment.  
You will drive alignment across hardware and software development activities, ensuring aircraft, autonomy software, and operational teams remain synchronized throughout the full product lifecycle. This role requires close coordination with distributed engineering teams across multiple offices globally.  

The ideal candidate combines strong technical program management fundamentals with hands-on experience coordinating complex hardware/software integration efforts and customer facing program management. You will drive schedule, cost, technical performance, integration readiness, and operational outcomes while helping define the future of autonomous aviation.  

What you'll do: 

    Lead Hivemind Enterprise Delivery
  •  Serve as the program manager responsible for the successful delivery of Hivemind Enterprise software to Armed Services and OEM customers.
  • Serve as the program manager responsible for the successful integration of Shield AI’s Hivemind autonomy software onto next-generation aircraft platforms. 
    • Drive Hardware & Software Alignment 
  • Operate as an embedded partner to aircraft engineering teams ensuring software development aligns with hardware integration, manufacturing, lab availability, and flight test schedules.  
    • Establish Clear Objectives 
  • Work closely with product managers, engineering leads, operations, and executive leadership to define clear program objectives tied to mission impact, customer success, strategic growth, financial outcomes, and technical performance. 
    • Program & Project Management 
  • Own development and execution of integrated project plans including scope, schedules, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and resource allocation. Continuously evaluate and rebalance customer priorities, technical risks, cost constraints, and schedule demands throughout the program. 
    • Drive Timely, High-Quality Decisions 
  • Facilitate rigorous, fast, and effective technical and programmatic decision-making across cross-functional teams. While not expected to design systems directly, you will possess sufficient technical depth to identify risks, challenge assumptions, and drive alignment. 
    • Integration & Flight Test Readiness  
  • Coordinate system integration activities across labs, ground test, and flight test operations. Drive readiness reviews, integration milestones, and closure of technical dependencies required to support successful aircraft integration and operational deployment.
  • Identify potential bottlenecks, critical path risks, and schedule delays, and drive mitigation strategies to achieve program milestones and delivery commitments. Conduct critical path analyses and support program execution through Gate Reviews, Program Management Reviews (PMRs), and Estimates at Completion (EACs).  
    • Communicate with Excellence  
  • Drive a consistent cadence of well-organized, effective meetings, including preparation, facilitation, action tracking, and follow-up. 
  • Ensure stakeholders (external and internal) remain aligned on status, milestones, priorities, risks, integration readiness, and technical challenges.  
    • Drive Technical Execution  
  • Support the development and refinement of technical and operational documentation, engineering change orders, work instructions, service bulletins, operational procedures, and integration documentation.  
    • Empower Teams & Remove Obstacles 
  • Create an environment where teams have the clarity, tools, accountability, and support needed to execute effectively. Escalate issues quickly, streamline processes, eliminate blockers, and foster a culture of ownership, urgency, and continuous improvement.
    • Deliver Outcomes 
  • Drive accurate and timely tracking and reporting of program financials, resources, schedules, integration status, and customer deliverables. 
    • Support Growth & Strategic Initiatives 
  • Support business development activities related to current and future autonomy integration programs, including proposals, requests for information (RFIs), requests for proposals (RFPs), technical evaluations, and strategic customer engagements.  

Required qualifications: 

  • Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 9 years and a Master’s degree
  • Experience leading complex cross-functional engineering programs from concept through production and operational deployment.  
  • Experience in military aviation
  • Strong technical understanding of software-enabled systems, autonomy, aerospace systems, or complex integrated products.  
  • Demonstrated success managing program execution across scope, schedule, budget, risk, and technical performance in fast-paced environments. 
  • Experience with Program Management Reviews (PMRs), gate reviews, and estimates. 
  • Exceptional customer communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to lead through influence across distributed teams.  
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills in fast-paced environments. 
  • Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and ability to drive execution with high standards and collaboration. 
  • Ability to travel up to 30%. 

Preferred qualifications: 

  • Experience integrating autonomy or software systems onto defense platforms. 
  • Experience in software development, autonomy development, or systems engineering.  
  • Experience managing clean-sheet defense or technology development programs.  
  • PMP and/or Certified Scrum Master (CSM) certification.  
  • Familiarity with MoD contracting, defense acquisition, or national security programs.  
  • Experience balancing aggressive timelines with complex engineering constraints.

This position is intentionally geared toward highly technical leaders who bring deep aerospace systems experience and are capable of operating effectively across flight sciences, vehicle integration, aerostructures, autonomy, test, and operations teams. This role will serve as a key integrator across engineering and program functions, helping align technical execution with demonstration objectives, risk reduction activities, and operational milestones.

What you'll do:

  • Lead day-to-day execution of the Hopper Demonstration Program across engineering, integration, flight test, and operations stakeholders
  • Drive integrated program planning, technical coordination, and execution tracking across multiple subsystem teams
  • Coordinate activities spanning flight controls, aero/performance, aerostructures, avionics, autonomy, software, and vehicle integration
  • Partner closely with engineering leads to identify technical risks, integration gaps, and critical path dependencies

  • Support rapid problem solving and decision-making in dynamic development and flight test environments

  • Aerodynamics / flight sciences
  • Vehicle integration

  • Aerostructures

We are looking for someone who can operate as a true talent partner to engineering leadership, helping shape hiring strategy, influence workforce planning, drive prioritization discipline, and build scalable pipelines for some of the hardest-to-hire technical talent in the industry.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description: 

Shield AI is seeking an experienced V-BAT Technical Writer to support the development, release, and lifecycle management of aircraft system service bulletins. This is a hands-on technical publications role that works closely with engineering, quality, manufacturing, and field support teams to translate complex technical changes, safety concerns, inspection requirements, corrective actions, and operational limitations into clear, accurate, and actionable communications for operators and maintainers. The successful candidate may come from an A&P, military aviation maintenance, UAS maintenance or operations, avionics, flight-test, aerospace technician, or field-service background, with demonstrated ability to write and maintain technical publications. 

The ideal candidate understands how aircraft are assembled, operated, inspected, troubleshot, repaired, and returned to service and is able to turn that knowledge into precise, usable, configuration-controlled documentation. The Technical Writer will be responsible for determining the appropriate scope and audience for service bulletins; identifying affected aircraft configurations, serial-number ranges, components, and software versions; documenting required inspections, modifications, repair actions, or operational restrictions; and ensuring released content aligns with approved engineering data and internal document-control processes. 

What you'll do:

  • Partner closely with mechanical, electrical, software, systems, quality, and fleet support engineers to develop and maintain accurate, actionable service bulletins to communicate required inspections, corrective actions, modifications, operational limitations, maintenance actions, parts replacements, or configuration changes affecting aircraft safety, airworthiness, reliability, or maintainability. 
  • Develop step-by-step maintenance and inspection procedures that are technically accurate, safe, complete, and usable in operational environments. 
  • Observe and document maintenance, assembly, inspection, troubleshooting, ground-test, and flight-test activities to ensure procedures reflect actual work execution. 
  • Develop or coordinate supporting technical visuals, including annotated photographs, exploded views, system diagrams, task flows, wiring or schematic excerpts, illustrations, and other graphics required for safe operation and maintenance. 
  • Assess the documentation impact of engineering changes, software releases, flight-test findings, and operational feedback; coordinate reviews and issue timely configuration-controlled updates. 
  • Determine and clearly document bulletin applicability, prerequisites, compliance requirements, labor estimates, required tools, consumables, replacement parts, and return-to-service requirements. 
  • Write and maintain warnings, cautions, notes, limitations, and hazard statements that communicate risks associated with maintenance, aircraft configuration changes, energized systems, rotating components, fuel, batteries, and other applicable hazards. 
  • Manage multiple service bulletin efforts across issue identification, engineering investigation, drafting, technical review, validation, release, revision, and field communication in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Facilitate cross-functional reviews with engineering, quality, manufacturing, supply chain, flight operations, maintenance, training, and customer-support stakeholders. 
  • Research and interpret engineering artifacts, including drawings, bills of material, engineering change orders, software release notes, wiring diagrams, maintenance procedures, inspection criteria, test reports, and configuration records. 
  • Work with engineering, quality, flight test, manufacturing, and operations teams to identify missing, incomplete, conflicting, unsafe, or ambiguous technical content and drive resolution before release. 
  • Maintain service bulletin templates, style guides, numbering conventions, revision histories, distribution records, and document-control processes. 
  • Support rapid publication and revision of service bulletins in response to flight-test findings, field issues, reliability trends, supplier notifications, production escapes, and operational feedback. 
  • Review field feedback and maintenance data to identify opportunities to improve bulletin clarity, reduce maintenance burden, and prevent recurring discrepancies. 
  • Ensure published bulletins align with applicable technical publications, maintenance manuals, illustrated parts catalogs, operator manuals, and approved engineering configurations. 
  • Maintain organized source material, technical references, revision histories, review comments, and approval records in accordance with company processes. 
  • Maintain traceability between published technical content and the applicable hardware configuration, software version, engineering change, product effectivity, and release approval. 
  • Fulfill additional responsibilities as required in support of V-BAT program objectives. 

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. Equivalent experience may include aircraft maintenance, military aviation, UAS maintenance or operations, avionics, flight test, aerospace field service, engineering technician work, or technical publications. 
  • 3+ years of or relevant experience in maintenance documentation, service engineering, or technical writing in aerospace, defense, aviation, unmanned aircraft systems, or other complex electromechanical systems. 
  • Demonstrated ability to create, revise, or technically validate maintenance procedures, troubleshooting instructions, operator procedures, service bulletins, work instructions, test procedures, or other post-delivery documentation. 
  • Experience developing maintenance instructions for aircraft systems, unmanned aircraft systems, avionics, propulsion systems, electrical systems, mechanical assemblies, or complex hardware/software products. 
  • Practical working knowledge of aircraft or UAS systems, including the ability to understand and document mechanical, electrical, avionics, propulsion, payload, ground-support, and/or mission-system interfaces. 
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, BOMs, CAD outputs, schematics, system architectures, requirements, interface control documents, test data, and engineering changes. 
  • Proven ability to work directly with engineers, quality personnel, maintainers, flight-test teams, and other subject matter experts to obtain, validate, and document technical information. 
  • Demonstrated ability to produce clear, sequential, user-focused procedures for inspection, removal, installation, modification, troubleshooting, functional testing, and return-to-service activities. 
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and organizational skills, with a consistent focus on technical accuracy, clarity, completeness, and usability. 
  • Ability to identify ambiguous, incomplete, conflicting, or potentially unsafe technical information and drive resolution with the responsible stakeholders. 
  • Experience working in a configuration-managed product environment with controlled document revisions, technical reviews, and formal approvals. 
  • Self-sufficient and proactive work style, with the ability to manage multiple high-priority publication efforts under compressed timelines. 
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver accurate work in a fast-paced development environment. 

Preferred qualifications:

  • FAA Airframe and Powerplant (A&P) certificate, military aviation maintenance specialty, or equivalent civilian or military aircraft maintenance experience. 
  • Experience maintaining, troubleshooting, inspecting, or supporting fixed-wing aircraft, rotorcraft, UAS, or other autonomous or robotic platforms. 
  • Experience supporting corrective-action, reliability, quality, safety, or fleet-support programs. 
  • Familiarity with ATA iSpec 2200, S1000D, MIL-STD-40051, MIL-STD-38784, MIL-STD-1808, service technical-order/manual formats, or comparable technical-publication frameworks. 
  • Background supporting developmental test, operational test, flight test, field sustainment, deployed operations, depot maintenance, or field-service operations. 
  • Experience using PLM, document-control, change-control, configuration-management, requirements-management, or engineering-release systems. 
  • Experience with Adobe FrameMaker, Arbortext, XML/DITA, Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Suite, Visio, or comparable technical-authoring and illustration tools. 
  • Experience developing or managing technical illustrations, wiring diagrams, and other maintenance graphics.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. The Tool Control Coordinator is responsible for establishing, implementing, and managing a comprehensive tool control program modeled after commercial and military aviation standards. This role will develop and enforce policies, processes, and accountability systems that ensure all tools used within maintenance operations are tracked, controlled, and compliant with aviation safety and regulatory requirements. The Tool Control Coordinator role will coordinate daily tool room operations, support maintenance and air vehicle operator teams, and oversee the lifecycle of controlled tools and equipment.

What You'll Do:

    • Develop and implement a robust tool control program, including policies, procedures, tool inventories, shadow boards, tracking systems, and inspection protocols.

    • Lead the daily operations of tool rooms and tool issue points, ensuring full accountability and availability of tools to support maintenance work and field operations.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

Will serves as the regional trade compliance leader for the UK and Europe, providing strategic oversight and execution of the company's international trade compliance program in support of critical defense. This position is responsible for developing and implementing regional trade compliance strategies, ensuring compliance with UK and international export control regulations, sanctions, licensing requirements, and other applicable trade laws throughout the full program lifecycle. The Trade Compliance Manager partners closely with Engineering, Program Management, Legal, Business Development, Supply Chain, and government stakeholders to enable business objectives while mitigating export compliance risk. The role provides leadership across multiple concurrent, high-priority international programs, advises senior leadership on trade compliance matters, and drives consistent compliance processes across the region.

What you'll do:

  • Act as the primary trade compliance point of contact for the UK and support regional compliance activities across Europe.
  • Review, prepare, submit, and manage export authorizations through UK systems (e.g., SPIRE), including SIELs, OIELs, and OGELs, and support European licensing requirements where applicable.
  • Classify products, software, and technical data under UK Strategic Export Control Lists
  • Provide guidance on European export control considerations, including intra-EU transfers and applicable member state regulations.
  • Partner with engineering teams to understand system functionality, data flows, and technical specifications to support accurate classifications and licensing strategies.
  • Develop and maintain classification and licensing documentation, including rationale and audit-ready records.
  • Provide clear, actionable guidance on export control requirements, restrictions, and compliance strategies across UK and European business activities.
  • Implement and manage trade compliance procedures, including visitor controls, international travel guidance, and restricted party screening in accordance with UK, EU, and applicable international regulations.
  • Review export authorizations to ensure alignment with UK government requirements (e.g., ECJU), relevant European authorities, and internal policies.
  • Monitor regulatory developments in UK and European export controls, ensuring ongoing compliance and organizational awareness.
  • Build and improve scalable internal processes and tools to streamline classification and licensing workflows across the region.

Required qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in trade compliance, customs, or export control within aerospace, defense, or advanced technology industries.
  • Experience with UK export control regulations and/or US export control frameworks (ITAR and EAR), including licensing and classification.
  • Experience managing export authorizations and interacting with regulatory bodies such as the UK Export Control Joint Unit (ECJU), EU member state authorities, and/or US State and Commerce Departments.
  • Strong working knowledge of export classification methodologies, jurisdiction determinations, and licensing workflows.
  • Understanding of European export control regimes and cross-border transfer considerations within Europe.
  • Experience collaborating with engineering and program teams to translate technical information into compliant export classifications and documentation.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business, International Trade, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience liaising with UK Government departments.
  • Experience supporting programs involving defense technologies, dual-use items, or autonomous systems.
  • Exposure to compliance operations across multiple jurisdictions (EU, US, APJ).
  • Relevant professional certifications (e.g., Certified Export Specialist, Certified Customs Specialist, or equivalent).
#LI-SL1
#LD

Job Description:

Shield AI’s mission is to protect service members and civilians with intelligent systems. We are seeking a UAS Operator & Flight Operations Technician to support autonomous aircraft testing, demonstrations, and flight operations in Ukraine. 

This is a highly hands-on, field-focused role supporting fixed-wing and multirotor unmanned aircraft systems in simulation, ground testing, and live flight environments. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating in dynamic field conditions, troubleshooting hardware and operational issues, and supporting autonomous flight testing activities with a strong safety mindset. 

This role will primarily support operations in the Lviv region, with occasional travel to other locations within Ukraine for demonstrations, testing, and operational support activities. 

What you'll do:

  • Operate fixed-wing and multirotor unmanned aircraft systems in test and operational environments  
  • Serve as a safety pilot for experimental and autonomous aircraft systems, including manual recovery of aircraft when required  
  • Support execution of simulation, SIL, HIL, VIL, ground testing, and live flight test activities  
  • Operate Ground Control Stations (GCS) and associated mission systems  
  • Support pre-flight setup, aircraft inspections, launch and recovery operations, and post-flight activities  
  • Configure, setup, transport, and maintain aircraft, support equipment, batteries, radios, networking equipment, and operational infrastructure  
  • Troubleshoot and repair aircraft systems and field support equipment  
  • Transport equipment and personnel to test and demonstration sites  
  • Create and maintain operational checklists, packing lists, maintenance logs, and flight documentation  
  • Support demonstration events and customer flight operations  
  • Work closely with engineering and flight test teams to support safe and effective field operations  
  • Ensure operations comply with local airspace requirements, operational procedures, and applicable Ukrainian UAS regulations  

Required qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience operating unmanned aircraft systems in field, test, or operational environments  
  • Experience operating both fixed-wing and multirotor UAS platforms  
  • Experience supporting Group 1 and Group 2 UAS operations, approximately up to 55 lbs / 25 kg  
  • Strong understanding of flight safety procedures and emergency recovery operations  
  • Experience supporting flight tests, demonstrations, or operational field exercises  
  • Familiarity with Ground Control Stations, telemetry systems, radios, and mission support equipment  
  • Experience supporting SIL, HIL, VIL, or related test environments  
  • Ability to troubleshoot and repair aircraft and support equipment in the field  
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to operational detail  
  • Familiarity with Ukrainian airspace requirements and operational procedures for UAS operations  
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to transport equipment and personnel to operational sites  
  • Ability to travel within Ukraine as required  
  • Ability to obtain and maintain any required Ukrainian remote pilot or UAS operational certifications  

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience supporting autonomous aircraft or experimental flight testing  
  • Background in military, defense, robotics, or aerospace operations  
  • Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, or similar flight control systems  
  • Experience with RF communications, datalinks, and networking systems  
  • Mechanical or electrical maintenance experience on unmanned aircraft systems  
  • Experience operating in austere or rapidly changing field environments  
  • Familiarity with BVLOS operations and operational risk management  
  • Ukrainian and English language proficiency  
  • Prior experience supporting defense or tactical UAS operations
